task1-bar-charts:1.english: The bar chart compares the number of US households, measured in millions, across five annual income bands in 2007, 2011 and 2015.
task1-bar-charts:1.chinese: 這張柱狀圖比較了 2007 年、 2011 年和 2015 年美國家庭在五個年收入組別中的數量，單位為百萬戶。

task1-bar-charts:1.english: Overall, the distribution was dominated by households earning below $50,000 and by those earning $100,000 or more, while the two middle-income groups were consistently smaller.
task1-bar-charts:1.chinese: 整體而言，年收入低於 50,000 美元的家庭以及年收入 100,000 美元或以上的家庭佔比較大，而兩個中等收入組別的家庭數量一直較少。

task1-bar-charts:1.english: The highest-income category became clearly the largest by 2015, whereas the $75,000–$99,999 group remained the least common throughout.
task1-bar-charts:1.chinese: 到 2015 年，最高收入組別明顯成為最大的類別；相反， 75,000 至 99,999 美元收入組在整段期間都是最少見的組別。

task1-bar-charts:1.english: In 2007, about 25 million households earned under $25,000, compared with roughly 27 million in the $25,000–$49,999 bracket.
task1-bar-charts:1.chinese: 在 2007 年，約有 2,500 萬戶家庭年收入低於 25,000 美元，而 25,000 至 49,999 美元收入組則約有 2,700 萬戶。

task1-bar-charts:1.english: Both groups increased by 2011, reaching just under 29 million and around 30 million, respectively.
task1-bar-charts:1.chinese: 到 2011 年，這兩個組別均有所上升，分別達到接近 2,900 萬戶和約 3,000 萬戶。

task1-bar-charts:1.english: By 2015, they had edged down slightly, to approximately 28 million and 29 million, although they were still among the largest categories.
task1-bar-charts:1.chinese: 到 2015 年，兩者都輕微回落，分別降至約 2,800 萬戶和 2,900 萬戶，但它們仍然屬於最大的組別之一。

task1-bar-charts:1.english: The remaining three bands showed less uniform movement.
task1-bar-charts:1.chinese: 其餘三個收入組別的變化則沒有那麼一致。

task1-bar-charts:1.english: The number of households earning $50,000–$74,999 stayed almost unchanged at about 21 million in all three years.
task1-bar-charts:1.chinese: 年收入 50,000 至 74,999 美元的家庭數量在三個年份中幾乎沒有變化，均約為2,100 萬戶。

task1-bar-charts:1.english: Those in the $75,000–$99,999 range were consistently the smallest group, at around 14–15 million.
task1-bar-charts:1.chinese: 年收入 75,000 至 99,999 美元的家庭一直是最小的組別，數量約為 1,400 萬至1,500 萬戶。

task1-bar-charts:1.english: By contrast, households with incomes of at least $100,000 dipped from about 29 million to 28 million in 2011, before rising sharply to approximately 33 million in 2015.
task1-bar-charts:1.chinese: 相比之下，年收入至少 100,000 美元的家庭數量先從約 2,900 萬戶下降至 2011年的 2,800 萬戶，之後在 2015 年大幅上升至約 3,300 萬戶。

task1-bar-charts:2.english: The bar chart compares the proportions of weekly income that families in one country spent on eight categories in 1968 and 2018.
task1-bar-charts:2.chinese: 這張柱狀圖比較了一個國家的家庭在 1968 年和 2018 年把每週收入花在八個類別上的比例。

task1-bar-charts:2.english: Overall, household spending shifted noticeably over the 50-year period.
task1-bar-charts:2.chinese: 整體而言，在這 50 年間，家庭支出結構出現了明顯轉變。

task1-bar-charts:2.english: Food was by far the dominant item in 1968, but its share fell sharply by 2018, when leisure, housing and transport had become much more significant.
task1-bar-charts:2.chinese: 食物在 1968 年是遠遠最主要的支出項目，但到 2018 年其比例大幅下降；同時，休閒、住房和交通變得重要得多。

task1-bar-charts:2.english: Several smaller categories declined, while household goods remained broadly stable.
task1-bar-charts:2.chinese: 幾個較小的類別有所下降，而家居用品則大致保持穩定。

task1-bar-charts:2.english: In 1968, families allocated about 35% of their income to food, more than three times the proportion spent on housing or clothing and footwear, each at around 10%.
task1-bar-charts:2.chinese: 在 1968 年，家庭把大約 35% 的收入花在食物上，這是住房或服裝及鞋類支出比例的三倍多；後兩者各約佔 10% 。

task1-bar-charts:2.english: Leisure and transport were also relatively modest, at just under 10% and about 8% respectively.
task1-bar-charts:2.chinese: 休閒和交通的比例也相對較低，分別為略低於 10% 和約 8% 。

task1-bar-charts:2.english: Household goods and personal goods accounted for similar shares, at roughly 7–8%, while fuel and power was slightly lower, at around 6%.
task1-bar-charts:2.chinese: 家居用品和個人用品所佔比例相近，約為 7% 至 8% ；而燃料和能源則稍低，約為 6% 。

task1-bar-charts:2.english: By 2018, leisure had become the largest category, rising to just over a fifth of income.
task1-bar-charts:2.chinese: 到 2018 年，休閒已成為最大的類別，上升至略高於收入的五分之一。

task1-bar-charts:2.english: Housing almost doubled to approximately 19%, and transport increased to about 14%.
task1-bar-charts:2.chinese: 住房幾乎翻倍，升至約 19% ；交通則增加至約 14% 。

task1-bar-charts:2.english: In contrast, food dropped to around 17%, clothing and footwear halved to 5%, and personal goods and fuel and power both fell to about 4%.
task1-bar-charts:2.chinese: 相比之下，食物下降至約 17% ，服裝及鞋類減半至 5% ，而個人用品以及燃料和能源都下降至約 4% 。

task1-bar-charts:2.english: Household goods changed very little, remaining near 7%.
task1-bar-charts:2.chinese: 家居用品變化很小，仍維持在約 7% 。

task1-bar-charts:3.english: The bar chart compares the proportions of residents in Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Adelaide and Hobart who bought fresh or instant coffee, or visited a café for coffee or tea, over the previous four weeks.
task1-bar-charts:3.chinese: 這張柱狀圖比較了悉尼、墨爾本、布里斯本、阿德萊德和霍巴特居民在過去四星期內購買新鮮咖啡、即溶咖啡，或到咖啡店喝咖啡或茶的比例。

task1-bar-charts:3.english: Overall, going to a café was the most common habit in most cities, while buying fresh coffee was consistently the least popular option.
task1-bar-charts:3.chinese: 整體而言，在大多數城市中，到咖啡店是最常見的習慣，而購買新鮮咖啡則一直是最不受歡迎的選項。

task1-bar-charts:3.english: Instant coffee was more widely purchased than fresh coffee in every city, and Adelaide was the only place where café visits did not occupy first position.
task1-bar-charts:3.chinese: 在每個城市中，即溶咖啡的購買比例都高於新鮮咖啡；而阿德萊德是唯一一個咖啡店到訪率沒有排在第一位的城市。

task1-bar-charts:3.english: Café-going was especially popular in Melbourne and Hobart, at about 64% and 63% respectively, followed by Sydney, where just over three fifths of residents reported doing so.
task1-bar-charts:3.chinese: 到咖啡店在墨爾本和霍巴特尤其普遍，比例分別約為 64% 和 63% ；其次是悉尼，當地略多於五分之三的居民表示曾這樣做。

task1-bar-charts:3.english: The figures were lower in Brisbane, at around 56%, and Adelaide, at just under 50%, making it the weakest city for café visits.
task1-bar-charts:3.chinese: 布里斯本的比例較低，約為 56% ；而阿德萊德則略低於 50% ，因此成為咖啡店到訪率最低的城市。

task1-bar-charts:3.english: In terms of coffee purchases, instant coffee recorded relatively high figures in Hobart and Brisbane, at roughly 54% and 53%.
task1-bar-charts:3.chinese: 就咖啡購買而言，即溶咖啡在霍巴特和布里斯本錄得相對較高的比例，分別約為 54% 和 53% 。

task1-bar-charts:3.english: Adelaide stood at about 50%, while Melbourne and Sydney were slightly lower, at approximately 48% and 45% respectively.
task1-bar-charts:3.chinese: 阿德萊德約為 50% ；而墨爾本和悉尼則稍低，分別約為 48% 和 45% 。

task1-bar-charts:3.english: By contrast, fresh coffee attracted smaller shares everywhere: around 44% in Sydney, 43% in Melbourne, 39% in Hobart, and only about 34% in Brisbane and 35% in Adelaide.
task1-bar-charts:3.chinese: 相比之下，新鮮咖啡在所有城市中的比例都較低：悉尼約為 44% ，墨爾本約為43% ，霍巴特約為 39% ，而布里斯本和阿德萊德分別只有約 34% 和 35% 。

task1-bar-charts:4.english: The bar chart compares the percentages of households living in owner-occupied and rented accommodation in England and Wales between 1918 and 2011.
task1-bar-charts:4.chinese: 這張柱狀圖比較了 1918 年至 2011 年間，英格蘭和威爾斯居住在自有住房和租住住房中的家庭比例。

task1-bar-charts:4.english: Overall, home ownership followed a clear upward trajectory for most of the period, whereas renting moved in the opposite direction.
task1-bar-charts:4.chinese: 整體而言，在大部分期間，自有住房比例呈現明顯上升趨勢；相反，租住住房比例則朝相反方向變化。

task1-bar-charts:4.english: The two categories were equal in 1971, after which ownership became dominant, although it slipped slightly in the final year.
task1-bar-charts:4.chinese: 這兩個類別在 1971 年持平；其後，自有住房成為主導類別，儘管它在最後一年略有回落。

task1-bar-charts:4.english: In 1918, renting accounted for by far the larger share, at just under four fifths of households, while ownership stood at only about 22%.
task1-bar-charts:4.chinese: 在 1918 年，租住住房佔明顯較大的比例，略低於五分之四；而自有住房比例僅約為 22% 。

task1-bar-charts:4.english: By 1939 and 1953, the rental figure had fallen to around 68%, with owner-occupation rising to roughly 31–32%.
task1-bar-charts:4.chinese: 到 1939 年和 1953 年，租住住房比例已下降至約 68% ，而自有住房比例則上升至約 31% 至 32% 。

task1-bar-charts:4.english: The gap narrowed further in 1961, when about 42% of households owned their homes, compared with just under 60% that rented.
task1-bar-charts:4.chinese: 到 1961 年，兩者之間的差距進一步收窄，當時約 42% 的家庭擁有自己的住房，而租住住房的比例則略低於 60% 。

task1-bar-charts:4.english: The turning point came in 1971, when both categories stood at exactly 50%.
task1-bar-charts:4.chinese: 轉折點出現在 1971 年，當時兩個類別的比例均為 50% 。

task1-bar-charts:4.english: Thereafter, ownership climbed to approximately 60% in 1981 and almost 70% in 2001, reaching its peak.
task1-bar-charts:4.chinese: 此後，自有住房比例在 1981 年上升至約 60% ，並在 2001 年接近 70% ，達最高點。

task1-bar-charts:4.english: By contrast, renting declined to just over 30% by 2001.
task1-bar-charts:4.chinese: 相比之下，租住住房比例到 2001 年下降至略高於 30% 。

task1-bar-charts:4.english: In 2011, however, the pattern changed modestly: ownership decreased to about 64%, while renting recovered to around 36%.
task1-bar-charts:4.chinese: 然而，到 2011 年，這一模式出現了輕微變化：自有住房比例下降至約 64% ，而租住住房比例則回升至約 36% 。

task1-bar-charts:5.english: The bar chart compares electricity production and consumption in the ten leading countries in 2014, in billions of kilowatt-hours.
task1-bar-charts:5.chinese: 這張柱狀圖比較了 2014 年十大主要國家的電力生產量和耗電量，單位為十億千瓦時。

task1-bar-charts:5.english: Overall, China and the United States were by far the largest producers and users, whereas the other eight countries recorded much lower figures.
task1-bar-charts:5.chinese: 整體而言，中國和美國是明顯最大的電力生產國和消耗國，而其餘八個國家的數字則低得多。

task1-bar-charts:5.english: It is also clear that output exceeded consumption in every country except Germany.
task1-bar-charts:5.chinese: 另一個明顯特徵是，除了德國之外，每個國家的電力產量都高於耗電量。

task1-bar-charts:5.english: China led the ranking, producing 5,398 billion kWh and consuming a marginally lower 5,322 billion kWh.
task1-bar-charts:5.chinese: 中國位居第一，電力產量為 5,398 十億千瓦時，耗電量則略低，為 5,322 十億千瓦時。

task1-bar-charts:5.english: The United States was second, at 4,099 billion kWh for production and 3,866 billion kWh for consumption; despite being well behind China, it remained far ahead of all other nations.
task1-bar-charts:5.chinese: 美國排名第二，電力產量為 4,099 十億千瓦時，耗電量為 3,866 十億千瓦時；雖然明顯落後於中國，但仍遠遠高於其他所有國家。

task1-bar-charts:5.english: Russia ranked third, generating 1,057 billion kWh and using 1,038 billion kWh, while Japan followed with 936.2 and 856.7 billion kWh, respectively.
task1-bar-charts:5.chinese: 俄羅斯排名第三，發電量為 1,057 十億千瓦時，用電量為 1,038 十億千瓦時；日本緊隨其後，生產和消耗分別為 936.2 和 856.7 十億千瓦時。

task1-bar-charts:5.english: In the remaining countries, the figures were much smaller.
task1-bar-charts:5.chinese: 在其餘國家中，相關數字要小得多。

task1-bar-charts:5.english: India produced 871 billion kWh but consumed only 698.8 billion kWh.
task1-bar-charts:5.chinese: 印度生產了 871 十億千瓦時的電力，但只消耗了 698.8 十億千瓦時。

task1-bar-charts:5.english: Canada, France and Brazil showed broadly similar patterns, each generating more electricity than it used, with production between 530.7 and 618.9 billion kWh.
task1-bar-charts:5.chinese: 加拿大、法國和巴西呈現大致相似的模式，三國的發電量都高於耗電量，而產量介乎 530.7 至 618.9 十億千瓦時之間。

task1-bar-charts:5.english: Germany was the only exception, consuming 582.5 billion kWh compared with output of 526.6 billion kWh.
task1-bar-charts:5.chinese: 德國是唯一例外，其耗電量為 582.5 十億千瓦時，高於 526.6 十億千瓦時的產量。

task1-bar-charts:5.english: South Korea had the lowest totals, at 485.1 and 449.5 billion kWh.
task1-bar-charts:5.chinese: 南韓的總量最低，產量和耗電量分別為 485.1 和 449.5 十億千瓦時。

task1-bar-charts:6.english: The bar chart compares the percentages of Australian men and women in six age groups who did regular physical activity in 2010.
task1-bar-charts:6.chinese: 這張柱狀圖比較了 2010 年澳洲男性和女性在六個年齡組中定期進行體育活動的百分比。

task1-bar-charts:6.english: Overall, women were more active than men in all age groups except 15–24.
task1-bar-charts:6.chinese: 整體而言，除了 15 至 24 歲組之外，女性在所有年齡組中都比男性更活躍。

task1-bar-charts:6.english: Male participation was highest among the youngest adults, then fell to a low in middle age before rising gradually, while the female figures remained relatively steady at around 48% to 53%.
task1-bar-charts:6.chinese: 男性參與率在最年輕的成年人中最高，之後下降至中年低點，然後逐漸回升；相比之下，女性數據則相對穩定，大約維持在 48% 至 53% 之間。

task1-bar-charts:6.english: In the 15–24 group, 52.8% of men exercised regularly, compared with 47.7% of women.
task1-bar-charts:6.chinese: 在 15 至 24 歲組中， 52.8% 的男性定期運動，而女性則為 47.7% 。

task1-bar-charts:6.english: The pattern then reversed: male participation dropped to 42.2% among 25- to 34-year-olds and reached its lowest point, 39.5%, in the 35–44 category.
task1-bar-charts:6.chinese: 之後，這一模式出現逆轉： 25 至 34 歲男性的參與率下降至 42.2% ，並在 35 至 44 歲組達到最低點，為 39.5% 。

task1-bar-charts:6.english: By contrast, the corresponding female rates rose from 48.9% to 52.5%, creating the largest gender gap, at 13 percentage points.
task1-bar-charts:6.chinese: 相比之下，相應的女性比率從 48.9% 上升至 52.5% ，形成了最大的性別差距，達13 個百分點。

task1-bar-charts:6.english: In the older age groups, the male figure recovered from 43.1% for those aged 45–54 to 45.1% among 55–64s and 46.7% among people aged 65 and over.
task1-bar-charts:6.chinese: 在較年長的年齡組中，男性數據有所回升： 45 至 54 歲組為 43.1% ， 55 至 64 歲組升至 45.1% ， 65 歲及以上組則達到 46.7% 。

task1-bar-charts:6.english: Women reached their peak in the 45–54 group, at 53.3%, and remained almost as high for 55–64s, at 53.0%.
task1-bar-charts:6.chinese: 女性在 45 至 54 歲組達到最高點，為 53.3% ；在 55 至 64 歲組中仍幾乎同樣高，為。

task1-bar-charts:6.english: In the oldest cohort, however, female participation fell to 47.1%, almost matching the male rate.
task1-bar-charts:6.chinese: 然而，在最年長的群體中，女性參與率下降至 47.1% ，幾乎與男性比率相同。

task1-bar-charts:7.english: The two bar charts compare the destinations of UK graduates and postgraduates who left college in 2008 but did not enter full-time employment.
task1-bar-charts:7.chinese: 這兩張柱狀圖比較了 2008 年英國大學畢業生和研究生離開學院後，在沒有進入全職工作的情況下所選擇的去向。

task1-bar-charts:7.english: Overall, further study was the most common route for both groups, whereas voluntary work attracted the fewest students.
task1-bar-charts:7.chinese: 整體而言，繼續深造是兩組學生最常見的去向，而從事志願工作的人數最少。

task1-bar-charts:7.english: Although the graduate figures were much higher in every category, the overall pattern was broadly similar.
task1-bar-charts:7.chinese: 雖然大學畢業生在每一個類別中人數都遠高於研究生，但整體模式大致相似。

task1-bar-charts:7.english: Among graduates, almost 30,000 continued their education, making further study the clear leading destination.
task1-bar-charts:7.chinese: 在大學畢業生中，接近 30,000 人繼續學業，使繼續深造成為明顯最多人選擇的去向。

task1-bar-charts:7.english: Part-time work came next, at 17,735, only slightly ahead of unemployment, which stood at 16,235.
task1-bar-charts:7.chinese: 兼職工作位居第二，有 17,735 人，只比失業人數 16,235 略高。

task1-bar-charts:7.english: By contrast, just 3,500 graduates chose voluntary work, less than a quarter of the number without a job and far below the total in further study.
task1-bar-charts:7.chinese: 相比之下，只有 3,500 名畢業生選擇志願工作，這還不到失業人數的四分之一，也遠低於繼續深造的人數。

task1-bar-charts:7.english: The same order was evident among postgraduates, though the numbers were smaller.
task1-bar-charts:7.chinese: 研究生中也呈現相同的排序，不過人數較少。

task1-bar-charts:7.english: Further study again ranked first, with 2,725 students, but it was only narrowly higher than part-time work, at 2,535.
task1-bar-charts:7.chinese: 繼續深造再次排名第一，有 2,725 人，但它只略高於兼職工作的 2,535 人。

task1-bar-charts:7.english: Unemployment involved 1,625 postgraduates, while voluntary work remained the least common option, at 345.
task1-bar-charts:7.chinese: 失業的研究生人數為 1,625 ，而志願工作仍然是最不常見的選項，只有 345 人。

task1-bar-charts:7.english: Across all four destinations, graduates outnumbered postgraduates substantially, especially in further study, where the difference exceeded 26,000.
task1-bar-charts:7.chinese: 在四個去向中，大學畢業生的人數都明顯多於研究生，尤其是在繼續深造方面，兩者差距超過 26,000 人。

task1-bar-charts:8.english: The bar chart compares the total duration of telephone calls made in the UK, measured in billions of minutes, across three categories between 1995 and 2002.
task1-bar-charts:8.chinese: 這張柱狀圖比較了 1995 年至 2002 年間英國三類電話通話的總時長，單位為十億分鐘。

task1-bar-charts:8.english: Overall, local fixed-line calls remained the largest category throughout, despite rising to a peak in the late 1990s and then returning to their initial level.
task1-bar-charts:8.chinese: 整體而言，本地固定電話通話在整段期間一直是最大類別，雖然其通話時長在 1990 年代末升至高點，之後又回到起初水平。

task1-bar-charts:8.english: By contrast, national and international fixed-line calls increased steadily, while mobile calls, though starting from a very low base, recorded by far the sharpest growth.
task1-bar-charts:8.chinese: 相比之下，國內及國際固定電話通話穩定上升；而流動電話通話雖然起點非常低，卻錄得遠遠最顯著的增長。

task1-bar-charts:8.english: In 1995, local fixed-line calls accounted for about 72 billion minutes, almost twice the figure for national and international calls, at roughly 37 billion.
task1-bar-charts:8.chinese: 在 1995 年，本地固定電話通話約佔 720 億分鐘，幾乎是國內及國際固定電話通話的兩倍，後者約為 370 億分鐘。

task1-bar-charts:8.english: The local category then climbed each year to around 90 billion minutes in 1998 and 1999, before falling back gradually to about 72 billion by 2002.
task1-bar-charts:8.chinese: 之後，本地通話類別逐年上升，在 1998 年和 1999 年達到約 900 億分鐘，然後逐步回落，到 2002 年降至約 720 億分鐘。

task1-bar-charts:8.english: The other two categories both followed upward trends.
task1-bar-charts:8.chinese: 其餘兩個類別都呈現上升趨勢。

task1-bar-charts:8.english: National and international fixed-line calls rose consistently from approximately 37 billion minutes in 1995 to just over 60 billion in 2002.
task1-bar-charts:8.chinese: 國內及國際固定電話通話由 1995 年的約 370 億分鐘穩定上升至 2002 年的略高於 600 億分鐘。

task1-bar-charts:8.english: Mobile calls showed a much more dramatic pattern: after increasing only modestly from about 3 to 12 billion minutes between 1995 and 1999, they surged to roughly 25 billion in 2000 and reached around 45 billion by the final year.
task1-bar-charts:8.chinese: 流動電話通話則呈現更加顯著的變化：在 1995 年至 1999 年間，它只由約 30 億分鐘溫和上升至 120 億分鐘，但在 2000 年急升至約 250 億分鐘，並在最後一年達到約 450 億分鐘。

task1-line-graph:1.english: The line graph illustrates the number of participants in five activities at a social centre in Melbourne, Australia, from 2000 to 2020.
task1-line-graph:1.chinese: 這張折線圖說明了澳洲墨爾本一所社交中心在 2000 年至 2020 年間五項活動的參加人數。

task1-line-graph:1.english: Overall, the film club remained the leading activity throughout, despite minor fluctuations.
task1-line-graph:1.chinese: 整體而言，電影俱樂部雖然有輕微波動，但在整個期間一直是參加人數最多的活動。

task1-line-graph:1.english: Table tennis recorded by far the most dramatic growth and became second by 2020, whereas amateur dramatics declined after a brief rise and finished as the least popular option.
task1-line-graph:1.chinese: 乒乓球的增長幅度明顯最大，並在 2020 年成為第二受歡迎的活動；相反，業餘戲劇在短暫上升後下跌，最後成為最不受歡迎的選項。

task1-line-graph:1.english: In 2000, around 65 people attended the film club, compared with 36 for martial arts and 26 for amateur dramatics.
task1-line-graph:1.chinese: 在 2000 年，約有 65 人參加電影俱樂部，相比之下，武術約有 36 人，而業餘戲劇約有 26 人。

task1-line-graph:1.english: The film club then dipped slightly to 60 in 2010 before recovering to about 66 at the end of the period.
task1-line-graph:1.chinese: 之後，電影俱樂部的人數在 2010 年小幅下降至 60 人，然後在期末回升至約 66人。

task1-line-graph:1.english: Martial arts showed no clear long-term change: after falling to 32 in 2005, it rose to 38 in 2010 and ended close to its starting point, at roughly 36.
task1-line-graph:1.chinese: 武術沒有明顯的長期變化：它在 2005 年跌至 32 人後，於 2010 年升至 38 人，最後以約 36 人結束，接近起點水平。

task1-line-graph:1.english: The remaining activities changed more noticeably.
task1-line-graph:1.chinese: 其餘活動的變化則更加明顯。

task1-line-graph:1.english: Table tennis increased only modestly from 16 to 20 participants between 2000 and 2010, but then climbed sharply to 35 in 2015 and approximately 54 in 2020.
task1-line-graph:1.chinese: 乒乓球在 2000 年至 2010 年間只從 16 人小幅增加至 20 人，但之後迅速上升，在2015 年達到 35 人，並在 2020 年達到約 54 人。

task1-line-graph:1.english: Musical performances, which had no participants in the first two years shown, rose gradually to 18.
task1-line-graph:1.chinese: 音樂表演在圖中最初兩個年份沒有參加者，但之後逐漸上升至 18 人。

task1-line-graph:1.english: By contrast, amateur dramatics fell from a peak of 28 in 2005 to just 6 by 2020.
task1-line-graph:1.chinese: 相比之下，業餘戲劇從 2005 年的峰值 28 人下降至 2020 年的僅 6 人。

task1-line-graph:2.english: The line graph compares the percentage of people living in cities in the Philippines, Malaysia, Thailand and Indonesia from 1970 to 2020, with forecasts to 2040.
task1-line-graph:2.chinese: 這張折線圖比較了 1970 年至 2020 年間菲律賓、馬來西亞、泰國和印尼城市人口所佔百分比，並附有到 2040 年的預測。

task1-line-graph:2.english: Overall, all four countries became more urbanised.
task1-line-graph:2.chinese: 整體而言，四個國家的城市化程度都提高了。

task1-line-graph:2.english: Malaysia became and is expected to remain the clear leader, while Indonesia climbed sharply from the lowest position to second place.
task1-line-graph:2.chinese: 馬來西亞已成為明顯領先者，並預計會保持這個位置；與此同時，印尼則從最低位置大幅上升至第二位。

task1-line-graph:2.english: By contrast, the Philippines fluctuated, and Thailand grew more slowly, becoming the least urbanised country from 2010 onwards.
task1-line-graph:2.chinese: 相比之下，菲律賓的數據有所波動，而泰國增長較慢，從 2010 年起成為城市化比例最低的國家。

task1-line-graph:2.english: In 1970, the Philippines led slightly, at just over 30%, compared with about 30% in Malaysia.
task1-line-graph:2.chinese: 在 1970 年，菲律賓以略高於 30% 的城市人口比例小幅領先，而馬來西亞約為。

task1-line-graph:2.english: The Philippine figure reached nearly 50% in 1990, then declined to just above 40% in 2010, before recovering to roughly 46% in 2020; it is projected to rise to about 56% by 2040.
task1-line-graph:2.chinese: 菲律賓的數據在 1990 年達到接近 50% ，之後在 2010 年下降至略高於 40% ，再於2020 年回升至約 46% ；預計到 2040 年將升至約 56% 。

task1-line-graph:2.english: Malaysia, however, climbed steadily from around 30% to 60% between 1970 and 2000, and is forecast to exceed 80% by the end.
task1-line-graph:2.chinese: 然而，馬來西亞從 1970 年的約 30% 穩步上升至 2000 年的 60% ，並預計在最後一年超過 80% 。

task1-line-graph:2.english: Indonesia began at only about 13%, but rose continuously, equalling the Philippines at around 43% in 2010 and reaching just over 50% in 2020.
task1-line-graph:2.chinese: 印尼的起點只有約 13% ，但其比例持續上升，在 2010 年以約 43% 追平菲律賓，並於 2020 年達到略高於 50% 。

task1-line-graph:2.english: It should climb further to the mid-60s, whereas Thailand is expected to grow from just above 30% in 2020 to 50% in 2040.
task1-line-graph:2.chinese: 預計印尼會進一步升至 60 多 % 的中段，而泰國則預計會從 2020 年的略高於30% 升至 2040 年的 50% 。

task1-line-graph:3.english: The line graph illustrates month-on-month percentage changes in the prices of copper, nickel and zinc in 2014.
task1-line-graph:3.chinese: 這張折線圖說明了 2014 年銅、鎳和鋅價格相對上個月的百分比變化。

task1-line-graph:3.english: Overall, nickel was the most volatile metal, starting with the strongest rise but later recording the steepest fall.
task1-line-graph:3.chinese: 整體而言，鎳是波動最大的金屬，年初錄得最強升幅，但之後又出現最大跌幅。

task1-line-graph:3.english: Copper changed more modestly, whereas zinc ended the year with the highest monthly change.
task1-line-graph:3.chinese: 銅的變化較為溫和；相反，鋅在年底錄得最高的月度變化。

task1-line-graph:3.english: All three metals weakened around mid-year before recovering in November and December.
task1-line-graph:3.chinese: 三種金屬都在年中附近走弱，然後在 11 月和 12 月回升。

task1-line-graph:3.english: At the beginning of the year, nickel rose by about 6%, compared with 2% for copper and 1% for zinc.
task1-line-graph:3.chinese: 年初，鎳上升約 6% ，相比之下，銅和鋅分別上升約 2% 和 1% 。

task1-line-graph:3.english: In February, nickel remained high at roughly 4%, while zinc peaked at 3%.
task1-line-graph:3.chinese: 2 月，鎳仍維持在約 4% 的高位，而鋅則達到 3% 的高峰。

task1-line-graph:3.english: After this, the figures for all three metals fell steadily: by May, nickel and zinc had dropped to around 0.5% and 1% respectively, while copper had slipped to about -0.5%.
task1-line-graph:3.chinese: 此後，三種金屬的數字都穩步下降：到 5 月，鎳和鋅分別跌至約 0.5% 和 1% ，而銅則下滑至約 -0.5% 。

task1-line-graph:3.english: June was the clear low point.
Nickel plunged to approximately -3%, far below zinc at -1% and copper at about -0.5%.
task1-line-graph:3.chinese: 鎳急跌至約 -3% ，遠低於鋅的 -1% 和銅的約 -0.5% 。

task1-line-graph:3.english: From July to September, copper recovered to around 1%, whereas nickel stayed at -1% and zinc hovered near -0.5%.
task1-line-graph:3.chinese: 從 7 月到 9 月，銅回升至約 1% ；相反，鎳維持在 -1% ，而鋅則徘徊在約 -0.5% 。

task1-line-graph:3.english: In October, nickel slipped again to -2%, but by December all three were positive, with zinc at 2%, copper at around 1.5% and nickel at 1%.
task1-line-graph:3.chinese: 10 月，鎳再次下滑至 -2% ；但到 12 月，三種金屬都回到正值，其中鋅為 2% ，銅約為 1.5% ，鎳為 1% 。

task1-line-graph:4.english: The line graph compares the numbers of shop closures and openings in one country from 2011 to 2018.
task1-line-graph:4.chinese: 這張折線圖比較了某一國家在 2011 年至 2018 年間商店關閉和新開商店的數量。

task1-line-graph:4.english: Overall, shop openings showed a clear downward trend, ending at their lowest point, while closures fluctuated markedly.
task1-line-graph:4.chinese: 整體而言，新開商店數量呈現明顯下降趨勢，並在最後達到最低點；相反，關店數量則大幅波動。

task1-line-graph:4.english: Apart from the initial year and the exceptional trough in closures in 2015, more shops closed than opened.
task1-line-graph:4.chinese: 除第一年以及 2015 年關店數出現異常低谷之外，關閉的商店數量多於新開商店數量。

task1-line-graph:4.english: In 2011, openings were far higher, at about 8,500, compared with roughly 6,400 closures.
task1-line-graph:4.chinese: 2011 年，新開商店數量遠高於關店數，約為 8,500 間，而關店數約為 6,400 間。

task1-line-graph:4.english: The number of new shops then almost halved to around 4,000 in 2012, before recovering to about 5,000 in 2013 and just over 6,000 in 2014.
task1-line-graph:4.chinese: 之後，新開商店數量在 2012 年幾乎減半至約 4,000 間，然後在 2013 年回升至約5,000 間，並在 2014 年升至略高於 6,000 間。

task1-line-graph:4.english: After this brief rebound, openings fell back to 4,000 in 2015 and 2016, edged up slightly to around 4,200 in 2017, and then declined to approximately 3,000 in 2018.
task1-line-graph:4.chinese: 在這次短暫回升之後，新開商店數量在 2015 年和 2016 年回落至 4,000 間， 2017年小幅上升至約 4,200 間，然後在 2018 年下降至約 3,000 間。

task1-line-graph:4.english: Closures followed a less steady pattern.
task1-line-graph:4.chinese: 關店數量的走勢則較不穩定。

task1-line-graph:4.english: The figure slipped from around 6,400 to just under 6,000 in 2012, then rose to a peak of about 7,200 in 2013.
task1-line-graph:4.chinese: 該數字從約 6,400 間下降至 2012 年的略低於 6,000 間，之後在 2013 年上升至約7,200 間的高峰。

task1-line-graph:4.english: It remained high in 2014, at roughly 6,500, before plunging to only about 500 in 2015.
task1-line-graph:4.chinese: 2014 年，關店數仍然維持在較高水平，約為 6,500 間，然後在 2015 年急跌至只有約 500 間。

task1-line-graph:4.english: However, closures rebounded sharply to just over 5,000 in 2016 and then stayed close to this level in the final two years.
task1-line-graph:4.chinese: 然而，關店數在 2016 年大幅反彈至略高於 5,000 間，之後在最後兩年保持在接近這一水平。

task1-line-graph:5.english: The two line charts illustrate changes in the proportion of households owning three electrical appliances and the average time spent on housework each week in one country from 1920 to 2019.
task1-line-graph:5.chinese: 這兩張折線圖說明了 1920 年至 2019 年間，某一國家家庭擁有三種電器的比例變化，以及每週平均花在家務上的時間變化。

task1-line-graph:5.english: Overall, ownership of all three appliances increased, with refrigerators and vacuum cleaners becoming almost universal by the end of the period.
task1-line-graph:5.chinese: 整體而言，三種電器的擁有率均有所上升，其中雪櫃和吸塵機到期末時幾乎已普及到所有家庭。

task1-line-graph:5.english: Meanwhile, weekly housework fell markedly, from 50 hours to only 10.
task1-line-graph:5.chinese: 與此同時，每週家務時間大幅下降，從 50 小時減少至僅 10 小時。

task1-line-graph:5.english: In 1920, washing machines were the most common appliance, at around 40%, compared with 30% for vacuum cleaners and almost no refrigerator ownership.
task1-line-graph:5.chinese: 在 1920 年，洗衣機是最常見的電器，約有 40% 的家庭擁有；相比之下，吸塵機的擁有率為 30% ，而幾乎沒有家庭擁有雪櫃。

task1-line-graph:5.english: The refrigerator then recorded the sharpest growth, rising to about 55% in 1940 and 90% in 1960, before reaching full ownership in 1980.
task1-line-graph:5.chinese: 之後，雪櫃的增長最為顯著，擁有率在 1940 年升至約 55% ， 1960 年升至 90% ，並在 1980 年達到完全普及。

task1-line-graph:5.english: Vacuum cleaners increased more steadily, climbing from 30% to 70% between 1920 and 1960 and reaching 100% by 2000.
task1-line-graph:5.chinese: 吸塵機的擁有率則以較穩定的方式上升，從 1920 年的 30% 增至 1960 年的 70% ，並在 2000 年達到 100% 。

task1-line-graph:5.english: By contrast, washing machines grew more modestly, from 40% to 70% in 1960, dipped to roughly 65% in 1980, and then recovered to about 75% in 2019.
task1-line-graph:5.chinese: 相比之下，洗衣機的增長較為溫和，從 1920 年的 40% 升至 1960 年的 70% ，其後在 1980 年下降至約 65% ，最後在 2019 年回升至約 75% 。

task1-line-graph:5.english: The second chart shows an opposite pattern.
task1-line-graph:5.chinese: 第二張圖顯示出相反的趨勢。

task1-line-graph:5.english: Housework declined from 50 hours per week in 1920 to 35 in 1940, then fell further to 20 by 1960.
task1-line-graph:5.chinese: 每週家務時間從 1920 年的 50 小時下降至 1940 年的 35 小時，然後到 1960 年進一步下降至 20 小時。

task1-line-graph:5.english: Thereafter, the decrease was slower, reaching 15 hours in 1980 and 2000, before dropping to 10 in 2019.
task1-line-graph:5.chinese: 此後，下降速度放緩，在 1980 年和 2000 年達到 15 小時，最後在 2019 年降至 10 小時。

task1-line-graph:6.english: The line graph illustrates tourist numbers on a Caribbean island between 2010 and 2017, separating visitors who stayed on cruise ships from those accommodated on the island.
task1-line-graph:6.chinese: 這張折線圖說明了 2010 年至 2017 年間前往某個加勒比海島嶼的遊客人數，並區分了住在遊輪上的遊客和住在島上的遊客。

task1-line-graph:6.english: Overall, total arrivals rose substantially, more than tripling across the period.
task1-line-graph:6.chinese: 整體而言，總到訪人數在整段期間大幅上升，增加了超過三倍。

task1-line-graph:6.english: Island-based tourists were the larger group at first, but cruise passengers grew much faster and had become the leading category by 2017.
task1-line-graph:6.chinese: 起初，住在島上的遊客是較大的群體，但遊輪遊客增長得更快，並在 2017 年成為主要類別。

task1-line-graph:6.english: In 2010, the island attracted 1 million visitors, about three quarters of whom stayed on the island.
task1-line-graph:6.chinese: 2010 年，該島吸引了 100 萬名遊客，其中約四分之三住在島上。

task1-line-graph:6.english: This total rose steadily to 2 million in 2013, when island-based tourists reached 1.5 million.
task1-line-graph:6.chinese: 到 2013 年，總遊客人數穩步上升至 200 萬，而當時住在島上的遊客達到 150 萬。

task1-line-graph:6.english: Over the same early period, the cruise-ship figure moved unevenly, increasing from 250,000 to 500,000 in 2011 before falling back to 250,000 in 2012.
task1-line-graph:6.chinese: 在同一前期階段，遊輪遊客人數變化不太穩定，先從 25 萬上升至 2011 年的 50萬，然後在 2012 年回落至 25 萬。

task1-line-graph:6.english: From 2014 onwards, cruise passengers became the main driver of growth.
task1-line-graph:6.chinese: 從 2014 年起，遊輪遊客成為推動增長的主要因素。

task1-line-graph:6.english: Their number climbed from 1 million in 2014 to 1.5 million in 2016, overtaking the island-based group, before reaching 2 million in 2017.
task1-line-graph:6.chinese: 其人數從 2014 年的 100 萬上升至 2016 年的 150 萬，超過了住在島上的遊客，並在 2017 年達到 200 萬。

task1-line-graph:6.english: By contrast, tourists staying on the island remained close to 1.5 million after 2013, except for a slight fall in 2016.
task1-line-graph:6.chinese: 相比之下， 2013 年之後，住在島上的遊客人數大致維持在接近 150 萬的水平，只是在 2016 年略有下降。

task1-line-graph:6.english: Consequently, total arrivals plateaued at around 2.75 million in 2015 and 2016, then rose sharply to 3.5 million.
task1-line-graph:6.chinese: 因此，總到訪人數在 2015 年和 2016 年停留在約 275 萬，隨後急升至 350 萬。

task1-line-graph:7.english: The line graph compares average carbon dioxide emissions per person in the United Kingdom, Sweden, Italy and Portugal from 1967 to 2007, measured in metric tonnes.
task1-line-graph:7.chinese: 該折線圖比較了 1967 年至 2007 年間英國、瑞典、義大利和葡萄牙的人均二氧化碳排放量，單位為公噸。

task1-line-graph:7.english: Overall, the United Kingdom remained the highest emitter throughout, although its figure declined gradually.
task1-line-graph:7.chinese: 整體而言，英國在整段期間一直是人均排放量最高的國家，儘管其數字逐漸下降。

task1-line-graph:7.english: Sweden also ended lower than it began after reaching a peak in the late 1970s, whereas Italy and Portugal recorded steady growth, with Italy ranking second by 2007.
task1-line-graph:7.chinese: 瑞典在 1970 年代末達到高峰後，最終排放量低於起點；相反，義大利和葡萄牙均穩定上升，其中義大利到 2007 年排名第二。

task1-line-graph:7.english: In 1967, the UK produced just under 11 tonnes per person, compared with about 8.7 tonnes in Sweden.
task1-line-graph:7.chinese: 1967 年，英國人均二氧化碳排放量略低於 11 公噸，而瑞典約為 8.7 公噸。

task1-line-graph:7.english: Sweden then rose to just over 10 tonnes in 1977, almost matching the UK, before falling markedly to around 7 tonnes in 1987 and then to approximately 5.5 tonnes by the final year.
task1-line-graph:7.chinese: 瑞典隨後在 1977 年升至略高於 10 公噸，幾乎追平英國，之後在 1987 年大幅下降至約 7 公噸，並在最後一年降至約 5.5 公噸。

task1-line-graph:7.english: The UK followed a gentler downward path, slipping from nearly 11 tonnes to about 8.7 tonnes over the same period.
task1-line-graph:7.chinese: 英國則呈現較溫和的下降趨勢，在同一期間由接近 11 公噸降至約 8.7 公噸。

task1-line-graph:7.english: By contrast, Italy climbed from roughly 4.2 tonnes in 1967 to about 6.3 tonnes in 1977, and then increased further to around 7.7 tonnes in 1997, where it levelled off.
task1-line-graph:7.chinese: 相比之下，義大利的人均排放量從 1967 年的約 4.2 公噸上升至 1977 年的約 6.3 公噸，之後進一步升至 1997 年的約 7.7 公噸，並在此後趨於平穩。

task1-line-graph:7.english: Portugal, initially the lowest at just over 1 tonne, rose steadily to about 5.5 tonnes in 2007, almost converging with Sweden.
task1-line-graph:7.chinese: 葡萄牙起初最低，略高於 1 公噸，但到 2007 年穩定上升至約 5.5 公噸，幾乎與瑞典匯合。

task1-line-graph:8.english: The line graph illustrates the amount of energy consumed in the United States from six fuel sources between 1980 and 2030, measured in quadrillion units, with later figures projected.
task1-line-graph:8.chinese: 該折線圖說明了 1980 年至 2030 年間美國六種燃料來源的能源消耗量，單位為千萬億單位，後期數據為預測值。

task1-line-graph:8.english: Overall, petrol and oil remained, and are expected to remain, the dominant fuel source.
task1-line-graph:8.chinese: 整體而言，汽油和石油一直是、並預計仍將是最主要的燃料來源。

task1-line-graph:8.english: Coal and natural gas formed a second tier, though coal is projected to overtake gas after about 2015, while nuclear, solar/wind and hydropower accounted for only small amounts throughout.
task1-line-graph:8.chinese: 煤和天然氣構成第二梯隊，不過煤預計在約 2015 年後超越天然氣；相反，核能、太陽能／風能和水電在整段期間的消耗量都很小。

task1-line-graph:8.english: In 1980, petrol and oil consumption stood at around 35 quadrillion units, compared with about 20 for natural gas and 16 for coal.
task1-line-graph:8.chinese: 1980 年，汽油和石油的消耗量約為 35 千萬億單位，相比之下，天然氣約為 20 ，煤約為 16 。

task1-line-graph:8.english: After dipping to just over 30 in the mid-1980s, petrol and oil rose steadily, reaching roughly 40 by 2005 and a projected 49 by 2030.
task1-line-graph:8.chinese: 在 1980 年代中期下降至略高於 30 後，汽油和石油的消耗量穩步上升，到 2005年達到約 40 ，並預計到 2030 年達到 49 。

task1-line-graph:8.english: Coal followed a gentler upward path, increasing to about 22 in the mid-1990s, remaining close to that level for several years, and then rising to approximately 32 by the end.
task1-line-graph:8.chinese: 煤的上升趨勢較為溫和，在 1990 年代中期增至約 22 ，之後數年保持在接近該水平，最後升至約 32 。

task1-line-graph:8.english: Natural gas fluctuated around the low twenties before leveling off at about 25 from 2015 onwards.
task1-line-graph:8.chinese: 天然氣在二十出頭的水平附近波動，之後從 2015 年起穩定在約 25 。

task1-line-graph:8.english: The remaining fuels were much less significant.
task1-line-graph:8.chinese: 其餘燃料的消耗量明顯小得多。

task1-line-graph:8.english: Nuclear power climbed gradually from around 4 to about 8–9 units.
task1-line-graph:8.chinese: 核能由約 4 逐漸上升至約 8 至 9 個單位。

task1-line-graph:8.english: Solar/wind also rose modestly to around 6, whereas hydropower fluctuated slightly and finished at roughly 4.
task1-line-graph:8.chinese: 太陽能／風能也溫和上升至約 6 ；相反，水電只是輕微波動，最後約為 4 。

task1-line-graph:9.english: The line graph illustrates the volume of goods transported in the UK by road, water, rail and pipeline between 1974 and 2002.
task1-line-graph:9.chinese: 該折線圖說明了 1974 年至 2002 年間，英國透過公路、水路、鐵路和管道運輸的貨物量。

task1-line-graph:9.english: Overall, road was consistently the dominant mode and recorded the largest increase.
task1-line-graph:9.chinese: 整體而言，公路運輸一直是最主要的運輸方式，並錄得最大的絕對增幅。

task1-line-graph:9.english: Water transport also rose considerably, whereas rail fluctuated and finished only slightly above its initial level.
task1-line-graph:9.chinese: 水路運輸也有明顯上升；相反，鐵路運輸有所波動，最後只略高於最初水平。

task1-line-graph:9.english: Pipeline remained the least-used method, despite steady growth.
task1-line-graph:9.chinese: 儘管管道運輸穩定增長，但它始終是使用量最低的運輸方式。

task1-line-graph:9.english: In 1974, road haulage stood at about 70 million tonnes, compared with roughly 38 million by water and 40 million by rail.
task1-line-graph:9.chinese: 在 1974 年，公路貨運量約為 7,000 萬噸，相比之下，水路約為 3,800 萬噸，鐵路約為 4,000 萬噸。

task1-line-graph:9.english: After a slight rise in 1978 and a dip in 1982, the road figure climbed to just over 80 million tonnes in 1990.
task1-line-graph:9.chinese: 在 1978 年小幅上升、 1982 年回落之後，公路運輸量在 1990 年升至略高於 8,000萬噸。

task1-line-graph:9.english: It then fell marginally in 1994 before rising sharply to almost 100 million tonnes by 2002.
task1-line-graph:9.chinese: 隨後，它在 1994 年略微下降，之後大幅上升，到 2002 年接近 1 億噸。

task1-line-graph:9.english: Water followed a gentler upward trend.
task1-line-graph:9.chinese: 水路運輸呈現較溫和的上升趨勢。

task1-line-graph:9.english: Its volume increased from just under 40 million tonnes to around 55 million in 1982, stayed near this level until 1994, dipped in 1998, and then recovered to approximately 65 million tonnes.
task1-line-graph:9.chinese: 其運輸量從略低於 4,000 萬噸上升至 1982 年的約 5,500 萬噸，並一直維持在接近這一水平直到 1994 年，之後在 1998 年下降，最後回升至約 6,500 萬噸。

task1-line-graph:9.english: By contrast, rail dropped to around 30 million tonnes in 1986 and, despite another dip in 1994, recovered to just over 40 by the end.
task1-line-graph:9.chinese: 相比之下，鐵路運輸量在 1986 年下降至約 3,000 萬噸；儘管它在 1994 年再次下跌，但到最後回升至略高於 4,000 萬噸。

task1-line-graph:9.english: Pipeline transport rose steadily from about 5 to slightly above 20 million tonnes.
task1-line-graph:9.chinese: 管道運輸量則從約 500 萬噸穩定上升至略高於 2,000 萬噸。

task1-maps:1.english: The two plans illustrate the layout of Beechwood Farm in 1950 and the arrangement of the same site today.
task1-maps:1.chinese: 這兩張平面圖展示了比奇伍德農場在 1950 年的佈局，以及同一地點現今的安排。

task1-maps:1.english: Overall, the farm has been transformed from a mainly agricultural site into a more diversified complex.
task1-maps:1.chinese: 整體而言，該農場已由一個主要用於農業的地點，轉變成一個功能更多元化的綜合場地。

task1-maps:1.english: The river, main road, farmhouse, chicken enclosure and three crop areas have been retained, whereas the sheep field and basic tracks have given way to roads, visitor facilities and solar panels.
task1-maps:1.chinese: 河流、主要道路、農舍、雞舍和三個種植區都被保留下來；相反，原本的羊群牧場和簡單小徑則已被道路、遊客設施和太陽能板取代。

task1-maps:1.english: In 1950, the western half was used for crops: fruit trees lay in the northwest, with soft fruits and vegetables in adjacent plots to the south.
task1-maps:1.chinese: 在 1950 年，西半部主要用作種植農作物：果樹位於西北部，而漿果類作物和蔬菜則分別位於其南面的相鄰地塊。

task1-maps:1.english: A large sheep field occupied most of the north-eastern area.
task1-maps:1.chinese: 一大片羊群牧場佔據了東北部的大部分地方。

task1-maps:1.english: Access was provided only by tracks, one running from the main road towards the barn and another leading to the farmhouse.
task1-maps:1.chinese: 當時的通道只由小徑提供，其中一條由主要道路通往穀倉，另一條則通向農舍。

task1-maps:1.english: The farmhouse stood in the southeast, just above the chickens and inside the bend of the river.
task1-maps:1.chinese: 農舍位於東南部，正好在雞舍上方，並坐落於河流彎曲處的內側。

task1-maps:1.english: Today, the crop plots remain in similar positions, but a farm shop and car park have been added near the entrance.
task1-maps:1.chinese: 現今，農作物地塊仍大致保留在相似的位置，但入口附近新增了一間農場商店和一個停車場。

task1-maps:1.english: The former sheep pasture is now divided between a camping field and a solar-panel area, with another car park nearby.
task1-maps:1.chinese: 昔日的羊群牧場現在被分成露營地和太陽能板區，附近還設有另一個停車場。

task1-maps:1.english: In the east, holiday cottages have been built above the farmhouse, while the barn has been moved south-west.
task1-maps:1.chinese: 在東部，度假小屋已建於農舍上方，而穀倉則被移至西南方向。

task1-maps:2.english: The two plans illustrate how Porth Harbour has changed since 2000.
task1-maps:2.chinese: 這兩幅平面圖展示了 Porth Harbour 自 2000 年以來的變化。

task1-maps:2.english: Overall, the harbour has become more developed and visitor-oriented.
task1-maps:2.chinese: 整體而言，這個港口變得更加發達，也更以遊客為導向。

task1-maps:2.english: The main changes are the addition of hotel and commercial facilities, the creation of a private beach, the expansion of the dock area, and the relocation of the marina and fishing boats.
task1-maps:2.chinese: 主要變化包括新增酒店和商業設施、設立私人海灘、擴建碼頭區，以及搬遷私人遊艇碼頭和漁船停泊區。

task1-maps:2.english: On the western side, the two car parks and the main road are still in place, and the original showers and toilets have been retained beside the northern car park.
task1-maps:2.chinese: 在西面，兩個停車場和主路仍然保留，而原有的淋浴間和洗手間也保留在北面停車場旁邊。

task1-maps:2.english: However, the marina for private yachts, formerly in the north-west basin, has been moved southwards to the area once used by fishing boats.
task1-maps:2.chinese: 然而，原本位於西北面水域的私人遊艇碼頭，已經向南遷移到原本停泊漁船的區域。

task1-maps:2.english: These boats now occupy the former marina site.
task1-maps:2.chinese: 這些漁船現在則停泊在原本私人遊艇碼頭所在的位置。

task1-maps:2.english: A second block of showers and toilets has been built near the lower car park, while cafés and shops have been added west of the lifeboat station.
task1-maps:2.chinese: 另一座淋浴間和洗手間已在較南面的停車場附近建成，而咖啡店和商店則新增在救生艇站的西面。

task1-maps:2.english: Further east, the dock has been enlarged with extra mooring space, although the passenger ferries remain nearby.
task1-maps:2.chinese: 再往東面，碼頭已經擴建，並增加了停泊空間，不過客運渡輪仍停留在附近。

task1-maps:2.english: The disused castle on the small peninsula has been replaced by a hotel, accessed by an extended road.
task1-maps:2.chinese: 小半島上原本廢棄的城堡已被一間酒店取代，而該酒店可通過延伸道路到達。

task1-maps:2.english: The southern beach is now reserved for hotel guests, whereas the northern public beach and lifeboat station remain largely unchanged.
task1-maps:2.chinese: 南面的海灘現在只供酒店住客使用；相反，北面的公共海灘和救生艇站則大致保持不變。

task1-maps:3.english: The two plans illustrate how the Central Library has been reorganised over the last two decades.
task1-maps:3.chinese: 這兩張平面圖說明中央圖書館在過去二十年間如何被重新規劃。

task1-maps:3.english: Overall, the library has changed from a mainly book- and reading-based space into a more varied facility, with new areas for technology, events, lectures and refreshments.
task1-maps:3.chinese: 整體而言，該圖書館已經從一個主要以藏書和閱讀為主的空間，轉變成一個功能更為多元的設施，新增了科技、活動、講座和餐飲相關區域。

task1-maps:3.english: Although the entrance remains in the same position, the central seating has disappeared and several services have been relocated or modernised.
task1-maps:3.chinese: 雖然入口仍在相同位置，但中央座位區已經消失，而多項服務已被重新安置或現代化。

task1-maps:3.english: Twenty years ago, the middle of the library was occupied by tables and chairs, with rooms arranged around it.
task1-maps:3.chinese: 二十年前，圖書館中央設有桌椅，周圍則分布著不同房間。

task1-maps:3.english: On the left, there was a media room for CDs, videos and computer games in the north-west corner, adult fiction books in the centre, and a reading room for newspapers and magazines near the entrance.
task1-maps:3.chinese: 在左側，西北角有一個供放置 CDs 、錄像和電腦遊戲的媒體室，中部是成人小說書籍區，靠近入口處則是供閱讀報紙和雜誌的閱覽室。

task1-maps:3.english: Today, this side has been fully reorganised: the former media and fiction sections contain children’s fiction books, storytelling space and sofas, while the old reading room has become a computer room.
task1-maps:3.chinese: 如今，這一側已被完全重新規劃：原來的媒體室和成人小說區變成兒童小說書籍區、講故事活動空間和沙發區，而舊閱覽室則變成電腦室。

task1-maps:3.english: A section for all reference books has also been introduced.
task1-maps:3.chinese: 此外，圖書館亦新增了一個全部參考書區。

task1-maps:3.english: On the right, the old children’s books area has been replaced by a lecture room.
task1-maps:3.chinese: 在右側，舊兒童書籍區已被講座室取代。

task1-maps:3.english: The former adult non-fiction section now houses adult fiction, an information desk and self-service machines, whereas the old enquiry desk has been converted into a café.
task1-maps:3.chinese: 原本的成人非小說書籍區現在設有成人小說、資訊服務台和自助服務機，而舊詢問處則已被改建成咖啡館。

task1-maps:4.english: The two maps compare the present industrial area in Norbiton with the proposed redevelopment of the site.
task1-maps:4.chinese: 這兩幅地圖比較了諾比頓目前的工業區與該地點擬議的未來重建規劃。

task1-maps:4.english: Overall, the area is set to be transformed from a factory complex into a residential district with public amenities.
task1-maps:4.chinese: 整體而言，該區域將由一個工廠群轉變為設有公共設施的住宅區。

task1-maps:4.english: The road network will also be expanded, especially northwards across the river and southwards to the main road, while the river and the main east–west road will largely remain in place.
task1-maps:4.chinese: 道路網也將會擴展，尤其會向北跨過河流，並向南連接主要道路；同時，河流和主要東西向道路大致會保留在原位。

task1-maps:4.english: Currently, the site is centred on a roundabout south of the river.
task1-maps:4.chinese: 目前，該地點以河流以南的一個迴旋處為中心。

task1-maps:4.english: From this junction, one road runs east, with several factories on both sides and another at its far end.
task1-maps:4.chinese: 從這個交匯處，一條道路向東延伸，道路兩側有數間工廠，最東端還有另一間工廠。

task1-maps:4.english: Other factories stand immediately north and west of the roundabout, and a short road links the junction to the main east–west road.
task1-maps:4.chinese: 其他工廠位於迴旋處正北方和西側，而一條短路把這個交匯處連接到主要的東西向道路。

task1-maps:4.english: The town lies to the west.
In the future plan, all factories will be removed and replaced mainly by housing.
task1-maps:4.chinese: 在未來規劃中，所有工廠都將被移除，並主要由住宅取代。

task1-maps:4.english: Homes will be added west of the roundabout, along the eastern road and, after a bridge is built, north of the river.
task1-maps:4.chinese: 住宅將會被增設在迴旋處西側、東面道路沿線，及在橋樑建成後的河流北側。

task1-maps:4.english: A second roundabout will be constructed on the southern access road.
task1-maps:4.chinese: 第二個迴旋處將會建在南面的通道上。

task1-maps:4.english: Shops, a medical centre, a playground and a school will also be introduced in the southern, eastern and northeastern parts of the site.
task1-maps:4.chinese: 商店、醫療中心、遊樂場和學校也將分別被引入該地點南部、東部和東北部。

task1-maps:5.english: The two plans illustrate the current layout of Southwest Airport and the way it is expected to look after redevelopment next year.
task1-maps:5.chinese: 這兩張平面圖展示了 Southwest Airport 現時的布局，以及它預計在明年重新發展後的樣貌。

task1-maps:5.english: Overall, the airport will be substantially enlarged, especially airside, where the existing pier with eight gates will be replaced by a Y-shaped concourse containing eighteen gates and a sky train.
task1-maps:5.chinese: 整體而言，該機場將會大幅擴建，尤其是在空側區域；現有設有八個登機閘口的登機廊將被一個 Y 形候機大廳取代，當中會有十八個登機閘口和一條空中列車。

task1-maps:5.english: The terminal will also offer more passenger facilities, although its basic division into departures and arrivals will remain.
task1-maps:5.chinese: 航站樓亦會提供更多乘客服務設施，不過其基本的離境和入境分區將會保留。

task1-maps:5.english: At present, the airport has a small terminal, with departures on the left and arrivals on the right.
task1-maps:5.chinese: 目前，該機場有一個較小的航站樓，離境區位於左邊，入境區位於右邊。

task1-maps:5.english: Departing passengers pass through security and passport control before using a walkway to reach eight gates arranged around a rectangular pier.
task1-maps:5.chinese: 離境乘客會先通過安檢和護照檢查，然後經由一條步行通道前往圍繞矩形登機廊排列的八個登機閘口。

task1-maps:5.english: The departures area contains only check-in facilities and a café, while arrivals are limited to passport control and customs.
task1-maps:5.chinese: 離境區只設有辦理登機手續的設施和一間咖啡店，而入境區則只包括護照檢查和海關。

task1-maps:5.english: After redevelopment, the departures hall will include a bag drop, check-in area and café.
task1-maps:5.chinese: 重新發展後，離境大堂將會包括行李托運處、辦理登機手續區和咖啡店。

task1-maps:5.english: Shops will be added beyond security, leading to the enlarged concourse.
task1-maps:5.chinese: 商店將會增設在安檢之後的位置，並通往擴大的候機大廳。

task1-maps:5.english: Instead of a simple walkway, passengers will use a sky train along the main pier, which will branch into two arms and increase the number of gates to eighteen.
task1-maps:5.chinese: 乘客將改乘空中列車，沿主登機廊前進，取代原有的簡單步行通道；該登機廊會分成兩條支線，並把登機閘口數量增加至十八個。

task1-maps:5.english: The arrivals side will also gain a café, an ATM and car-hire facilities near the exit.
task1-maps:5.chinese: 入境區一側亦會在出口附近增設咖啡店、自動櫃員機和租車設施。

task1-maps:6.english: The two plans illustrate the layout of Grange Park when it opened in 1920 and its arrangement today.
task1-maps:6.chinese: 這兩張平面圖展示了格蘭奇公園在 1920 年首次開放時的布局，以及它今天的安排。

task1-maps:6.english: Overall, the park has been substantially modernised, with recreational facilities such as an amphitheatre, café, children’s play area and underground parking added.
task1-maps:6.chinese: 整體而言，該公園已大幅現代化，新增了露天劇場、咖啡館、兒童遊樂區和地下停車場等休閒設施。

task1-maps:6.english: However, the two main entrances on Arnold Avenue and Eldon Street have been retained, and rose gardens remain important, although they have been reduced and reorganised.
task1-maps:6.chinese: 然而，位於阿諾德大道和埃爾登街的兩個主要入口被保留下來，而玫瑰園仍然是重要元素，儘管它們的數量已減少並被重新安排。

task1-maps:6.english: In 1920, the park had a formal layout.
task1-maps:6.chinese: 在 1920 年，該公園具有較正式的布局。

task1-maps:6.english: A fountain stood at its centre, while a stage for musicians occupied the western side.
task1-maps:6.chinese: 一座噴泉位於公園中央，而音樂家表演台則佔據西側位置。

task1-maps:6.english: Three rose gardens were located in the northwest, northeast and southwest corners, and seating was distributed around the edges.
task1-maps:6.chinese: 三個玫瑰園分別位於西北角、東北角和西南角，座位則分布在公園邊緣一帶。

task1-maps:6.english: The eastern half contained a pond for water plants in the northeast and a glasshouse in the southeast.
task1-maps:6.chinese: 公園東半部包含位於東北方的水生植物池，以及位於東南方的玻璃溫室。

task1-maps:6.english: Today, the central fountain has been replaced by a square rose garden, surrounded by seats on all four sides.
task1-maps:6.chinese: 如今，中央噴泉已被一個方形玫瑰園取代，而其四周均設有座位。

task1-maps:6.english: The former musicians’ stage has given way to a larger amphitheatre for concerts.
task1-maps:6.chinese: 原本的音樂家表演台已被一個更大的露天音樂會劇場取代。

task1-maps:6.english: On the eastern side, the old pond and glasshouse have disappeared; in their place are a café, a children’s play area and a water feature.
task1-maps:6.chinese: 在東側，舊有的池塘和玻璃溫室已經消失；取而代之的是咖啡館、兒童遊樂區和水景設施。

task1-maps:6.english: A new entrance to an underground car park has also been introduced from the southeast.
task1-maps:6.chinese: 此外，東南方也新增了一個通往地下停車場的入口。

task1-maps:7.english: The maps compare road access to a city hospital in 2007 and 2010.
task1-maps:7.chinese: 這兩幅地圖比較了 2007 年和 2010 年通往一所城市醫院的道路通達情況。

task1-maps:7.english: Overall, the layout was substantially reorganised: two roundabouts and a bus station were introduced, and the original combined car park was replaced by separate staff and public parking facilities.
task1-maps:7.chinese: 整體而言，該區佈局被大幅重新規劃：新增了兩個迴旋處和一個巴士總站，而原本供員工和公眾共同使用的停車場則被分成員工停車場和公眾停車場。

task1-maps:7.english: The three main roads, however, remained in the same positions.
task1-maps:7.chinese: 然而，三條主要道路的位置保持不變。

task1-maps:7.english: In 2007, Hospital Road ran northwards from City Road to the Ring Road, which surrounded the hospital.
task1-maps:7.chinese: 2007 年，醫院路從城市路向北延伸至環路，而環路圍繞著醫院。

task1-maps:7.english: Six small bus stops were placed along Hospital Road, three on each side.
task1-maps:7.chinese: 六個小型巴士站沿醫院路設置，左右兩側各三個。

task1-maps:7.english: A single car park for both staff and the public stood to the east of this road, just below the Ring Road.
task1-maps:7.chinese: 一個供員工和公眾共同使用的停車場位於這條路以東、環路正下方。

task1-maps:7.english: By 2010, traffic flow had been redesigned more systematically.
task1-maps:7.chinese: 到 2010 年，交通流線已被更有系統地重新設計。

task1-maps:7.english: A roundabout had been built at each end of Hospital Road, one at its junction with City Road and the other where it joined the Ring Road.
task1-maps:7.chinese: 醫院路兩端各建了一個迴旋處，一個位於它與城市路的交界處，另一個位於它與環路相接的位置。

task1-maps:7.english: The bus stops had been removed and replaced by a bus station on the western side, with access links to both roundabouts.
task1-maps:7.chinese: 原有巴士站被移除，並由西側的一個巴士總站取代，而該巴士總站有道路連接至兩個迴旋處。

task1-maps:7.english: Parking was also separated: the staff car park occupied the area east of Hospital Road, while a new public car park was constructed east of the hospital, reached directly from the Ring Road.
task1-maps:7.chinese: 停車安排也被分開：員工停車場佔據醫院路以東的區域，而一個新的公眾停車場則建於醫院東側，可直接從環路進入。

task1-maps:8.english: The two plans illustrate the current layout of a university sports centre and its proposed redevelopment.
task1-maps:8.chinese: 這兩張平面圖說明一所大學體育中心目前的布局，以及其擬議重建後的樣貌。

task1-maps:8.english: Overall, the centre is expected to expand westwards and eastwards, replacing both outdoor court areas with indoor facilities.
task1-maps:8.chinese: 整體而言，該中心預計會向西和向東擴展，並用室內設施取代兩側的戶外球場區。

task1-maps:8.english: The existing central core, including the 25-metre pool, reception, original changing room and seating area, will remain largely unchanged, while the gym will be enlarged and new leisure and commercial amenities will be added.
task1-maps:8.chinese: 現有的中央核心區，包括 25 米泳池、接待處、原有更衣室和座位區，將大致保持不變；同時，健身房會擴大，並會增設新的休閒和商業設施。

task1-maps:8.english: At present, the sports centre consists of a compact rectangular building.
task1-maps:8.chinese: 目前，該體育中心由一座緊湊的矩形建築組成。

task1-maps:8.english: A 25-metre pool occupies the middle, with a gym directly to its north.
task1-maps:8.chinese: 一個 25 米泳池位於中間，其正北方是健身房。

task1-maps:8.english: On the western side of the pool there is a changing room, whereas seating is located to the east.
task1-maps:8.chinese: 泳池西側設有更衣室，而座位區位於東側。

task1-maps:8.english: The reception area stands at the southern entrance, and the building is flanked by outdoor courts on both sides.
task1-maps:8.chinese: 接待處位於南面的入口處，而建築兩側各有一片戶外球場。

task1-maps:8.english: After redevelopment, the western courts will be replaced by a large leisure pool, with an additional changing room and a sports shop to its south.
task1-maps:8.chinese: 重建後，西側球場將被一個大型休閒泳池取代，其南面會新增一間更衣室和一間體育用品商店。

task1-maps:8.english: On the eastern side, the courts will give way to a sports hall, two dance studios, a café and another changing room.
task1-maps:8.chinese: 在東側，球場將讓位給一個體育館、兩間舞蹈室、一間咖啡廳和另一間更衣室。

task1-maps:8.english: The gym will also be extended across the northern part of the complex.
task1-maps:8.chinese: 健身房也將沿著建築群北部擴建。

task1-maps:9.english: The two plans illustrate the layout of Grange Park when it opened in 1920 and its arrangement today.
task1-maps:9.chinese: 這兩張平面圖展示了格蘭奇公園在 1920 年首次開放時的布局，以及它今天的安排。

task1-maps:9.english: Overall, the park has been substantially modernised, with recreational facilities such as an amphitheatre, café, children’s play area and underground parking added.
task1-maps:9.chinese: 整體而言，該公園已大幅現代化，新增了露天劇場、咖啡館、兒童遊樂區和地下停車場等休閒設施。

task1-maps:9.english: However, the two main entrances on Arnold Avenue and Eldon Street have been retained, and rose gardens remain important, although they have been reduced and reorganised.
task1-maps:9.chinese: 然而，位於阿諾德大道和埃爾登街的兩個主要入口被保留下來，而玫瑰園仍然是重要元素，儘管它們的數量已減少並被重新安排。

task1-maps:9.english: In 1920, the park had a formal layout.
task1-maps:9.chinese: 在 1920 年，該公園具有較正式的布局。

task1-maps:9.english: A fountain stood at its centre, while a stage for musicians occupied the western side.
task1-maps:9.chinese: 一座噴泉位於公園中央，而音樂家表演台則佔據西側位置。

task1-maps:9.english: Three rose gardens were located in the northwest, northeast and southwest corners, and seating was distributed around the edges.
task1-maps:9.chinese: 三個玫瑰園分別位於西北角、東北角和西南角，座位則分布在公園邊緣一帶。

task1-maps:9.english: The eastern half contained a pond for water plants in the northeast and a glasshouse in the southeast.
task1-maps:9.chinese: 公園東半部包含位於東北方的水生植物池，以及位於東南方的玻璃溫室。

task1-maps:9.english: Today, the central fountain has been replaced by a square rose garden, surrounded by seats on all four sides.
task1-maps:9.chinese: 如今，中央噴泉已被一個方形玫瑰園取代，而其四周均設有座位。

task1-maps:9.english: The former musicians’ stage has given way to a larger amphitheatre for concerts.
task1-maps:9.chinese: 原本的音樂家表演台已被一個更大的露天音樂會劇場取代。

task1-maps:9.english: On the eastern side, the old pond and glasshouse have disappeared; in their place are a café, a children’s play area and a water feature.
task1-maps:9.chinese: 在東側，舊有的池塘和玻璃溫室已經消失；取而代之的是咖啡館、兒童遊樂區和水景設施。

task1-maps:9.english: A new entrance to an underground car park has also been introduced from the southeast.
task1-maps:9.chinese: 此外，東南方也新增了一個通往地下停車場的入口。

task1-maps:10.english: The two maps compare an island before and after the construction of tourist facilities.
task1-maps:10.chinese: 這兩張地圖比較了一個島嶼在旅遊設施建設前後的情況。

task1-maps:10.english: Overall, the island has been transformed from a largely undeveloped natural area into a compact resort, with accommodation, catering facilities and transport links added mainly in the western and central sections.
task1-maps:10.chinese: 整體而言，這座島已經由一個基本未開發的自然區域轉變成一個小型度假區，住宿、餐飲設施和交通連接主要集中在西部和中部地區。

task1-maps:10.english: However, the beach and most palm-tree areas have been retained, while the eastern end remains largely untouched.
task1-maps:10.chinese: 然而，海灘和大部分棕櫚樹區域被保留下來，而島的東端基本上仍未受到改動。

task1-maps:10.english: Before development, the island contained only natural features.
task1-maps:10.chinese: 在開發前，這座島只包含自然特徵。

task1-maps:10.english: A beach lay on the western shore, and groups of palm trees were scattered across the middle and, more densely, towards the east.
task1-maps:10.chinese: 一片海灘位於西岸，而棕櫚樹群分布在島的中部，並且在東部一帶更加密集。

task1-maps:10.english: There were no buildings, roads, paths or landing facilities, so access to and movement around the island were not formally provided.
task1-maps:10.chinese: 圖中沒有建築物、道路、小徑或登岸設施，因此島上的進出和內部移動並沒有正式的安排。

task1-maps:10.english: Following construction, two clusters of accommodation huts have been built: one close to the beach in the west and another around an open central area.
task1-maps:10.chinese: 建設完成後，兩組住宿小屋被建成：一組靠近西部的海灘，另一組則圍繞中部的一片開放區域。

task1-maps:10.english: These are linked by footpaths, one of which also runs to the beach, now marked for swimming.
task1-maps:10.chinese: 這些住宿小屋由步行小徑連接，其中一條小徑也通向海灘，而海灘現在被標示為游泳區。

task1-maps:10.english: A reception building stands near the centre, with a restaurant just to its north.
task1-maps:10.chinese: 一座接待處位於島的中部附近，其北面緊鄰一間餐廳。

task1-maps:10.english: To the south, a pier has been added for boats, and vehicle tracks now connect it with both main service buildings.
task1-maps:10.chinese: 在南部，一座供船隻使用的碼頭已被增設，而車道現在把碼頭與兩座主要服務建築連接起來。

task1-mixed-charts:1.english: The graphics summarise Little Chalfont Library’s age profile, loan categories in 2016, and annual loan totals from 2007 to 2016.
task1-mixed-charts:1.chinese: 這些圖表概述了 Little Chalfont Library 的會員年齡分布、2016年的借閱類別，以及2007年至2016年間每年的總借閱量。

task1-mixed-charts:1.english: Overall, adults aged 18–64 made up the majority of members, while fiction was by far the dominant type of borrowing.
task1-mixed-charts:1.chinese: 整體而言，18至64歲的成年人佔會員的大多數，而小說明顯是最主要的借閱類型。

task1-mixed-charts:1.english: Total lending rose across the period, despite a brief dip around 2013.
task1-mixed-charts:1.chinese: 儘管在2013年前後曾短暫下降，整體借閱量在整段期間仍然上升。

task1-mixed-charts:1.english: In 2016, adults aged 18–64 accounted for 51% of members, more than twice the share of children, at 22%.
task1-mixed-charts:1.chinese: 在2016年，18至64歲的成年人佔會員的51%，是兒童比例22%的兩倍多。

task1-mixed-charts:1.english: Young adults and people aged 65 or over were smaller groups, at 15% and 12% respectively.
task1-mixed-charts:1.chinese: 青年成人和65歲或以上人士則是較小的群體，分別佔15%和12%。

task1-mixed-charts:1.english: Loans were concentrated in two categories: children’s fiction and adult fiction each represented 38%, together making up just over three quarters of all borrowing.
task1-mixed-charts:1.chinese: 借閱主要集中在兩個類別：兒童小說和成人小說各佔38%，兩者合計佔全部借閱量的四分之三多一點。

task1-mixed-charts:1.english: Adult non-fiction was next, at 13%, whereas children’s non-fiction accounted for only 6%.
task1-mixed-charts:1.chinese: 成人非小說類排在其後，佔13%；相比之下，兒童非小說類只佔6%。

task1-mixed-charts:1.english: Young adults and adult audio books stood at 2% each, and children’s DVDs were negligible, at 1%.
task1-mixed-charts:1.chinese: 青年成人類和成人有聲書各佔2%，而兒童 DVDs 幾乎可以忽略，只佔1%。

task1-mixed-charts:1.english: Annual loans increased from just under 16,000 in 2007 to about 19,000 in 2008 and 2009.
task1-mixed-charts:1.chinese: 每年借閱量由2007年的略低於16,000次，上升至2008年和2009年的約19,000次。

task1-mixed-charts:1.english: The figure then stayed mostly above 20,000 until 2012, fell slightly below this level in 2013, and recovered steadily to a peak of roughly 21,500 in 2016.
task1-mixed-charts:1.chinese: 此後，該數字到2012年大多維持在20,000次以上，2013年略跌至此水平以下，然後穩步回升，並在2016年達到約21,500次的高峰。

task1-mixed-charts:2.english: The pie chart shows where young people in an Australian town attend dance classes, while the bar chart compares the numbers of under-11s and 11- to 16-year-olds taking ballet, tap and modern dance.
task1-mixed-charts:2.chinese: 圓餅圖顯示澳洲某城鎮的年輕人在哪些地點上舞蹈課，而柱狀圖則比較了 11歲以下以及 11 至 16 歲學生參加芭蕾舞、踢踏舞和現代舞課程的人數。

task1-mixed-charts:2.english: Overall, private studios are by far the most common venue, accounting for nearly half of all classes, whereas college-based studios represent the smallest share.
task1-mixed-charts:2.chinese: 整體而言，私人舞蹈室是目前最常見的上課地點，佔所有課程的接近一半；相反，設於學院的舞蹈室所佔比例最小。

task1-mixed-charts:2.english: In terms of dance style, ballet is clearly the leading choice among younger children, while modern dance is more popular with the older group; tap attracts broadly similar numbers in both age bands.
task1-mixed-charts:2.chinese: 就舞蹈類型而言，芭蕾舞明顯是較年幼兒童的首選，而現代舞則更受年齡較大的學生歡迎；踢踏舞在兩個年齡組中的人數大致相近。

task1-mixed-charts:2.english: Looking first at locations, 48% of classes are held in private studios, exactly twice the proportion taking place in after-school sessions in school halls, at 24%.
task1-mixed-charts:2.chinese: 先看上課地點， 48% 的課程在私人舞蹈室舉行，這正好是學校禮堂課後課程比例的兩倍，後者為 24% 。

task1-mixed-charts:2.english: Community halls and other venues make up a further 18%, leaving college-based studios with only 10%, or around one tenth of the total.
task1-mixed-charts:2.chinese: 社區禮堂和其他場地另佔 18% ，而學院舞蹈室只佔 10% ，即大約佔整體的十分之一。

task1-mixed-charts:2.english: Regarding class types, about 600 children under 11 attend ballet, compared with roughly 300 students aged 11–16.
task1-mixed-charts:2.chinese: 就課程類型而言，大約 600 名 11 歲以下兒童參加芭蕾舞課，相比之下， 11 至16 歲的學生約為 300 人。

task1-mixed-charts:2.english: Modern dance shows the opposite pattern, with just under 300 younger participants but approximately 520 older ones.
task1-mixed-charts:2.chinese: 現代舞則呈現相反模式，較年幼組別的人數略低於 300 ，而較年長組別約有520 人。

task1-mixed-charts:2.english: Tap is more evenly balanced, at around 450 under-11s and slightly over 400 students in the older age group.
task1-mixed-charts:2.chinese: 踢踏舞的人數分布較平均， 11 歲以下學生約為 450 人，而較年長組別則略高於 400 人。

task1-mixed-charts:3.english: The table compares the police budget in one area of Britain in 2017 and 2018 by funding source, while the pie charts show how the money was spent.
task1-mixed-charts:3.chinese: 該表格按照資金來源比較了英國某地區在2017年和2018年的警察預算，而餅圖則顯示了這筆錢的支出方式。

task1-mixed-charts:3.english: Overall, the budget rose modestly over the two years.
task1-mixed-charts:3.chinese: 整體而言，這兩年間警察預算有小幅上升。

task1-mixed-charts:3.english: The national government remained the main source of funding, although the increase came chiefly from local taxes.
task1-mixed-charts:3.chinese: 中央政府仍然是主要資金來源，儘管預算增幅主要來自地方稅收。

task1-mixed-charts:3.english: In terms of expenditure, salaries continued to dominate the budget, but their share fell as technology took a larger proportion.
task1-mixed-charts:3.chinese: 在支出方面，薪金仍然佔據預算的最大部分，但其比例有所下降，而科技支出所佔比例則增加了。

task1-mixed-charts:3.english: In 2017, the total police budget stood at £304.7 million.
Of this, £175.5 million came from the national government, far more than the £91.2 million raised through local taxes and the £38 million from other sources, such as grants.
task1-mixed-charts:3.chinese: 其中，1.755億英鎊來自中央政府，遠高於地方稅收籌得的9,120萬英鎊，以及來自其他來源如補助金的3,800萬英鎊。

task1-mixed-charts:3.english: By 2018, the total had climbed to £318.6 million.
task1-mixed-charts:3.chinese: 到2018年，總預算上升至3.186億英鎊。

task1-mixed-charts:3.english: Government funding increased only slightly, to £177.8 million, while local-tax revenue rose more sharply to £102.3 million.
task1-mixed-charts:3.chinese: 政府撥款只小幅增加至1.778億英鎊，而地方稅收則更明顯地上升至1.023億英鎊。

task1-mixed-charts:3.english: Other sources changed very little, reaching £38.5 million.
task1-mixed-charts:3.chinese: 其他來源變化很小，達到3,850萬英鎊。

task1-mixed-charts:3.english: Regarding spending, salaries accounted for three quarters of the budget in 2017, before declining to 69% in 2018.
task1-mixed-charts:3.chinese: 在支出方面，薪金在2017年佔預算的四分之三，之後在2018年下降至69%。

task1-mixed-charts:3.english: By contrast, technology almost doubled its share, rising from 8% to 14%, whereas buildings and transport remained unchanged at 17%.
task1-mixed-charts:3.chinese: 相比之下，科技支出所佔比例幾乎翻倍，從8%上升至14%；而建築物和交通支出則保持不變，均為17%。

task1-mixed-charts:4.english: The bar chart compares the export earnings of a country in five product categories in 2015 and 2016, while the table indicates the percentage change in each category over the same period.
task1-mixed-charts:4.chinese: 這張柱狀圖比較了一個國家在 2015 年和 2016 年五個產品類別的出口收入，而表格則顯示了同一期間每個類別出口價值的百分比變化。

task1-mixed-charts:4.english: Overall, export revenue rose in four of the five categories, with gems and jewellery being the only sector to decline.
task1-mixed-charts:4.chinese: 整體而言，五個類別中有四個的出口收入上升，只有寶石與珠寶這一類出現下降。

task1-mixed-charts:4.english: Petroleum products remained the largest earner in both years, whereas textiles, despite starting from the lowest base, recorded the fastest growth.
task1-mixed-charts:4.chinese: 石油產品在兩年中都是出口收入最高的類別；相反，紡織品雖然起點最低，卻錄得最快的增長。

task1-mixed-charts:4.english: In 2015, petroleum products generated about $61 billion, slightly more than engineered goods, at roughly $58 billion.
task1-mixed-charts:4.chinese: 2015 年，石油產品創造了約 610 億美元的出口收入，略高於工程產品的約 580億美元。

task1-mixed-charts:4.english: Both categories increased in 2016: the former rose modestly by 3% to around $63 billion, while the latter climbed more sharply, by 8.5%, to approximately $62 billion.
task1-mixed-charts:4.chinese: 這兩個類別在 2016 年均有所上升：前者溫和增長 3% ，達到約 630 億美元；後者則上升更明顯，增幅為 8.5% ，達到約 620 億美元。

task1-mixed-charts:4.english: Gems and jewellery followed a different path, falling from about $43 billion to roughly $41 billion, a decrease of 5.18%.
task1-mixed-charts:4.chinese: 寶石與珠寶則呈現不同走勢，從約 430 億美元下降至約 410 億美元，跌幅為。

task1-mixed-charts:4.english: Among the lower-earning categories, agricultural products changed very little, remaining at around $31 billion in both years after a marginal rise of 0.81%.
task1-mixed-charts:4.chinese: 在收入較低的類別中，農產品變化非常小，在輕微上升 0.81% 後，兩年都維持在約 310 億美元左右。

task1-mixed-charts:4.english: Textiles, by contrast, grew markedly from about $26 billion to roughly $31 billion, representing a 15.24% increase and making it nearly equal to agricultural products by 2016.
task1-mixed-charts:4.chinese: 相比之下，紡織品從約 260 億美元顯著增長至約 310 億美元，增幅為 15.24% ，到2016 年幾乎與農產品持平。

task1-mixed-charts:5.english: The bar chart compares the export earnings of five product categories in one country in 2015 and 2016, while the table indicates the percentage change in each category over the same period.
task1-mixed-charts:5.chinese: 這張柱狀圖比較了一個國家在 2015 年和 2016 年五個產品類別的出口收入，而表格則顯示同一期間每個類別的百分比變化。

task1-mixed-charts:5.english: Overall, export revenues increased in four of the five categories, with gems and jewellery being the only sector to decline.
task1-mixed-charts:5.chinese: 整體而言，五個出口類別中有四個的收入上升，而寶石和珠寶是唯一下降的類別。

task1-mixed-charts:5.english: Petroleum products remained the highest-earning export in both years, while textiles recorded the strongest percentage growth despite starting from the lowest base.
task1-mixed-charts:5.chinese: 石油產品在兩年中都是收入最高的出口類別；相反，紡織品雖然起點最低，但錄得最強的百分比增長。

task1-mixed-charts:5.english: In 2015, petroleum products generated about $61 billion, slightly more than engineered goods, which stood at roughly $58 billion.
task1-mixed-charts:5.chinese: 2015 年，石油產品創造了約 610 億美元的收入，略高於工程產品約 580 億美元。

task1-mixed-charts:5.english: By 2016, both categories had risen, to approximately $63 billion and $62 billion respectively.
task1-mixed-charts:5.chinese: 到 2016 年，這兩個類別均有所上升，分別達到約 630 億美元和 620 億美元。

task1-mixed-charts:5.english: Although petroleum products still led the chart, engineered goods narrowed the gap after an 8.5% increase, compared with a more modest 3% rise in petroleum exports.
task1-mixed-charts:5.chinese: 雖然石油產品仍然位居首位，但工程產品在增長 8.5% 後縮小了差距；相比之下，石油產品的增幅較溫和，只有 3% 。

task1-mixed-charts:5.english: Gems and jewellery fell from around $43 billion to about $41 billion, representing a decline of 5.18%.
task1-mixed-charts:5.chinese: 寶石和珠寶的收入從約 430 億美元下降至約 410 億美元，代表下降了 5.18% 。

task1-mixed-charts:5.english: Agricultural products changed very little, edging up by only 0.81% from just over $30 billion.
task1-mixed-charts:5.chinese: 農產品變化非常小，從略高於 300 億美元的水平只微升了 0.81% 。

task1-mixed-charts:5.english: By contrast, textiles climbed markedly from approximately $26 billion to $31 billion, making it the fastest-growing category at 15.24%.
task1-mixed-charts:5.chinese: 相比之下，紡織品從約 260 億美元顯著上升至 310 億美元，使其成為增長最快的類別，增幅達 15.24% 。

task1-mixed-charts:6.english: The table and pie charts compare attendance at Ashdown Museum and visitors’ satisfaction levels in the years before and after its refurbishment.
task1-mixed-charts:6.chinese: 該表格和圓餅圖比較了阿什當博物館翻新前後兩年中的參觀人數，以及訪客對參觀體驗的滿意程度。

task1-mixed-charts:6.english: Overall, the museum became both more popular and more highly rated after the work was completed.
task1-mixed-charts:6.chinese: 整體而言，翻新工程完成後，該博物館不但更受歡迎，也獲得了更高的評價。

task1-mixed-charts:6.english: The total number of visitors rose markedly, while positive responses replaced dissatisfaction as the dominant pattern.
task1-mixed-charts:6.chinese: 總訪客人數明顯上升，而正面回應也取代不滿意，成為主要的滿意度模式。

task1-mixed-charts:6.english: In terms of attendance, the museum received 74,000 visitors before the refurbishment, but this figure increased to 92,000 in the following year, a rise of 18,000.
task1-mixed-charts:6.chinese: 就參觀人數而言，該博物館在翻新前一年接待了 74,000 名訪客，但在翻新後一年，這一數字上升至 92,000 ，增加了 18,000 人。

task1-mixed-charts:6.english: The improvement in satisfaction was even more striking.
task1-mixed-charts:6.chinese: 滿意度方面的改善甚至更加明顯。

task1-mixed-charts:6.english: Before the changes, only 15% of respondents said they were very satisfied and a further 30% were satisfied, meaning that positive feedback accounted for less than half of all responses.
task1-mixed-charts:6.chinese: 在翻新前，只有 15% 的受訪者表示非常滿意，另有 30% 表示滿意，這意味著正面回饋佔所有回應不到一半。

task1-mixed-charts:6.english: After refurbishment, however, these two categories climbed to 35% and 40%, respectively, so three quarters of visitors expressed satisfaction.
task1-mixed-charts:6.chinese: 然而，翻新後，這兩個類別分別上升至 35% 和 40% ，因此有四分之三的訪客表達了滿意。

task1-mixed-charts:6.english: By contrast, the proportion of dissatisfied visitors fell sharply.
task1-mixed-charts:6.chinese: 相比之下，不滿意訪客的比例大幅下降。

task1-mixed-charts:6.english: In the year before refurbishment, 40% reported being dissatisfied, making this the largest single group, while 10% were very dissatisfied.
task1-mixed-charts:6.chinese: 在翻新前一年， 40% 的訪客表示不滿意，使其成為最大的單一組別，而另有10% 表示非常不滿意。

task1-mixed-charts:6.english: In the year after refurbishment, these figures dropped to 15% and 5%, respectively.
task1-mixed-charts:6.chinese: 在翻新後一年，這兩項數字分別下降至 15% 和 5% 。

task1-mixed-charts:6.english: The share giving no response remained unchanged at 5% in both years.
task1-mixed-charts:6.chinese: 沒有回應的比例在兩年中都保持在 5% ，沒有變化。

task1-mixed-charts:7.chinese: 然而，翻新後，這兩個類別分別上升至 35% 和 40% ，因此有四分之三的訪客表達了滿意。

task1-pie-charts:1.english: The three pie charts compare the average shares of sodium, saturated fat and added sugar consumed at breakfast, lunch, dinner and snack times in the USA.
task1-pie-charts:1.chinese: 這三個圓餅圖比較了美國人在早餐、午餐、晚餐和零食時間中攝入的鈉、飽和脂肪和添加糖的平均比例。

task1-pie-charts:1.english: Overall, dinner is the main contributor to sodium and saturated fat intake, whereas snacks account for the greatest proportion of added sugar.
task1-pie-charts:1.chinese: 整體而言，晚餐是鈉和飽和脂肪攝入的主要來源，而零食則佔添加糖的最大比例。

task1-pie-charts:1.english: Breakfast consistently makes the smallest, or joint-smallest, contribution, while lunch occupies an intermediate position across all three nutrients.
task1-pie-charts:1.chinese: 早餐在各項中一直佔最小或並列最小比例，而午餐在三種營養素中大致處於中間位置。

task1-pie-charts:1.english: Breakfast is comparatively light in all categories, representing 14% of sodium and 16% of both saturated fat and added sugar.
task1-pie-charts:1.chinese: 早餐在所有類別中所佔比例都相對較低，分別佔鈉的 14% ，以及飽和脂肪和添加糖的 16% 。

task1-pie-charts:1.english: Lunch contributes noticeably more sodium and saturated fat, at 29% and 26% respectively, but its share of added sugar is lower, at 19%.
task1-pie-charts:1.chinese: 午餐所佔的鈉和飽和脂肪比例明顯較高，分別為 29% 和 26% ，但其添加糖比例較低，為 19% 。

task1-pie-charts:1.english: Thus, these two earlier meals are generally less dominant than the later ones, although lunch is still a substantial source of sodium.
task1-pie-charts:1.chinese: 因此，這兩個較早的餐次整體上不及較晚的餐次突出，不過午餐仍然是鈉的一個重要來源。

task1-pie-charts:1.english: Dinner is the most sodium-heavy meal, with its share reaching 43%, and it also leads saturated fat consumption at 37%.
task1-pie-charts:1.chinese: 晚餐是含鈉比例最高的一餐，佔 43% ，同時也以 37% 成為飽和脂肪比例最高的一餐。

task1-pie-charts:1.english: Its contribution to added sugar, however, is much lower, at 23%.
task1-pie-charts:1.chinese: 然而，它在添加糖方面的比例低得多，只有 23% 。

task1-pie-charts:1.english: Snacks show the reverse pattern: they account for only 14% of sodium and 21% of saturated fat, but dominate added sugar at 42%, almost double the dinner figure.
task1-pie-charts:1.chinese: 零食則呈現相反模式：它們只佔鈉的 14% 和飽和脂肪的 21% ，但在添加糖方面佔主導地位，達到 42% ，幾乎是晚餐比例的兩倍。

task1-pie-charts:2.english: The six pie charts compare how water is allocated to agriculture, industry and domestic purposes in six regions of the world.
task1-pie-charts:2.chinese: 六個餅圖比較了世界六個地區的用水如何分配於農業、工業和家庭用途。

task1-pie-charts:2.english: Overall, agriculture dominates water consumption in four of the six regions, particularly Central Asia, Africa and South East Asia.
task1-pie-charts:2.chinese: 整體而言，農業在六個地區中的四個地區佔據用水主導地位，尤其是在中亞、非洲和東南亞。

task1-pie-charts:2.english: By contrast, industrial use takes the largest share in Europe and North America, while household use remains comparatively small everywhere and never represents the leading category.
task1-pie-charts:2.chinese: 相比之下，工業用途在歐洲和北美佔最大比例，而家庭用水在所有地區都相對較小，並且從未成為主導類別。

task1-pie-charts:2.english: In the two regions where industry is the main user, Europe records the highest industrial proportion, at 53%, slightly above North America’s 48%.
task1-pie-charts:2.chinese: 在工業是主要用水者的兩個地區中，歐洲的工業用水比例最高，為 53% ，略高於北美的 48% 。

task1-pie-charts:2.english: Agricultural use is lower in both places, accounting for 32% in Europe and 39% in North America, whereas domestic consumption is modest, at 15% and 13% respectively.
task1-pie-charts:2.chinese: 在這兩個地區，農業用水比例都較低，歐洲為 32% ，北美為 39% ；而家庭用水比例則較溫和，分別為 15% 和 13% 。

task1-pie-charts:2.english: The remaining four regions are clearly agriculture-centred.
task1-pie-charts:2.chinese: 其餘四個地區明顯以農業用水為中心。

task1-pie-charts:2.english: Central Asia has the most pronounced reliance on farming, with 88% of water used for this purpose, followed closely by Africa at 84% and South East Asia at 81%.
task1-pie-charts:2.chinese: 中亞對農業用水的依賴最明顯，有 88% 的水用於此目的，其次是非洲的 84% 和東南亞的 81% 。

task1-pie-charts:2.english: South America also devotes a large majority to agriculture, at 71%, although its domestic share, 19%, is noticeably higher than in the other agriculture-dominated regions.
task1-pie-charts:2.chinese: 南美洲也將絕大部分水用於農業，比例為 71% ；不過其家庭用水比例為 19% ，明顯高於其他以農業為主的地區。

task1-pie-charts:2.english: Industrial use is minimal in these areas, ranging from only 5% in Central Asia to 12% in South East Asia.
task1-pie-charts:2.chinese: 在這些地區，工業用水比例很低，從中亞的僅 5% 到東南亞的 12% 不等。

task1-pie-charts:3.english: The two pie charts compare British students at a university in England according to the additional language or languages they could speak besides English in 2000 and 2010.
task1-pie-charts:3.chinese: 這兩個圓餅圖比較了英格蘭一所大學的英國學生在 2000 年和 2010 年除英語以外能說的額外語言情況。

task1-pie-charts:3.english: Overall, students became more likely to speak at least one language besides English: the share reporting no additional language fell markedly, while Spanish, another language and two other languages all increased.
task1-pie-charts:3.chinese: 整體而言，學生變得更有可能會說至少一種英語以外的語言：表示不會任何額外語言的比例明顯下降，而除英語外只會西班牙語、另一種語言以及另外兩種語言的比例均有所上升。

task1-pie-charts:3.english: Spanish remained the dominant category in both years.
task1-pie-charts:3.chinese: 除英語外只會西班牙語在兩個年份中都保持為最大類別。

task1-pie-charts:3.english: In 2000, Spanish only accounted for the largest segment, at 30% of students.
task1-pie-charts:3.chinese: 在 2000 年，除英語外只會西班牙語佔最大部分，為學生總數的 30% 。

task1-pie-charts:3.english: This was followed by those with no other language, who made up one fifth of the total.
task1-pie-charts:3.chinese: 其次是不會任何其他語言的學生，他們佔總數的五分之一。

task1-pie-charts:3.english: French only and another language were equal at 15% each, whereas German only and two other languages were the smallest categories, both standing at 10%.
task1-pie-charts:3.chinese: 除英語外只會法語和會另一種語言的比例相同，均為 15% ；相反，只會德語和會另外兩種語言是最小的類別，兩者都為 10% 。

task1-pie-charts:3.english: By 2010, Spanish had strengthened its lead, rising to 35%.
task1-pie-charts:3.chinese: 到 2010 年，除英語外只會西班牙語進一步擴大領先優勢，上升至 35% 。

task1-pie-charts:3.english: The proportion speaking another language also increased, from 15% to 20%, while the figure for students able to speak two other languages grew by five percentage points to 15%.
task1-pie-charts:3.chinese: 會另一種語言的比例也從 15% 上升至 20% ，而能說另外兩種語言的學生比例則增加了五個百分點，達到 15% 。

task1-pie-charts:3.english: By contrast, the percentage with no additional language halved to 10%, and French only fell to the same level.
task1-pie-charts:3.chinese: 相比之下，不會任何額外語言的比例減半至 10% ，而除英語外只會法語的比例也下降至同一水平。
除英語外只會德語的比例則保持不變，仍為 10% 。

task1-pie-charts:4.english: The two pie charts compare energy consumption in an average Australian household with the proportions of greenhouse gas emissions produced by each use.
task1-pie-charts:4.chinese: 這兩個圓餅圖比較澳洲一般家庭的能源消耗，以及每種能源用途所產生的溫室氣體排放比例。

task1-pie-charts:4.english: Overall, heating and water heating account for most household energy use, whereas emissions are more evenly distributed.
task1-pie-charts:4.chinese: 整體而言，供暖和熱水加熱佔家庭能源使用的大部分；相反，溫室氣體排放的分布則更加平均。

task1-pie-charts:4.english: Although heating is by far the largest consumer of energy, it produces a much smaller share of emissions; by contrast, other appliances, refrigeration and lighting generate proportionally more greenhouse gas than the energy they use.
task1-pie-charts:4.chinese: 雖然供暖是迄今最大的能源消耗項目，但它產生的排放比例卻小得多；相反，其他電器、冷藏和照明所產生的溫室氣體比例高於它們所使用的能源比例。

task1-pie-charts:4.english: In the first chart, heating makes up 42% of total energy consumption, making it the dominant category.
task1-pie-charts:4.chinese: 在第一個圖中，供暖佔總能源消耗的 42% ，使其成為主導類別。

task1-pie-charts:4.english: Water heating is second at 30%, so these two uses together represent almost three quarters of household energy demand.
task1-pie-charts:4.chinese: 熱水加熱位居第二，佔 30% ，因此這兩種用途合計幾乎佔家庭能源需求的四分之三。

task1-pie-charts:4.english: The remaining categories are much smaller: other appliances account for 15%, refrigeration for 7%, lighting for 4%, and cooling for just 2%.
task1-pie-charts:4.chinese: 其餘類別則小得多：其他電器佔 15% ，冷藏佔 7% ，照明佔 4% ，而冷氣只佔 2%。

task1-pie-charts:4.english: In the emissions chart, water heating is the leading source, at 32%, while other appliances almost double their energy share, producing 28% of emissions.
task1-pie-charts:4.chinese: 在排放圖中，熱水加熱是最大的來源，佔 32% ；同時，其他電器的排放比例幾乎是其能源使用比例的兩倍，產生 28% 的排放。

task1-pie-charts:4.english: Heating, however, is responsible for only 15%.
task1-pie-charts:4.chinese: 然而，供暖只佔 15% 的排放。

task1-pie-charts:4.english: Refrigeration and lighting also have higher emission figures, at 14% and 8% respectively, while cooling remains the smallest contributor, at 3%.
task1-pie-charts:4.chinese: 冷藏和照明的排放數字也較高，分別為 14% 和 8% ；而冷氣仍然是最小的排放來源，佔 3% 。

task1-pie-charts:5.english: The pie charts compare the age profiles of the populations of Yemen and Italy in 2000 and show projections for 2050.
task1-pie-charts:5.chinese: 這些圓餅圖比較了葉門和意大利在 2000 年的人口年齡結構，並展示了 2050 年的預測。

task1-pie-charts:5.english: Overall, Yemen had a markedly younger population than Italy in 2000, and this is expected to remain the case in 2050.
task1-pie-charts:5.chinese: 整體而言，葉門在 2000 年的人口明顯比意大利年輕，而這種情況預計在 2050年仍會維持。

task1-pie-charts:5.english: However, both countries are projected to age: the share of children will decline, while older groups, especially those aged 60 and above in Italy, will become more prominent.
task1-pie-charts:5.chinese: 然而，兩國人口都預計會老化：兒童所佔比例將會下降，而較年長的群體會變得更突出，尤其是意大利 60 歲及以上的人口。
