task1-pie-charts:5.english: In Yemen, children aged 0–14 made up just over half of the population in 2000, at 50.1%, slightly exceeding the 46.3% recorded for people aged 15–59.
task1-pie-charts:5.chinese: 在葉門， 0 至 14 歲兒童在 2000 年佔人口略多於一半，為 50.1% ，稍高於 15 至 59 歲人口的 46.3% 。

task1-pie-charts:5.english: By 2050, this pattern is forecast to reverse, with the working-age group rising to 57.3% and children falling to 37.0%.
task1-pie-charts:5.chinese: 到 2050 年，這種模式預計會逆轉，工作年齡人口將上升至 57.3% ，而兒童比例則下降至 37.0% 。

task1-pie-charts:5.english: The elderly population will remain comparatively small, though it is expected to increase from 3.6% to 5.7%.
task1-pie-charts:5.chinese: 老年人口仍會相對較少，儘管預計會從 3.6% 上升至 5.7% 。

task1-pie-charts:5.english: Italy showed a far older structure.
task1-pie-charts:5.chinese: 意大利則呈現出明顯更老化的人口結構。

task1-pie-charts:5.english: In 2000, people aged 15–59 accounted for the largest proportion, at 61.6%, while those over 60 represented 24.1%; children made up only 14.3%.
task1-pie-charts:5.chinese: 在 2000 年， 15 至 59 歲人口佔最大比例，為 61.6% ； 60 歲以上人口佔 24.1% ；兒童則只佔 14.3% 。

task1-pie-charts:5.english: By 2050, the 60-plus group is projected to surge to 42.3%, close to the working-age share of 46.2%, whereas the youngest group will shrink slightly to 11.5%.
task1-pie-charts:5.chinese: 到 2050 年， 60 歲以上人口預計會大幅上升至 42.3% ，接近工作年齡人口的46.2% ；相反，最年輕組別將小幅下降至 11.5% 。

task1-pie-charts:6.english: The three pie charts compare how a UK school allocated its annual budget across five categories in 1981, 1991 and 2001.
task1-pie-charts:6.chinese: 這三個圓餅圖比較了一所英國學校在 1981 年、 1991 年和 2001 年如何將年度預算分配到五個項目中。

task1-pie-charts:6.english: Overall, teachers’ salaries consistently took the largest share of spending, although this figure peaked in 1991 before declining slightly.
task1-pie-charts:6.chinese: 整體而言，教師薪資一直佔學校開支中最大的比例，不過這一數字在 1991 年達到最高點後略有下降。

task1-pie-charts:6.english: Insurance remained the smallest item throughout, while spending on other workers fell steadily and the two material-related categories moved in opposite directions.
task1-pie-charts:6.chinese: 保險在整段期間一直是最小的支出項目，而其他員工薪資持續下降；同時，兩個與物資和設備相關的項目呈現相反走勢。

task1-pie-charts:6.english: In 1981, staff pay was the dominant expense, with teachers’ salaries at 40% and other workers’ pay at 28%.
task1-pie-charts:6.chinese: 在 1981 年，員工薪資是主要支出，其中教師薪資佔 40% ，其他員工薪資佔 28%。

task1-pie-charts:6.english: A decade later, teachers’ salaries rose to half of total expenditure, while spending on other employees fell to 22%, so staff costs together accounted for 72%.
task1-pie-charts:6.chinese: 十年後，教師薪資上升至總開支的一半，而其他員工薪資則下降至 22% ，因此兩項員工薪資合計佔 72% 。

task1-pie-charts:6.english: By 2001, the former had eased to 45% and the latter had dropped more sharply to 15%, reducing the combined salary share to 60%.
task1-pie-charts:6.chinese: 到 2001 年，前者回落至 45% ，後者則更明顯地下降至 15% ，使整體薪資開支比例降至 60% 。
其餘項目的變化並不一致。

task1-pie-charts:6.english: Resources such as books increased from 15% in 1981 to 20% in 1991, before falling to 9% in 2001.
task1-pie-charts:6.chinese: 書本等資源開支由 1981 年的 15% 上升至 1991 年的 20% ，之後在 2001 年下降至 9%。

task1-pie-charts:6.english: In contrast, furniture and equipment followed the opposite path: it fell from 15% to 5%, then climbed to 23%, becoming the second-largest item in 2001.
task1-pie-charts:6.chinese: 相反，家具和設備開支呈現相反走勢：它先由 15% 下降至 5% ，然後上升至 23%，並在 2001 年成為第二大支出項目。

task1-pie-charts:6.english: Insurance, although always the smallest category, rose steadily from 2% to 3% and finally to 8%.
task1-pie-charts:6.chinese: 保險雖然一直是最小的類別，但仍由 2% 持續上升至 3% ，最後達到 8% 。

task1-process-diagram:1.english: The diagram illustrates the process by which bamboo is converted into fabric and, ultimately, clothing items.
task1-process-diagram:1.chinese: 該圖說明竹子如何被轉化成布料，並最終製成衣物。

task1-process-diagram:1.english: Overall, this is a linear, nine-stage manufacturing process, beginning with the cultivation of bamboo plants in spring and ending with finished garments.
task1-process-diagram:1.chinese: 整體而言，這是一個線性的九階段製造流程，從春季種植竹子開始，以製成成衣結束。

task1-process-diagram:1.english: The early stages are concerned with growing and mechanically preparing the bamboo, while the later stages turn the extracted fibres into yarn and woven cloth.
task1-process-diagram:1.chinese: 前期階段主要涉及竹子的生長和機械處理，而後期階段則把提取出的纖維轉化為紗線和織布。

task1-process-diagram:1.english: At the outset, bamboo plants are planted in spring and left to mature until autumn, when they are harvested.
task1-process-diagram:1.chinese: 一開始，竹子在春季被種下，並被留待生長至秋季，然後被收割。

task1-process-diagram:1.english: Once the crop has been collected, the stems are cut into narrow strips.
task1-process-diagram:1.chinese: 當作物被收集後，竹莖會被切成細條。

task1-process-diagram:1.english: These strips are then crushed so that they are reduced to a liquid pulp.
task1-process-diagram:1.chinese: 然後，這些竹條會被壓碎，使其變成液態漿料。

task1-process-diagram:1.english: Following this, the pulp is filtered in order to separate the long fibres from the remaining liquid.
task1-process-diagram:1.chinese: 接著，漿料會被過濾，以便把長纖維從剩餘液體中分離出來。

task1-process-diagram:1.english: In the next stage, the extracted fibres are softened through the addition of water and amine oxide.
task1-process-diagram:1.chinese: 在下一階段，提取出的纖維會透過加入水和胺氧化物而被軟化。

task1-process-diagram:1.english: After they have been treated in this way, they are spun into yarn.
task1-process-diagram:1.chinese: 當它們以這種方式處理後，便會被紡成紗線。

task1-process-diagram:1.english: The yarn is subsequently woven to produce bamboo fabric.
task1-process-diagram:1.chinese: 隨後，紗線會被編織成竹纖維布料。

task1-process-diagram:1.english: Finally, this fabric is made into everyday clothing products, such as socks and T-shirts.
task1-process-diagram:1.chinese: 最後，這些布料會被製成日常衣物產品，例如襪子和 T 恤。

task1-process-diagram:2.english: The diagram illustrates the cyclical process by which the biofuel ethanol is produced from plant material and then used as an energy source.
task1-process-diagram:2.chinese: 該圖說明生物燃料乙醇如何由植物材料製成，然後被用作能源的循環過程。

task1-process-diagram:2.english: Overall, ethanol production begins with the growth of plants and trees, which use sunlight and carbon dioxide, and ends with ethanol being consumed by vehicles.
task1-process-diagram:2.chinese: 整體而言，乙醇的生產始於植物和樹木的生長，它們利用陽光和二氧化碳；最後則以乙醇被交通工具消耗作結。

task1-process-diagram:2.english: A key feature is that the carbon dioxide released during use is returned to the atmosphere and can be absorbed by new vegetation, allowing the cycle to continue.
task1-process-diagram:2.chinese: 一個關鍵特徵是，使用過程中釋放出的二氧化碳會回到大氣中，並可被新的植被吸收，使整個循環得以持續。

task1-process-diagram:2.english: In the first stage, plants and trees grow through exposure to sunlight and carbon dioxide.
task1-process-diagram:2.chinese: 在第一階段，植物和樹木透過接觸陽光和二氧化碳而生長。

task1-process-diagram:2.english: Once mature, they are harvested by machinery and sent for pre-processing, where the raw biomass is prepared.
task1-process-diagram:2.chinese: 當它們成熟後，會由機械收割，並送往預處理階段，在那裡原始生物質會被準備好。

task1-process-diagram:2.english: The material is then reduced to cellulose, which is transferred to a processing plant.
task1-process-diagram:2.chinese: 接著，這些材料會被轉化為纖維素，並被送往加工廠。

task1-process-diagram:2.english: Inside the plant, cellulose is broken down into sugars.
task1-process-diagram:2.chinese: 在加工廠內，纖維素會被分解成糖。

task1-process-diagram:2.english: Microbes are subsequently added to these sugars, and this biological stage converts them into ethanol.
task1-process-diagram:2.chinese: 隨後，微生物會被加入這些糖中，而這一生物階段會把它們轉化為乙醇。

task1-process-diagram:2.english: The finished fuel is then distributed for use in transport, including cars, lorries and aircraft.
task1-process-diagram:2.chinese: 完成後的燃料接著會被分配到交通運輸中使用，包括汽車、貨車和飛機。

task1-process-diagram:2.english: As these vehicles consume ethanol, carbon dioxide is emitted; this gas then becomes part of the next growing stage when it is taken up again by plants and trees.
task1-process-diagram:2.chinese: 當這些交通工具消耗乙醇時，二氧化碳會被排放出來；之後，這種氣體會在再次被植物和樹木吸收時，成為下一個生長階段的一部分。

task1-process-diagram:3.english: The diagram illustrates the process by which sugar is produced from sugar cane.
task1-process-diagram:3.chinese: 該圖說明糖是如何由甘蔗製成的。

task1-process-diagram:3.english: Overall, the production of sugar is a linear, seven-stage process that begins with growing cane and ends with drying and cooling the finished crystals.
task1-process-diagram:3.chinese: 整體而言，糖的生產是一個線性的七階段流程，從種植甘蔗開始，最後以乾燥和冷卻成品糖晶體結束。

task1-process-diagram:3.english: Broadly, it moves from an agricultural phase, involving cultivation and harvesting, to an industrial phase in which juice is extracted, purified, thickened and separated.
task1-process-diagram:3.chinese: 大致來說，這個流程由涉及栽培和收割的農業階段，轉向工業階段；在工業階段中，汁液會被提取、淨化、濃縮並分離。

task1-process-diagram:3.english: First, sugar cane is grown for 12 to 18 months until it reaches maturity.
task1-process-diagram:3.chinese: 首先，甘蔗會被種植十二至十八個月，直到成熟。

task1-process-diagram:3.english: It is then harvested in one of two ways: mechanically, with a vehicle cutting and loading the crop, or manually, with workers cutting the stalks by hand.
task1-process-diagram:3.chinese: 然後，甘蔗會以兩種方式之一被收割：一種是機械收割，由車輛切割並裝載作物；另一種是人工收割，由工人用手切割甘蔗莖。

task1-process-diagram:3.english: After harvesting, the cane is crushed in a machine, and this step squeezes out the juice required for the later stages.
task1-process-diagram:3.chinese: 收割後，甘蔗會在機器中被壓碎，而這一步會擠出後續階段所需的汁液。

task1-process-diagram:3.english: The extracted juice is next purified by passing through a limestone filter.
task1-process-diagram:3.chinese: 提取出的汁液接著會通過石灰石過濾器被淨化。

task1-process-diagram:3.english: Once it has been cleaned, it is heated in an evaporator, where excess water is removed and the liquid becomes syrup.
task1-process-diagram:3.chinese: 當汁液被清潔後，它會在蒸發器中被加熱；在這一步中，多餘的水分會被去除，而液體會變成糖漿。

task1-process-diagram:3.english: This syrup is then spun in a centrifuge, which separates sugar crystals from the remaining syrup.
task1-process-diagram:3.chinese: 然後，糖漿會在離心機中旋轉，離心機會把糖晶體從剩餘糖漿中分離出來。

task1-process-diagram:3.english: In the final stage, the crystals are dried and cooled, leaving the finished sugar.
task1-process-diagram:3.chinese: 在最後階段，糖晶體會被乾燥和冷卻，最終留下成品糖。

task1-process-diagram:4.english: The diagram illustrates the process by which plastic bottles are recycled and converted into new goods.
task1-process-diagram:4.chinese: 該圖說明塑膠瓶如何被回收，並轉化為新的商品。

task1-process-diagram:4.english: Overall, the procedure contains nine main stages, beginning with the disposal of used bottles and ending with the manufacture of various end products.
task1-process-diagram:4.chinese: 整體而言，這個流程包含九個主要階段，從丟棄使用過的塑膠瓶開始，到製造各種最終產品結束。

task1-process-diagram:4.english: It is largely linear, although the production of new bottles means that some items can re-enter the same recycling loop.
task1-process-diagram:4.chinese: 它大致上是一個線性流程；不過，由於最終產品中包括新的塑膠瓶，一些物品可以重新進入同一個回收循環。

task1-process-diagram:4.english: At the initial stage, consumers place discarded plastic bottles in dedicated recycling bins.
task1-process-diagram:4.chinese: 在最初階段，消費者把丟棄的塑膠瓶放入專門的回收箱中。

task1-process-diagram:4.english: These containers are then emptied by a collection truck, which transports the waste to a recycling centre.
task1-process-diagram:4.chinese: 這些回收箱隨後由收集卡車清空，而卡車會把廢棄物運送到回收中心。

task1-process-diagram:4.english: Once there, the bottles are sorted on a conveyor belt, with suitable items separated from rejected materials.
task1-process-diagram:4.chinese: 到達回收中心後，塑膠瓶會在輸送帶上被分類，合適的物品會與被拒收的材料分開。

task1-process-diagram:4.english: The accepted bottles are subsequently compressed into dense blocks, making them easier to handle before further processing.
task1-process-diagram:4.chinese: 合格的塑膠瓶隨後被壓縮成密集的方塊，以便在進一步加工前更容易處理。

task1-process-diagram:4.english: In the next phase, the compacted blocks are crushed into small fragments, which are washed to remove impurities.
task1-process-diagram:4.chinese: 在下一階段，被壓縮的方塊會被粉碎成小碎片，然後被清洗以去除雜質。

task1-process-diagram:4.english: The cleaned pieces are fed into a machine and turned into plastic pellets.
task1-process-diagram:4.chinese: 清洗後的碎片會被送入機器，並轉化成塑膠顆粒。

task1-process-diagram:4.english: After this, the pellets are heated and transformed into raw material, which is stored in large bundles.
task1-process-diagram:4.chinese: 之後，這些塑膠粒會被加熱並轉化為原材料，而原材料會被存放成大型捆包。

task1-process-diagram:4.english: Finally, this material is used to manufacture a range of products, including new bottles, food containers, T-shirts, shopping bags and pencils.
task1-process-diagram:4.chinese: 最後，這些材料會被用來製造一系列產品，包括新的塑膠瓶、食物容器、 T 恤、購物袋和鉛筆。

task1-process-diagram:5.english: The diagram illustrates the industrial process by which instant noodles are manufactured.
task1-process-diagram:5.chinese: 該圖說明即食麵是如何透過工業流程被製造出來的。

task1-process-diagram:5.english: Overall, this is a linear, eight-stage procedure that starts with flour being stored in silos and ends with finished noodle cups being sealed and labelled.
task1-process-diagram:5.chinese: 整體而言，這是一個線性的八階段流程，從麵粉被存放在筒倉開始，以完成的麵杯被密封並貼上標籤結束。

task1-process-diagram:5.english: Broadly, the process can be divided into two phases: preparing and shaping the dough, followed by cooking, flavouring and packaging the product.
task1-process-diagram:5.chinese: 大致上，該流程可分為兩個階段：先準備並塑造麵團，然後烹煮、調味並包裝產品。

task1-process-diagram:5.english: At the beginning, flour is delivered by truck and kept in storage silos.
task1-process-diagram:5.chinese: 一開始，麵粉由貨車運送，並被存放在儲存筒倉中。

task1-process-diagram:5.english: It is then transferred to a mixer, where water and oil are added to form dough.
task1-process-diagram:5.chinese: 然後，麵粉被轉移到攪拌機中，在那裡加入水和油以形成麵團。

task1-process-diagram:5.english: After this mixture has been prepared, it passes through a series of rollers, which flatten it into thin dough sheets.
task1-process-diagram:5.chinese: 當這種混合物準備完成後，它會通過一系列滾軸，被壓平成薄薄的麵團片。

task1-process-diagram:5.english: These sheets are subsequently cut into narrow strips, and the strips are shaped into round noodle discs.
task1-process-diagram:5.chinese: 隨後，這些麵團片被切成狹長條狀，而這些條狀物再被塑造成圓形麵餅。

task1-process-diagram:5.english: In the second half of the process, the noodle discs are cooked in oil and then dried.
task1-process-diagram:5.chinese: 在流程的後半部分，麵餅會在油中被烹煮，然後被烘乾。

task1-process-diagram:5.english: Once this heating stage has been completed, the dried discs are placed into individual cups.
task1-process-diagram:5.chinese: 當這個加熱階段完成後，乾燥的麵餅會被放入各自的杯子中。

task1-process-diagram:5.english: Vegetables and spices are added at this point, turning the plain noodles into a complete convenience product.
task1-process-diagram:5.chinese: 在這個階段，蔬菜和香料會被加入，使原本普通的麵條變成完整的便利食品。

task1-process-diagram:5.english: Finally, the cups are sealed and labelled before leaving the production line.
task1-process-diagram:5.chinese: 最後，杯子在離開生產線前會被密封並貼上標籤。

task1-process-diagram:6.english: The diagram illustrates how a hydroelectric power station produces electricity by using water stored at different heights.
task1-process-diagram:6.chinese: 該圖說明一座水力發電站如何利用儲存在不同高度的水來產生電力。

task1-process-diagram:6.english: Overall, the system works as a daily cycle: during the day, water flows downwards from an upper reservoir to generate electricity, while at night the same water is pumped back uphill for reuse.
task1-process-diagram:6.chinese: 整體而言，該系統以每日循環的方式運作：白天，水從上方水庫向下流動以產生電力；夜晚，同一批水會被抽回高處，以便再次使用。

task1-process-diagram:6.english: A dam and reversible turbines are the central features, and the electricity produced is sent to the national grid.
task1-process-diagram:6.chinese: 水壩和可逆式渦輪機是該系統的核心部件，而產生的電力會被輸送到國家電網。

task1-process-diagram:6.english: In the daytime, river water is held in the high-level reservoir behind the dam.
task1-process-diagram:6.chinese: 白天，河水被儲存在水壩後方的高位水庫中。

task1-process-diagram:6.english: When the intake is opened, the stored water is released through a sloping pipe towards the power station.
task1-process-diagram:6.chinese: 當進水口打開時，儲存的水會通過一條傾斜的管道流向發電站。

task1-process-diagram:6.english: As it passes through the reversible turbines, these operate a generator, which converts the energy from the moving water into electricity.
task1-process-diagram:6.chinese: 當水流經可逆式渦輪機時，渦輪機會帶動發電機，而發電機會把水流的能量轉化為電力。

task1-process-diagram:6.english: The power is then transmitted by power lines to the national grid, while the used water is discharged into the low-level reservoir.
task1-process-diagram:6.chinese: 隨後，電力會通過電力線輸送到國家電網，而使用過的水則被排入低位水。

task1-process-diagram:6.english: At night, the direction of movement is reversed.
task1-process-diagram:6.chinese: 到了夜晚，水流方向會反過來。

task1-process-diagram:6.english: The intake at the dam is closed, and water from the lower reservoir is pumped back through the same turbine system and conduit to the upper reservoir.
task1-process-diagram:6.chinese: 水壩處的進水口會關閉，而低位水庫中的水會通過同一套渦輪系統和導管被抽回高位水庫。

task1-process-diagram:6.english: This restores the supply of water, allowing the process to begin again the following day.
task1-process-diagram:6.chinese: 這樣可以恢復高位水庫中的水量，使整個過程能夠在第二天再次開始。

task1-process-diagram:7.english: The diagram illustrates the operation of a geothermal power plant and the stages through which underground heat is converted into electricity.
task1-process-diagram:7.chinese: 該圖說明地熱發電廠的運作方式，以及地下熱能如何經過多個階段被轉化為電力。

task1-process-diagram:7.english: Overall, this is a five-stage, linear process.
task1-process-diagram:7.chinese: 整體而言，這是一個五階段的線性流程。

task1-process-diagram:7.english: It begins with cold water being pumped deep below the surface and ends with electricity being generated, with the key transformation occurring when water is heated by hot rocks and then used to produce steam.
task1-process-diagram:7.chinese: 它從冷水被泵入地表深處開始，以電力的產生結束；其中關鍵轉化發生在水被熱岩加熱後，再被用來產生蒸汽。

task1-process-diagram:7.english: At the first stage, cold water stored at ground level is forced down through an injection well to a depth of about 4.5 kilometres.
task1-process-diagram:7.chinese: 第一階段，儲存在地面上的冷水被迫通過注入井下送至約 4.5 公里深處。

task1-process-diagram:7.english: Once it reaches the geothermal zone, the water passes horizontally through an area of hot rocks, where it absorbs heat.
task1-process-diagram:7.chinese: 當水到達地熱區後，它會水平流經一片熱岩區，並在此吸收熱量。

task1-process-diagram:7.english: It then travels back towards the surface through a separate production well, in contrast to the initial downward movement through the injection well.
task1-process-diagram:7.chinese: 然後，它會通過一口獨立的生產井返回地表；這與最初通過注入井向下流動形成對比。

task1-process-diagram:7.english: After the heated water has been pumped up, it enters a condenser, from which steam is released.
task1-process-diagram:7.chinese: 加熱後的水被泵上來後，會進入冷凝器，並由此釋放出蒸汽。

task1-process-diagram:7.english: This steam is directed into a turbine, causing the turbine blades to rotate.
task1-process-diagram:7.chinese: 這些蒸汽被引導進入渦輪機，使渦輪葉片旋轉。

task1-process-diagram:7.english: In the final stage, the rotating turbine powers a generator, which produces electricity that is then transmitted through power lines.
task1-process-diagram:7.chinese: 在最後階段，旋轉的渦輪機帶動發電機，而發電機產生的電力隨後通過電線輸送出去。

task1-process-diagram:8.english: The diagrams illustrate the life cycle of the salmon, showing the habitats, durations and sizes associated with its main developmental stages.
task1-process-diagram:8.chinese: 這些圖表說明鮭魚的生命週期，展示其主要發育階段所對應的棲息地、所需時間和體型大小。

task1-process-diagram:8.english: Overall, salmon pass through three named growth stages—fry, smolt and adult salmon—and move from freshwater rivers to the open sea before returning upstream to reproduce.
task1-process-diagram:8.chinese: 整體而言，鮭魚會經歷三個有名稱的成長階段 —— 幼魚、銀鮭幼魚和成年鮭魚，並從淡水河流移往開闊海域，之後再逆流返回繁殖。

task1-process-diagram:8.english: The cycle lasts roughly nine and a half years, with the longest period spent in the sea and most growth occurring during the marine phase.
task1-process-diagram:8.chinese: 整個週期大約持續九年半，其中最長的階段是在海中度過，而大部分體型增長也發生在海洋階段。

task1-process-diagram:8.english: At the beginning, salmon eggs are laid in the upper river, where slow-moving water, reeds and small stones provide the spawning environment.
task1-process-diagram:8.chinese: 一開始，鮭魚卵被產在上游河段；那裡水流緩慢，並有蘆葦和小石頭，為產卵提供合適環境。

task1-process-diagram:8.english: After approximately five to six months, they hatch into fry, measuring only 3–8 cm.
task1-process-diagram:8.chinese: 大約五至六個月後，魚卵孵化成幼魚，體長只有三至八厘米。

task1-process-diagram:8.english: These young fish then move downstream to the lower river, a faster-flowing area.
task1-process-diagram:8.chinese: 這些幼魚接著向下游移動，到達水流較快的下游河段。

task1-process-diagram:8.english: They remain there for about four years, growing into smolt of around 12–15 cm.
task1-process-diagram:8.chinese: 牠們會在那裡停留大約四年，並成長為體長約十二至十五厘米的銀鮭幼魚。

task1-process-diagram:8.english: Following this freshwater stage, the smolt migrate to the open sea.
task1-process-diagram:8.chinese: 在完成這個淡水階段後，銀鮭幼魚會遷徙到開闊海域。

task1-process-diagram:8.english: This is the longest single phase, lasting about five years, during which they develop into adult salmon.
task1-process-diagram:8.chinese: 這是最長的單一階段，持續約五年；在此期間，牠們發育成成年鮭魚。

task1-process-diagram:8.english: By this point, their length has increased markedly to 70–76 cm.
task1-process-diagram:8.chinese: 到這個階段，牠們的體長已明顯增加到七十至七十六厘米。

task1-process-diagram:8.english: Finally, the mature fish swim back to the upper river, where they lay eggs and restart the cycle.
task1-process-diagram:8.chinese: 最後，成熟的鮭魚會游回上游河段，在那裡產卵並重新開始整個週期。

task1-process-diagram:9.english: The diagrams illustrate the stages and equipment used to make cement, and how this cement is then used to produce concrete for construction.
task1-process-diagram:9.chinese: 這些圖表說明了製造水泥所使用的階段和設備，以及這種水泥如何進一步用於生產建築用混凝土。

task1-process-diagram:9.english: Overall, cement manufacture is a multi-stage linear process involving crushing, mixing, heating and grinding, whereas concrete production is much simpler, requiring only the blending of four measured ingredients.
task1-process-diagram:9.chinese: 整體而言，水泥製造是一個多階段的線性流程，涉及壓碎、混合、加熱和研磨；相比之下，混凝土生產簡單得多，只需要把四種按比例計量的原料混合起來。

task1-process-diagram:9.english: Gravel accounts for by far the largest share of concrete, while water is the smallest component.
task1-process-diagram:9.chinese: 碎石在混凝土中佔遠遠最大的比例，而水則是最小的組成部分。

task1-process-diagram:9.english: At the beginning of the cement-making process, limestone and clay are fed into a crusher, where they are reduced to powder.
task1-process-diagram:9.chinese: 在水泥製造過程的開始，石灰石和黏土被送入破碎機，在那裡被壓碎成粉末。

task1-process-diagram:9.english: This powder is transferred to a mixer and then passes into a rotating heater.
task1-process-diagram:9.chinese: 這些粉末接著被轉移到混合器，然後進入旋轉加熱器。

task1-process-diagram:9.english: As the mixture moves through this cylinder, heat is applied from one end, after which the heated material is processed in a grinder.
task1-process-diagram:9.chinese: 當混合物通過這個圓筒時，熱量從一端施加；之後，加熱後的材料會在研磨機中進一步處理。

task1-process-diagram:9.english: The resulting cement is finally packed into bags.
task1-process-diagram:9.chinese: 最後，製成的水泥被裝入袋中。
混凝土生產涉及的階段較少。

task1-process-diagram:9.english: Cement, sand, gravel and water are all poured into a concrete mixer, which rotates to combine them.
task1-process-diagram:9.chinese: 水泥、沙、碎石和水全部被倒入混凝土攪拌機中，該機器會旋轉將它們混合。

task1-process-diagram:9.english: Gravel, labelled as small stones, makes up half of the mixture, while sand accounts for a further quarter.
task1-process-diagram:9.chinese: 碎石，也就是圖中標註的小石子，佔整個混合物的一半，而沙則佔另外四分之一。

task1-process-diagram:9.english: Cement and water constitute 15% and 10%, respectively, before the finished concrete is ready for building work.
task1-process-diagram:9.chinese: 水泥和水分別佔 15% 和 10% ，然後製成的混凝土便可用於建築工程。

task1-tables:1.english: The tables present changes in the population of New York City as a whole and compare Manhattan with the other four districts between 1800 and 2000.
task1-tables:1.chinese: 這些表格呈現了 1800 年至 2000 年間整個紐約市人口的變化，並將曼哈頓與其他四個區作比較。

task1-tables:1.english: Overall, the city’s population rose dramatically across the two centuries, but the balance shifted sharply away from Manhattan.
task1-tables:1.chinese: 整體而言，在這兩個世紀中，該市人口大幅上升，但人口分布的重心明顯從曼哈頓轉移開來。

task1-tables:1.english: While Manhattan made up more than three quarters of New York’s residents in 1800, the other districts accounted for over four fifths by 2000.
task1-tables:1.chinese: 雖然曼哈頓在 1800 年佔紐約居民的四分之三以上，但到 2000 年，其他區已佔超過五分之四。

task1-tables:1.english: In 1800, New York City had only 79,216 inhabitants.
task1-tables:1.chinese: 1800 年，紐約市只有 79,216 名居民。

task1-tables:1.english: By 1900 this figure had increased to 3,437,202, before reaching 8,009,185 in 2000.

The first century therefore saw the more explosive expansion, with the population multiplying more than fortyfold; over the following hundred years it still grew substantially, though by a little over twice.
task1-tables:1.chinese: 因此，第一個世紀出現了更爆炸性的增長，人口增加了四十多倍；在接下來的一百年中，人口仍然大幅增長，儘管只是略多於兩倍。

task1-tables:1.english: Manhattan followed a different path from the rest of the city.
task1-tables:1.chinese: 曼哈頓的發展路徑與城市其他地區不同。

task1-tables:1.english: Its population climbed from 60,515 in 1800 to 1,850,093 in 1900, but then declined to 1,538,096 by 2000.
Its share consequently fell from 76% to 54%, and finally to just 19%.
task1-tables:1.chinese: 因此，其所佔比例從 76% 下降至 54% ，最後降至僅 19% 。

task1-tables:1.english: By contrast, the other districts grew continuously, from 18,701 to 1,587,109 and then to 6,471,089, raising their combined share from 24% to 81%.
task1-tables:1.chinese: 相比之下，其他區的人口持續增長，從 18,701 上升至 1,587,109 ，然後再增至6,471,089 ，使它們的合計比例從 24% 上升至 81% 。

task1-tables:2.english: The tables compare sales of Fairtrade-labelled coffee and bananas, measured in millions of euros, in five European countries in 1999 and 2004.
task1-tables:2.chinese: 這些表格比較了 1999 年和 2004 年五個歐洲國家的公平貿易標籤咖啡和香蕉銷售額，單位為百萬歐元。

task1-tables:2.english: Overall, coffee sales increased in every market, with the UK recording by far the most striking rise and becoming the leading purchaser by 2004.
task1-tables:2.chinese: 整體而言，咖啡銷售額在每個市場都有上升，其中英國的升幅最為顯著，並在 2004 年成為最大的購買國。

task1-tables:2.english: Banana sales showed a less even pattern: Switzerland remained dominant and grew sharply, whereas Sweden and Denmark experienced declines.
task1-tables:2.chinese: 香蕉銷售額的變化則沒有那麼一致：瑞士仍然佔主導地位並大幅增長，而瑞典和丹麥則出現下降。

task1-tables:2.english: Regarding coffee, Switzerland had the highest figure in 1999, at 3 million euros, followed by Denmark at 1.8 million and the UK at 1.5 million.
task1-tables:2.chinese: 就咖啡而言，瑞士在 1999 年的銷售額最高，為 300 萬歐元，其次是丹麥的 180 萬歐元和英國的 150 萬歐元。

task1-tables:2.english: By 2004, however, the UK had surged to 20 million euros, more than three times Switzerland’s figure of 6 million.
task1-tables:2.chinese: 然而，到 2004 年，英國銷售額激增至 2,000 萬歐元，是瑞士 600 萬歐元的三倍多。

task1-tables:2.english: The remaining countries saw only modest growth, with Denmark edging up to 2 million, Belgium to 1.7 million and Sweden to 1 million.
task1-tables:2.chinese: 其餘國家只錄得溫和增長，其中丹麥微升至 200 萬歐元，比利時升至 170 萬歐元，瑞典則升至 100 萬歐元。

task1-tables:2.english: Banana sales were led by Switzerland in both years, rising from 15 to 47 million euros, which was far ahead of all other markets.
task1-tables:2.chinese: 香蕉銷售額在兩個年份都由瑞士領先，從 1,500 萬歐元上升至 4,700 萬歐元，遠高於所有其他市場。

task1-tables:2.english: The UK and Belgium also increased substantially, reaching 5.5 million and 4 million respectively in 2004.
task1-tables:2.chinese: 英國和比利時也大幅增長，在 2004 年分別達到 550 萬歐元和 400 萬歐元。

task1-tables:2.english: By contrast, Sweden fell from 1.8 to 1 million, while Denmark dropped from 2 to 0.9 million, becoming the smallest market.
task1-tables:2.chinese: 相比之下，瑞典從 180 萬歐元下降至 100 萬歐元，而丹麥則從 200 萬歐元跌至 90萬歐元，成為最小的市場。

task1-tables:3.english: The table compares six major MRT systems by year of completion, network length and annual carrying capacity.
task1-tables:3.chinese: 這個表格比較了六個主要地鐵系統的完工年份、網絡長度和年度載客容量。

task1-tables:3.english: Overall, London and Paris are the earliest and most extensive systems, with London’s network standing well ahead of all the others in length.
task1-tables:3.chinese: 整體而言，倫敦和巴黎是最早完工且網絡規模最大的系統，其中倫敦的路線長度明顯遠超所有其他城市。

task1-tables:3.english: In contrast, Tokyo has by far the greatest yearly capacity despite being much shorter, while Kyoto is the smallest system on both measures.
task1-tables:3.chinese: 相比之下，東京雖然路線短得多，卻擁有遠遠最高的年度載客容量；而京都在路線長度和載客容量兩方面都是最小的系統。

task1-tables:3.english: London was completed first, in 1863, and covers 1,100 kilometres, almost twice Paris’s 594 kilometres.
task1-tables:3.chinese: 倫敦最早完工，時間是 1863 年，總長度為 1,100 公里，幾乎是巴黎 594 公里的兩倍。

task1-tables:3.english: Paris, which was completed in 1890, nevertheless has a higher annual carrying capacity than London, at 850 million compared with 548 million.
task1-tables:3.chinese: 巴黎於 1890 年完工，但其年度載客容量仍高於倫敦，分別為 8.5 億和 5.48 億。

task1-tables:3.english: Tokyo was completed in 1904 and is only 149 kilometres long, yet it dominates in capacity, with an annual carrying capacity of 1,434 million passengers.
task1-tables:3.chinese: 東京於 1904 年完工，長度只有 149 公里，但它在載客容量方面居於首位，每年可承載 14.34 億乘客。

task1-tables:3.english: The other three systems are on a much smaller scale.
task1-tables:3.chinese: 另外三個系統的規模則小得多。

task1-tables:3.english: Washington DC, completed in 1921, has 114 kilometres of track, but its annual capacity is just 70 million.
task1-tables:3.chinese: 華盛頓特區於 1921 年完工，擁有 114 公里路線，但其年度載客容量只有 7,000 萬。

task1-tables:3.english: Kyoto and Los Angeles are the newest networks, finished in 1980 and 2001 respectively, and both are extremely short, at 11 and 14 kilometres.
task1-tables:3.chinese: 京都和洛杉磯是最新的兩個網絡，分別於 1980 年和 2001 年完工，而且兩者都非常短，分別只有 11 公里和 14 公里。

task1-tables:3.english: However, Los Angeles can carry 90 million passengers annually, far more than Kyoto’s 11 million.
task1-tables:3.chinese: 然而，洛杉磯每年可承載 9,000 萬乘客，遠高於京都的 1,100 萬。

task1-tables:4.english: The table presents data on the number of nights spent in Germany by domestic and international tourists between 2016 and 2022, measured in millions.
task1-tables:4.chinese: 這個表格呈現了 2016 年至 2022 年間，本地及國際遊客在德國逗留晚數的數據，單位為百萬晚。

task1-tables:4.english: Overall, domestic tourism accounted for far more overnight stays than international tourism throughout the period.
task1-tables:4.chinese: 整體而言，在整個時期內，本地旅遊所佔的過夜住宿晚數遠遠高於國際旅遊。

task1-tables:4.english: Both categories rose steadily until 2019, before falling sharply in 2020; although they recovered strongly by 2022, neither returned fully to its pre-decline peak.
task1-tables:4.chinese: 兩個類別都穩步上升至 2019 年，之後在 2020 年急劇下跌；雖然到 2022 年兩者均明顯回升，但都未完全恢復至下跌前的高峰。

task1-tables:4.english: From 2016 to 2019, domestic-tourist nights increased consistently, rising from 366.4 million to 405.7 million.
task1-tables:4.chinese: 從 2016 年至 2019 年，本地遊客住宿晚數持續上升，從 3.664 億晚增至 4.057 億晚。

task1-tables:4.english: The international figure followed a similar but much smaller upward trend, climbing from 80.8 million to 89.9 million over the same years.
task1-tables:4.chinese: 國際遊客的數字也呈現相似但規模小得多的上升趨勢，同期從 8,080 萬晚增至 8,990 萬晚。

task1-tables:4.english: As a result, domestic stays were roughly four and a half times as high as overseas stays during this initial period.
task1-tables:4.chinese: 因此，在這一初期階段，本地住宿晚數大約是海外遊客住宿晚數的四倍半。
2019 年之後，這一模式出現了明顯變化。

task1-tables:4.english: Domestic nights dropped to 270.3 million in 2020, a fall of more than 130 million, before edging up to 279.23 million in 2021.
task1-tables:4.chinese: 本地遊客住宿晚數在 2020 年跌至 2.703 億晚，下降超過 1.3 億晚，之後在 2021 年小幅回升至 2.7923 億晚。

task1-tables:4.english: International nights fell even more steeply in proportional terms, plunging from 89.9 million in 2019 to 32 million in 2020 and then slipping to 31.01 million in 2021.
task1-tables:4.chinese: 按比例來看，國際遊客住宿晚數跌幅更為陡峭，從 2019 年的 8,990 萬晚急跌至2020 年的 3,200 萬晚，之後在 2021 年再微跌至 3,101 萬晚。

task1-tables:4.english: By 2022, domestic and international figures had rebounded to 382.62 million and 68.09 million respectively, but both remained below their 2019 levels.
task1-tables:4.chinese: 到 2022 年，本地及國際遊客住宿晚數分別反彈至 3.8262 億晚和 6,809 萬晚，但兩者仍低於 2019 年的水平。

task1-tables:5.english: The table compares the global market shares of mobile phone sales held by several manufacturers in 2005 and 2006.
task1-tables:5.chinese: 這張表比較了數間手機製造商在 2005 年和 2006 年所佔的全球手機銷售市場份額。

task1-tables:5.english: Overall, Nokia remained the clear market leader and slightly strengthened its position, while Motorola recorded the most notable gain among the named companies.
task1-tables:5.chinese: 整體而言， Nokia 仍然是明顯的市場領導者，並略微鞏固了其地位；而在所有列名公司之中， Motorola 錄得最顯著的增長。

task1-tables:5.english: By contrast, Samsung, LG, BenQ Mobile and the collective “Others” category all lost market share; Sony Ericsson was the only smaller named brand to grow.
task1-tables:5.chinese: 相比之下， Samsung 、 LG 、 BenQ Mobile 以及合併計算的「其他」類別均失去市場份額； Sony Ericsson 則是較小型列名品牌中唯一錄得增長的一間。

task1-tables:5.english: In 2005, Nokia accounted for 32.5% of worldwide sales, almost twice Motorola’s share of 17.7% and well ahead of Samsung, at 12.7%.
task1-tables:5.chinese: 2005 年， Nokia 佔全球銷售的 32.5% ，幾乎是 Motorola 17.7% 的兩倍，並遠高於Samsung 的 12.7% 。

task1-tables:5.english: One year later, Nokia had risen to 35%, maintaining a clear lead despite Motorola’s increase to 21.1%.
task1-tables:5.chinese: 一年後， Nokia 上升至 35% ；儘管 Motorola 也增至 21.1% ， Nokia 仍保持明顯領先。

task1-tables:5.english: Motorola’s rise, at 3.4 percentage points, was the largest improvement in the table, whereas Samsung slipped slightly to 11.8%.
task1-tables:5.chinese: Motorola 上升了 3.4 個百分點，是表中最大增幅；相反， Samsung 則輕微下跌至 11.8% 。

task1-tables:5.english: The remaining named manufacturers held much smaller shares.
task1-tables:5.chinese: 其餘列名製造商所佔的市場份額明顯較小。

task1-tables:5.english: Sony Ericsson rose from 6.3% to 7.4%, overtaking LG, whose figure declined marginally from 6.7% to 6.3%.
task1-tables:5.chinese: Sony Ericsson 從 6.3% 上升至 7.4% ，並超越了 LG ；後者的數字則由 6.7% 輕微下降至 6.3% 。

task1-tables:5.english: Among named manufacturers, the steepest fall was seen in BenQ Mobile, which more than halved from 4.9% to 2.4%.
task1-tables:5.chinese: 在列名製造商中，BenQ Mobile 的跌幅最大 ，其市場份額由 4.9% 跌至 2.4% ，縮減了一半以上。

task1-tables:5.english: Other manufacturers also became less significant collectively, dropping from 19.2% to 16.2%.
task1-tables:5.chinese: 其他製造商的合計市佔率也下降，從 19.2% 跌至 16.2% 。

task1-tables:6.english: The table compares the percentages of first-year students in Economics, Law and Commerce who rated five aspects of their course as “very good”.
task1-tables:6.chinese: 該表格比較了經濟學、法律和商科三個課程中，一年級學生把其課程五個方面評為「非常好」的比例。

task1-tables:6.english: Overall, Commerce received the strongest evaluations, leading or sharing first place in every aspect.
task1-tables:6.chinese: 整體而言，商科獲得最強的評價，在每一個方面都位列第一或並列第一。

task1-tables:6.english: Economics was rated highly for teaching and tutor support but much less favourably for pre-course information and resources, whereas Law showed a more balanced pattern, with teaching quality its weakest area.
task1-tables:6.chinese: 經濟學在教學質素和導師支援方面評價很高，但在課前資訊和資源方面明顯較不理想；相比之下，法律的表現較為均衡，而教學質素是其最弱的一項。

task1-tables:6.english: In terms of teaching-related measures, Economics and Commerce both recorded 95% for teaching quality, far above Law at 67%.
task1-tables:6.chinese: 在教學相關指標方面，經濟學和商科的教學質素同樣錄得 95% ，遠高於法律的 67% 。

task1-tables:6.english: Tutor support followed a similar pattern: Commerce was marginally ahead at 93%, with Economics close behind at 92%, while Law was lower, though still fairly positive, at 79%.
task1-tables:6.chinese: 導師支援呈現相似模式：商科以 93% 略微領先，經濟學以 92% 緊隨其後，而法律則較低，儘管 79% 仍算相當正面。

task1-tables:6.english: These figures made Economics and Commerce the clear leaders in these two areas.
task1-tables:6.chinese: 這些數字使經濟學和商科在這兩個方面明顯領先。

task1-tables:6.english: For the remaining aspects, Commerce again stood out.
task1-tables:6.chinese: 至於其餘方面，商科再次突出。

task1-tables:6.english: It achieved 95% for pre-course information, compared with 72% for Law and just 55% for Economics.
task1-tables:6.chinese: 它在課前資訊方面達到 95% ，相比之下，法律為 72% ，經濟學只有 55% 。

task1-tables:6.english: The same hierarchy appeared for printed resources, at 81%, 70% and 59%, respectively.
task1-tables:6.chinese: 印刷資源方面也出現相同排序，商科、法律和經濟學分別為 81% 、 70% 和 59%。

task1-tables:6.english: Other resources were also rated most highly in Commerce, at 85%, followed by Law at 80%, leaving Economics clearly behind at 62%.
task1-tables:6.chinese: 其他資源方面，商科亦獲最高評價，達 85% ；法律以 80% 居次，而經濟學則以62% 明顯落後。

task1-tables:7.english: The table compares international tourist arrivals, measured in millions, in the listed destinations in 2009 and 2010, together with the percentage change over the period.
task1-tables:7.chinese: 該表格比較了所列目的地在 2009 年和 2010 年的國際遊客到訪人數，以百萬為單位，並展示了期間的百分比變化。

task1-tables:7.english: Overall, France remained the most visited destination, despite recording no growth.
task1-tables:7.chinese: 整體而言，法國雖然沒有錄得增長，但仍然是最多遊客到訪的目的地。

task1-tables:7.english: Most places attracted more tourists in the second year, but the increases were generally modest among the larger markets and far stronger among Germany, China and Turkey.
task1-tables:7.chinese: 大部分地區在第二年吸引了更多遊客，但較大型市場的升幅普遍溫和，而德國、中國和土耳其的增長則強勁得多。

task1-tables:7.english: Hong Kong was the only destination to decline.
task1-tables:7.chinese: 香港是唯一出現下跌的目的地。

task1-tables:7.english: Among the leading destinations, France received 76 million tourists in both years, staying well ahead of the US, whose figure edged up from 66 to 67 million.
task1-tables:7.chinese: 在主要目的地之中，法國兩年均接待了 7,600 萬名遊客，仍然大幅領先美國；而美國的數字則由 6,600 萬微升至 6,700 萬。

task1-tables:7.english: Spain and the UK were level at 55 million in 2009, but the UK grew more quickly, reaching 57 million and narrowly overtaking Spain, which rose to 56 million.
task1-tables:7.chinese: 西班牙和英國在 2009 年同為 5,500 萬，但英國增長較快，達到 5,700 萬，並以輕微差距超越西班牙；西班牙則上升至 5,600 萬。

task1-tables:7.english: Italy also increased slightly, from 44 to 45 million.
task1-tables:7.chinese: 意大利亦輕微上升，由 4,400 萬增至 4,500 萬。

task1-tables:7.english: The remaining destinations showed much sharper relative changes.
task1-tables:7.chinese: 其餘目的地則呈現出更明顯的相對變化。

task1-tables:7.english: Turkey, China and Germany each gained 12 million arrivals, climbing from 33 to 45 million, 22 to 34 million and 11 to 23 million respectively.
task1-tables:7.chinese: 土耳其、中國和德國的到訪人數均增加了 1,200 萬，分別由 3,300 萬升至 4,500萬、由 2,200 萬升至 3,400 萬，以及由 1,100 萬升至 2,300 萬。

task1-tables:7.english: Because Germany started from the lowest base, this represented the largest percentage rise, at 109%.
task1-tables:7.chinese: 由於德國的起點最低，因此這代表了最大的百分比升幅，達 109% 。

task1-tables:7.english: By contrast, Hong Kong fell from 10 to 9 million, a decrease of 11%.
task1-tables:7.chinese: 相比之下，香港由 1,000 萬下降至 900 萬，跌幅為 11% 。

task1-tables:8.english: The table compares the percentage of management posts occupied by women in finance, manufacturing, IT and hospitality in a European country in 2006.
task1-tables:8.chinese: 該表格比較了 2006 年某歐洲國家中，女性在金融、製造業、資訊科技和酒店款待業所佔管理職位的百分比。

task1-tables:8.english: Overall, women were most strongly represented in hospitality and least represented in manufacturing across the three levels.
task1-tables:8.chinese: 整體而言，在三個職級中，女性在酒店款待業的代表性最高，而在製造業的代表性最低。

task1-tables:8.english: In addition, their share generally decreased as seniority rose, although hospitality was an exception at the top level, where the proportion of female CEOs slightly exceeded that of female executives.
task1-tables:8.chinese: 此外，女性所佔比例通常隨職級上升而下降；不過，酒店款待業在最高層級是一個例外，女性行政總裁的比例略高於女性行政人員。

task1-tables:8.english: Among managers, hospitality had by far the highest figure, at 33.14%, roughly twice the shares recorded in finance and IT, which were almost identical at 16.39% and 16.04% respectively.
task1-tables:8.chinese: 在經理職位中，酒店款待業的數字遠高於其他行業，達 33.14% ，大約是金融和資訊科技業的兩倍；後兩者的比例幾乎相同，分別為 16.39% 和 16.04% 。

task1-tables:8.english: Manufacturing was noticeably lower, with women making up only 9% of managers.
task1-tables:8.chinese: 製造業則明顯較低，女性只佔經理職位的 9% 。

task1-tables:8.english: A similar ranking can be seen among executives and CEOs, though the percentages were smaller.
task1-tables:8.chinese: 在行政人員和行政總裁層面，也可以看到相似的排名，不過比例整體較低。

task1-tables:8.english: In hospitality, women accounted for 19.9% of executives and 20.6% of CEOs, far ahead of IT, where the equivalent figures were 12.82% and 6.58%.
task1-tables:8.chinese: 在酒店款待業中，女性佔行政人員的 19.9% ，並佔行政總裁的 20.6% ，遠高於資訊科技業；後者相應數字為 12.82% 和 6.58% 。

task1-tables:8.english: Female representation was much weaker in finance, at 4.58% for executives and just 1.98% for CEOs.
task1-tables:8.chinese: 金融業的女性代表性則弱得多，女性行政人員佔 4.58% ，而女性行政總裁僅佔。

task1-tables:8.english: Manufacturing had the lowest levels overall, with only 1.98% of executives and 1.21% of CEOs being women.
task1-tables:8.chinese: 製造業整體水平最低，女性只佔行政人員的 1.98% ，並只佔行政總裁的 1.21%。

task1-tables:9.english: The table compares the daily per-person calorie intake from rice, wheat and maize in Cambodia, Poland, Egypt and Mexico.
task1-tables:9.chinese: 該表比較了柬埔寨、波蘭、埃及和墨西哥四國人民每日每人從米、小麥和玉米中攝取的卡路里。

task1-tables:9.english: Overall, each country shows a clear dependence on a different staple: rice in Cambodia, wheat in Poland and Egypt, and maize in Mexico.
task1-tables:9.chinese: 整體而言，每個國家都明顯依賴不同的主食：柬埔寨主要依賴米，波蘭和埃及主要依賴小麥，而墨西哥則主要依賴玉米。

task1-tables:9.english: Egypt records the broadest consumption across all three foods, while Poland has the narrowest pattern, with no calories from maize.
task1-tables:9.chinese: 埃及在三種食物中都有較廣泛的攝取，而波蘭的飲食模式最狹窄，完全沒有來自玉米的卡路里。

task1-tables:9.english: Rice is overwhelmingly dominant in Cambodia, at 1,445 calories per person per day, which is nearly three times Egypt's figure of 501.
task1-tables:9.chinese: 米在柬埔寨佔絕對主導地位，達到每日每人 1,445 卡路里，幾乎是埃及 501 卡路里的三倍。

task1-tables:9.english: The two remaining countries consume little rice: Mexico stands at 57 calories, while Poland records only 19.
task1-tables:9.chinese: 其餘兩國的米攝取量很低：墨西哥為 57 卡路里，而波蘭只有 19 卡路里。

task1-tables:9.english: Wheat, by contrast, is barely eaten in Cambodia, at just 18 calories.
task1-tables:9.chinese: 相比之下，小麥在柬埔寨幾乎不被食用，只有 18 卡路里。

task1-tables:9.english: It is the main source in Egypt and Poland, at 1,095 and 865 calories respectively, whereas Mexico's figure is much lower, at 275.
task1-tables:9.chinese: 小麥是埃及和波蘭的主要來源，分別為 1,095 和 865 卡路里，而墨西哥的數字則低得多，為 275 卡路里。

task1-tables:9.english: Maize consumption follows a different pattern.
task1-tables:9.chinese: 玉米的攝取情況則呈現不同模式。

task1-tables:9.english: Mexico records the highest intake, at 1,083 calories, far ahead of Egypt's 578 and over ten times Cambodia's 103.
task1-tables:9.chinese: 墨西哥的玉米攝取量最高，達 1,083 卡路里，遠高於埃及的 578 卡路里，也超過柬埔寨 103 卡路里的十倍。

task1-tables:9.english: Poland, however, reports no maize consumption at all.
task1-tables:9.chinese: 然而，波蘭完全沒有玉米攝取量。

task1-tables:10.english: The table compares the proportions of pupils enrolled in four types of secondary school in 2000, 2005 and 2009.
task1-tables:10.chinese: 該表格比較了 2000 年、 2005 年和 2009 年四類中學的學生就讀比例。

task1-tables:10.english: Overall, attendance shifted markedly away from voluntary-controlled and grammar schools towards community schools.
task1-tables:10.chinese: 整體而言，學生就讀比例明顯由志願控制學校和文法學校轉向社區學校。

task1-tables:10.english: While voluntary-controlled schools had by far the largest share at the beginning, community schools became the dominant type by 2009, and specialist schools remained the smallest or joint-smallest category throughout.
task1-tables:10.chinese: 雖然志願控制學校在最初佔比遠遠最高，但到 2009 年，社區學校已成為最主要的類別，而專科學校在整段期間一直是最小或並列最小的類別。

task1-tables:10.english: In 2000, just over half of pupils attended voluntary-controlled schools, at 52%, making this sector more than twice as large as grammar schools, which accounted for 24%.
task1-tables:10.chinese: 在 2000 年，剛過半數學生就讀於志願控制學校，比例為 52% ，使這一類別的佔比超過文法學校的兩倍；文法學校則佔 24% 。

task1-tables:10.english: Specialist and community schools each had 12%, so their combined share was equal to that of grammar schools alone.
task1-tables:10.chinese: 專科學校和社區學校各佔 12% ，因此兩者合計比例正好等同於文法學校單獨的比例。

task1-tables:10.english: By 2005, however, voluntary-controlled schools had fallen to 38%, while community schools had climbed sharply to 32%, narrowing the gap between the two leading categories to only six percentage points.
task1-tables:10.chinese: 然而，到 2005 年，志願控制學校已下降至 38% ，而社區學校則大幅上升至 32%，使兩個主要類別之間的差距收窄至僅 6 個百分點。

task1-tables:10.english: The change became more pronounced by 2009.
task1-tables:10.chinese: 到 2009 年，這一變化變得更加明顯。

task1-tables:10.english: Community schools rose further to 58%, almost five times their initial proportion.
task1-tables:10.chinese: 社區學校進一步上升至 58% ，幾乎是其最初比例的五倍。

task1-tables:10.english: By contrast, voluntary-controlled schools dropped to 20%, less than half their 2000 figure.
task1-tables:10.chinese: 相比之下，志願控制學校下降至 20% ，不到其 2000 年數字的一半。

task1-tables:10.english: Grammar schools also declined steadily, from 24% to 12%, while specialist schools slipped only slightly, from 12% to 10%.
task1-tables:10.chinese: 文法學校也持續下降，從 24% 跌至 12% ；而專科學校則只輕微下滑，從 12% 降至。

task1-tables:11.english: The table compares the cost of meeting the minimum daily water requirement per person in five countries, expressed both in US cents and as a share of the average daily wage.
task1-tables:11.chinese: 該表比較了五個國家中，每人每日達到最低用水需求所需的成本，並同時以美仙及平均日薪比例呈現。

task1-tables:11.english: Overall, Tanzania records the highest cost and the greatest wage burden, while the US has the lowest figures on both measures.
task1-tables:11.chinese: 整體而言，坦桑尼亞的用水成本最高，對工資造成的負擔也最大；而美國在兩項指標上都是最低。

task1-tables:11.english: More broadly, Tanzania, Uganda and Pakistan spend far larger proportions of daily earnings on this basic requirement than the UK and the US, even though the cash differences are only a few cents.
task1-tables:11.chinese: 更廣泛而言，坦桑尼亞、烏干達和巴基斯坦在這項基本需求上所花費的日薪比例，遠高於英國和美國，即使它們在實際金額上的差距只有數美仙。

task1-tables:11.english: In monetary terms, Tanzania leads the table, at 6.4 cents per person per day.
task1-tables:11.chinese: 以金額來看，坦桑尼亞位居首位，每人每日成本為 6.4 美仙。

task1-tables:11.english: Uganda is next, at 4.1 cents, while Pakistan’s figure is considerably lower, at 1.76 cents.
task1-tables:11.chinese: 烏干達緊隨其後，為 4.1 美仙；而巴基斯坦的數字則低得多，為 1.76 美仙。

task1-tables:11.english: The two remaining countries are cheaper still: the UK stands at 1.3 cents, and the US records the lowest daily cost, at 0.85 cents.
task1-tables:11.chinese: 其餘兩個國家的成本更低：英國為 1.3 美仙，而美國錄得最低的每日成本，只有 0.85 美仙。

task1-tables:11.english: The percentage figures show a much sharper contrast.
task1-tables:11.chinese: 百分比數據呈現出更鮮明的對比。

task1-tables:11.english: In Tanzania, the minimum requirement takes up 5.7% of the average daily wage, compared with 3.2% in Uganda and 1.1% in Pakistan.
task1-tables:11.chinese: 在坦桑尼亞，最低用水需求佔平均日薪的 5.7% ；相比之下，烏干達為 3.2% ，巴基斯坦則為 1.1% 。

task1-tables:11.english: By contrast, the equivalent shares in the UK and the US are tiny, at only 0.013% and 0.006% respectively; indeed, Tanzania’s percentage is almost 1,000 times the US figure.
task1-tables:11.chinese: 相比之下，英國和美國的相應比例極小，分別只有 0.013% 和 0.006% ；事實上，坦桑尼亞的比例幾乎是美國的 1,000 倍。

advantage-disadvantage:2.english: In many countries, purchasing goods through digital platforms has become part of everyday life.
advantage-disadvantage:2.chinese: 在許多國家，透過數位平台購買商品已成為日常生活的一部分。

advantage-disadvantage:2.english: This development brings clear benefits to both consumers and businesses, particularly in terms of convenience and efficiency, although it also creates several notable drawbacks.
advantage-disadvantage:2.chinese: 這種發展為消費者和企業都帶來了明顯好處，尤其是在便利性和效率方面，儘管它也造成了一些值得注意的缺點。

advantage-disadvantage:2.english: Overall, I believe that online shopping is a positive trend because its advantages are more significant than its disadvantages for both individuals and companies.
advantage-disadvantage:2.chinese: 總的來說，我認為網上購物是一項正面的趨勢，因為對個人和企業而言，它的優點比缺點更為顯著。

advantage-disadvantage:2.english: The principal advantage of online shopping is the efficiency it creates.
advantage-disadvantage:2.chinese: 網上購物最主要的優點是它所帶來的效率。

advantage-disadvantage:2.english: For individuals, online marketplaces allow people to compare prices, read reviews, and complete purchases within minutes, which saves both time and effort.
advantage-disadvantage:2.chinese: 對個人而言，網上市場讓人們可以在幾分鐘內比價、閱讀評論並完成購買，這樣能同時節省時間與精力。

advantage-disadvantage:2.english: Instead of travelling from one shop to another, a busy parent, for example, can order groceries or school supplies during a lunch break and have them delivered directly home.
advantage-disadvantage:2.chinese: 例如，一位忙碌的家長不必一家店接一家店地奔波，只需在午休時間訂購雜貨或學用品，並直接送到家中。

advantage-disadvantage:2.english: This convenience is especially valuable for those with demanding schedules or limited access to physical stores.
advantage-disadvantage:2.chinese: 這種便利對於行程繁忙或不容易前往實體商店的人尤其有價值。

advantage-disadvantage:2.english: Companies also benefit substantially.
advantage-disadvantage:2.chinese: 企業同樣能獲得相當大的好處。

advantage-disadvantage:2.english: By selling online, businesses can reduce costs related to rent, shop maintenance, and in-store staff, while at the same time reaching a much wider customer base.
advantage-disadvantage:2.chinese: 透過線上銷售，企業可以降低與租金、店面維護及店內員工相關的成本，同時接觸到更廣大的顧客群。

advantage-disadvantage:2.english: A small independent bookshop, for instance, can move beyond relying on local foot traffic and sell to buyers across the country through a website or online marketplace.
advantage-disadvantage:2.chinese: 例如，一家小型獨立書店可以透過網站或網上市場，把書賣給全國各地的買家，無須再單靠本地客流。

advantage-disadvantage:2.english: As a result, online retailing increases accessibility for consumers and improves commercial efficiency for firms.
advantage-disadvantage:2.chinese: 因此，線上零售提升了消費者的可及性，也改善了企業的商業效率。

advantage-disadvantage:2.english: However, online shopping also has clear disadvantages.
advantage-disadvantage:2.chinese: 然而，網上購物也有明顯的缺點。

advantage-disadvantage:2.english: For individuals, the inability to inspect products physically means that purchases are often based only on pictures and descriptions, which can be misleading.
advantage-disadvantage:2.chinese: 對個人而言，無法親自檢查商品意味著購買往往只能根據圖片與描述作出，而這些資訊可能具有誤導性。

advantage-disadvantage:2.english: This can lead to disappointment when an item arrives in the wrong size, poor quality, or a different appearance from what was advertised.
advantage-disadvantage:2.chinese: 這可能導致失望，因為商品送達時可能尺寸不對、品質不佳，或外觀與廣告宣傳不符。

advantage-disadvantage:2.english: Someone who buys clothing or furniture online, for example, may have to go through an inconvenient returns process after discovering that the product does not meet expectations.
advantage-disadvantage:2.chinese: 例如，某人若在網上購買衣服或家具，發現商品不符合預期後，可能必須經歷一個麻煩的退貨流程。

advantage-disadvantage:2.english: For companies, the digital marketplace is highly competitive and fragile.
advantage-disadvantage:2.chinese: 對企業而言，數位市場競爭非常激烈，而且相當脆弱。

advantage-disadvantage:2.english: Because customers can compare dozens of sellers instantly, businesses are forced into price competition that can reduce profit margins.
advantage-disadvantage:2.chinese: 由於顧客能夠立即比較數十家賣家，企業被迫陷入價格競爭，而這可能壓縮利潤空間。

advantage-disadvantage:2.english: In addition, one delivery failure, data breach, or widely shared negative review can rapidly damage a company’s reputation.
advantage-disadvantage:2.chinese: 此外，一次配送失誤、資料外洩，或一則被廣泛傳播的負評，都可能迅速損害一家公司的聲譽。

advantage-disadvantage:2.english: Therefore, while e-commerce offers speed and reach, it also exposes both shoppers and firms to significant risks.
advantage-disadvantage:2.chinese: 因此，雖然電子商務提供了速度與廣泛觸及的優勢，但它也使消費者與企業同時面臨重大的風險。

advantage-disadvantage:2.english: In conclusion, online shopping does present disadvantages, particularly product uncertainty for consumers and competitive pressure for businesses.
advantage-disadvantage:2.chinese: 總結來說，網上購物確實帶來缺點，尤其是消費者面臨商品不確定性，以及企業承受競爭壓力。

advantage-disadvantage:2.english: Nevertheless, because it provides greater convenience for individuals and lower costs together with broader market access for companies, the advantages of shopping online clearly outweigh the disadvantages.
advantage-disadvantage:2.chinese: 然而，由於它為個人帶來更大的便利，也為企業帶來更低的成本與更廣的市場接觸，因此網上購物的優點明顯大於缺點。

advantage-disadvantage:3.english: It has become increasingly common for school-leavers to spend a gap year doing charitable work in less developed countries before entering university.
advantage-disadvantage:3.chinese: 在進入大學前先花一年到海外從事慈善工作，已愈來愈成為離校生常見的選擇。

advantage-disadvantage:3.english: Although this choice can create emotional and academic difficulties, it is ultimately a highly positive experience for young people because it develops maturity and gives them a far deeper understanding of society than a conventional year at home would.
advantage-disadvantage:3.chinese: 雖然這個決定可能帶來情緒壓力，並打亂原有的學習習慣，本文將論證，這樣的經歷對年輕人而言最終是有益的，因為它能加速個人成長，並加深他們對社會的理解。

advantage-disadvantage:3.english: The primary advantage is accelerated personal growth.
advantage-disadvantage:3.chinese: 到海外從事義工工作的第一個優點，是它能促進快速的個人成長。

advantage-disadvantage:3.english: When young volunteers live abroad, they must budget, solve practical problems and communicate in unfamiliar settings without the daily support of parents or teachers.
advantage-disadvantage:3.chinese: 生活在一個陌生的國家，會迫使年輕人自己管理金錢、處理日常問題，並在沒有父母或老師持續支援的情況下獨立與人溝通。

advantage-disadvantage:3.english: This pushes them to become more self-reliant, adaptable and resilient, which are precisely the qualities needed for university life and later employment.
advantage-disadvantage:3.chinese: 因此，他們會變得更獨立、更有適應力，也更堅韌，而這些正是大學生活及未來就業所必需的特質。

advantage-disadvantage:3.english: A student helping to organise food distribution, for example, may need to cope with transport failures, limited resources and language barriers on a daily basis.
advantage-disadvantage:3.chinese: 例如，一名協助安排糧食分發的學生，可能每天都要處理交通失誤、資源不足以及語言障礙。

advantage-disadvantage:3.english: A second benefit is the way such work broadens moral and intellectual perspective.
advantage-disadvantage:3.chinese: 義工工作也能擴闊年輕人的道德與思想視野。

advantage-disadvantage:3.english: Seeing inadequate schooling, poor sanitation or limited medical care at first hand turns abstract global issues into concrete human realities.
advantage-disadvantage:3.chinese: 親眼看到教育體系薄弱、衛生條件惡劣或醫療資源不足，會把抽象的全球問題轉化為具體的人類現實。

advantage-disadvantage:3.english: As a result, many young people become more socially aware and more purposeful about their future.
advantage-disadvantage:3.chinese: 這往往會使義工變得更有社會意識，也更清楚自己未來的人生方向。

advantage-disadvantage:3.english: Someone who assists in a rural clinic, for instance, may return home determined to study medicine, public health or international development.
advantage-disadvantage:3.chinese: 例如，一位在鄉村診所幫忙的人，回國後可能會下定決心修讀醫學、公共衛生或國際發展。基於以上原因，義工工作能在個人層面與思想層面同時令年輕人受益。
然而，主要的缺點在於情緒壓力與學業中斷。

advantage-disadvantage:3.english: One is the emotional strain of working in communities affected by poverty, illness or trauma.
advantage-disadvantage:3.chinese: 在受貧窮、疾病或創傷影響的社區工作，對於心理上仍未成熟的青少年而言，可能會造成沉重的心理負擔。

advantage-disadvantage:3.english: Many teenagers are still psychologically inexperienced, so constant exposure to suffering can leave them distressed, guilty or overwhelmed rather than inspired.
advantage-disadvantage:3.chinese: 長期接觸苦難，可能不會令他們受到鼓舞，反而會使他們感到痛苦、內疚或不堪負荷。

advantage-disadvantage:3.english: A volunteer in an orphanage, for example, may form strong attachments and then find the eventual separation deeply upsetting.
advantage-disadvantage:3.chinese: 例如，一名在孤兒院服務的義工，可能會與孩子建立深厚感情，而最終的分離則會令他十分難受。

advantage-disadvantage:3.english: Another drawback is that a gap year can weaken academic momentum.
advantage-disadvantage:3.chinese: 空檔年也可能削弱原有的學習節奏。

advantage-disadvantage:3.english: After spending many months outside formal education, some students struggle to readjust to lectures, deadlines and examinations, especially when university courses demand intense concentration from the outset.
advantage-disadvantage:3.chinese: 在離開正規教育數月之後，有些學生在大學開始時，會難以重新適應講課、截止日期和考試。尤其當學位課程一開始就要求高度專注與嚴格的學習習慣時，這種情況更為明顯。

advantage-disadvantage:3.english: For example, a school-leaver who has spent a year on construction or community projects may find essay writing and exam preparation unexpectedly difficult on returning to study.
advantage-disadvantage:3.chinese: 例如，一名把一年時間投入建設或社區項目的畢業生，在回到校園後，可能會發現寫論文與準備考試比預期更困難。即便如此，這些缺點仍不足以蓋過這段經歷的長遠價值。

advantage-disadvantage:3.english: In conclusion, volunteering abroad is not an easy option for young people, as it can be emotionally demanding and can interrupt study habits.
advantage-disadvantage:3.chinese: 總而言之，我認為在空檔年到海外從事義工工作，對年輕人而言最終是利大於弊的。

advantage-disadvantage:3.english: Even so, it remains a profoundly worthwhile experience, since few alternatives cultivate independence, perspective and long-term purpose so effectively.
advantage-disadvantage:3.chinese: 雖然它可能帶來情緒壓力並打斷學習習慣，但它能培養獨立性、韌性與社會意識，而這些往往是一般經歷難以帶來的。

advantage-disadvantage:4.english: Change is an inevitable part of modern life, yet people respond to it in very different ways.
advantage-disadvantage:4.chinese: [改變是現代生活中不可避免的一部分，然而人們對它的反應卻非常不同。]

advantage-disadvantage:4.english: While some actively welcome new experiences, others prefer to protect their routines and avoid disruption whenever possible.
advantage-disadvantage:4.chinese: [有些人會主動迎接新的經驗，另一些人則傾向維持原有的生活規律，並在可能的情況下避免干擾。]

advantage-disadvantage:4.english: Although both approaches bring certain benefits and drawbacks, embracing change is ultimately the more advantageous mindset because it fosters adaptability and growth, whereas avoiding change mainly provides short-term security.
advantage-disadvantage:4.chinese: [雖然這兩種做法都有一些優點和缺點，但擁抱改變最終是更有利的心態，因為它能培養適應力與成長，而避免改變主要只是提供短期的安全感。]

advantage-disadvantage:4.english: People who enjoy change usually gain stronger long-term benefits, even though this way of life is not without cost.
advantage-disadvantage:4.chinese: [喜歡改變的人通常能獲得更強的長遠好處，儘管這種生活方式並非毫無代價。]

advantage-disadvantage:4.english: When individuals enter unfamiliar situations, they are forced to learn new skills, solve unexpected problems and interact with different kinds of people, which gradually makes them more resilient and capable.
advantage-disadvantage:4.chinese: [當人們進入陌生情境時，他們會被迫學習新技能、解決意料之外的問題，並與不同類型的人互動，而這些過程會逐漸令他們變得更有韌性、更有能力。]

advantage-disadvantage:4.english: For example, a graduate who moves abroad for work must adjust to a new culture, new colleagues and new expectations, and this process often leaves them more confident and employable.
advantage-disadvantage:4.chinese: [例如，一位到國外工作的畢業生必須適應新的文化、新的同事以及新的期待，而這個過程往往會讓他變得更有自信，也更具就業競爭力。]

advantage-disadvantage:4.english: However, constant change can also create instability.
advantage-disadvantage:4.chinese: [然而，不斷的改變也可能造成不穩定。]

advantage-disadvantage:4.english: If someone changes jobs, cities or relationships too frequently, they may struggle to build lasting support networks or any real sense of security.
advantage-disadvantage:4.chinese: [如果一個人過於頻繁地更換工作、城市或人際關係，他們可能難以建立持久的支持網絡，或任何真正的安全感。]

advantage-disadvantage:4.english: A worker who continually moves from one short-term role to another, for instance, may enjoy variety, but may also feel financially and emotionally unsettled.
advantage-disadvantage:4.chinese: [例如，一位不斷在不同短期工作之間轉換的員工，也許會享受多樣性，但同時也可能在經濟和情緒上感到不安定。][即便如此，改變所帶來的個人成長，往往仍然大於它暫時造成的不穩定。]

advantage-disadvantage:4.english: By contrast, people who try to avoid change benefit from stability, but this preference can easily become a serious limitation.
advantage-disadvantage:4.chinese: [相比之下，試圖避免改變的人可以從穩定中獲益，但這種偏好也很容易成為一種嚴重的限制。]

advantage-disadvantage:4.english: Remaining in a familiar environment reduces stress because routines are predictable, responsibilities are clear and long-term relationships can deepen over time.
advantage-disadvantage:4.chinese: [留在熟悉的環境中能減少壓力，因為生活規律是可預測的、責任是清晰的，而且長期關係也能隨時間加深。]

advantage-disadvantage:4.english: Someone who stays in one community for many years, for example, may enjoy close friendships, a reliable support system and a steady career path.
advantage-disadvantage:4.chinese: [例如，一個在同一個社區生活多年的人，可能會擁有親密的友誼、可靠的支持系統，以及穩定的職涯道路。]

advantage-disadvantage:4.english: The disadvantage, however, is that excessive caution often leads to stagnation.
advantage-disadvantage:4.chinese: [然而，這種做法的缺點在於，過度謹慎往往會導致停滯。]

advantage-disadvantage:4.english: When people reject new technology, training or opportunities simply because these feel uncomfortable, they may fall behind both personally and professionally.
advantage-disadvantage:4.chinese: [當人們只是因為新科技、培訓或機會讓人感到不舒服，就拒絕接受它們時，他們可能會在個人和職業層面上同時落後。]

advantage-disadvantage:4.english: An employee who refuses to learn new digital systems may preserve the comfort of old habits for a while, but may eventually become less useful in a changing workplace.
advantage-disadvantage:4.chinese: [一名拒絕學習新數位系統的員工，也許能暫時保住舊習慣帶來的舒適感，但最終可能會在不斷改變的職場中變得不那麼有用。][基於這一點，避免改變所獲得的穩定，往往會被這種謹慎所扼殺的機會抵消。]

advantage-disadvantage:4.english: In conclusion, both attitudes have understandable advantages: enjoying change encourages development, while avoiding it offers stability.
advantage-disadvantage:4.chinese: [總而言之，雖然這兩種態度都提供了一些好處，但擁抱改變顯然是更好的做法。]

advantage-disadvantage:4.english: Nevertheless, welcoming change is clearly the better approach, because a flexible person can still create stability, whereas an inflexible one may lose valuable opportunities that never return.
advantage-disadvantage:4.chinese: [這是因為它能促進韌性、成長與適應力；相反地，避免改變主要只是提供暫時的舒適，卻同時增加停滯與錯失機會的風險。]

advantage-disadvantage:5.english: In both working life and private life, a growing proportion of communication is now conducted through digital technology instead of face-to-face interaction.
advantage-disadvantage:5.chinese: 無論在工作還是私人生活中，越來越多的溝通如今都是透過數位科技進行，而不是面對面交流。

advantage-disadvantage:5.english: Although this development can weaken the quality of human relationships and increase the risk of misunderstanding, I believe its advantages are greater overall because it makes communication far more efficient and keeps people connected despite geographical separation.
advantage-disadvantage:5.chinese: 儘管這種發展可能削弱人際關係的品質，並增加誤解的風險，我認為整體而言，它的優點更大，因為它使溝通更有效率，並能讓人們即使相隔遙遠也保持聯繫。

advantage-disadvantage:5.english: The main benefit of technology-based communication is speed and convenience.
advantage-disadvantage:5.chinese: 科技化溝通最主要的優點是速度和便利性。

advantage-disadvantage:5.english: In professional settings, email, messaging platforms and video conferencing remove the need for travel and allow decisions to be made almost immediately.
advantage-disadvantage:5.chinese: 在專業環境中，電子郵件、即時通訊平台和視像會議免除了人們出行的需要，並使決策幾乎可以即時作出。

advantage-disadvantage:5.english: This shortens response times, reduces operating costs and enables companies to coordinate teams across different cities or even continents with remarkable ease.
advantage-disadvantage:5.chinese: 這不但縮短了回應時間、降低了營運成本，還使公司能夠非常輕鬆地協調分布在不同城市甚至不同大洲的團隊。

advantage-disadvantage:5.english: For instance, a manager can resolve a production issue with overseas colleagues in a single online meeting rather than waiting days for an in-person discussion.
advantage-disadvantage:5.chinese: 例如，一位經理可以透過一次線上會議便與海外同事解決生產問題，而不是等待數天才進行一次面對面的討論。

advantage-disadvantage:5.english: The same principle applies socially: parents, children and friends who live far apart can speak daily through calls and messages, thereby maintaining close relationships that might otherwise weaken over time.
advantage-disadvantage:5.chinese: 同樣的情況也適用於社交層面：住得很遠的父母、子女和朋友仍然可以透過通話和訊息每天聯絡。結果是，人際關係更容易維持，也較不會隨時間而逐漸淡化。例如，一個家庭即使成員分散在不同國家，仍然可以透過視像通話分享日常近況並提供情感支持。因此，數位溝通大大提升了工作和個人生活中的效率與可及性。

advantage-disadvantage:5.english: Nevertheless, digital communication has important drawbacks, the most serious of which is its lack of emotional richness.
advantage-disadvantage:5.chinese: 然而，數位溝通也有重要的缺點，其中最嚴重的是它缺乏情感上的豐富性。

advantage-disadvantage:5.english: Face-to-face conversation conveys tone, facial expression and body language, which help people interpret meaning accurately, show empathy and build trust.
advantage-disadvantage:5.chinese: 面對面的交談能傳達語氣、面部表情和肢體語言，這些都有助於人們準確理解意思、表達同理心並建立信任。

advantage-disadvantage:5.english: When these cues disappear, messages are more easily misread; a brief email or text, for example, may sound cold or hostile even when no offence was intended.
advantage-disadvantage:5.chinese: 當這些線索消失時，訊息便更容易被誤解，從而導致困惑甚至衝突。例如，一封簡短的電郵或文字訊息即使本無惡意，也可能顯得冷淡甚至帶有敵意。

advantage-disadvantage:5.english: This is especially problematic in workplaces, where trust and nuance are essential for leadership, negotiation and teamwork.
advantage-disadvantage:5.chinese: 這在職場中尤其成問題，因為信任和細膩的理解對領導、協商和團隊合作都至關重要。

advantage-disadvantage:5.english: Over time, heavy reliance on screens may also encourage shallow social habits.
advantage-disadvantage:5.chinese: 長遠而言，過度依賴螢幕也可能助長膚淺的社交習慣，因此人們即使在線上一直保持聯絡，仍可能感到孤立。

advantage-disadvantage:5.english: People can remain constantly in contact online yet still feel isolated, because frequent messaging is not the same as receiving genuine attention and human presence.
advantage-disadvantage:5.chinese: 例如，一個人即使經常透過社交媒體聊天，仍可能感到孤單，因為數位接觸始終無法完全取代真正的關注和人的陪伴。因此，儘管科技讓溝通成為可能，它同時也可能削弱清晰度、信任感和情感深度。

advantage-disadvantage:5.english: In conclusion, communicating through technology offers clear advantages in terms of efficiency and accessibility, even though it may reduce the depth and clarity of human interaction.
advantage-disadvantage:5.chinese: 總結來說，透過科技進行溝通在效率和可及性方面具有明顯優勢，儘管它可能削弱人際互動的深度與清晰度。

advantage-disadvantage:5.english: Overall, I believe the benefits outweigh the disadvantages because digital tools allow both professional and personal communication to function effectively across time and distance.
advantage-disadvantage:5.chinese: 整體而言，我認為其優點大於缺點，因為數位工具使工作和個人生活中的溝通都能跨越時間與距離而有效運作。

advantage-disadvantage:6.english: In today’s highly connected world, digital communication has made it possible for people from different countries to interact instantly and regularly.
advantage-disadvantage:6.chinese: 在當今高度互聯的世界裡，數位溝通已使來自不同國家的人能夠即時而持續地互動。

advantage-disadvantage:6.english: Through social media, messaging apps and video calls, individuals who would otherwise never meet are now able to exchange ideas, build relationships and work together.
advantage-disadvantage:6.chinese: 透過社交媒體、即時通訊應用程式和視像通話，那些原本根本沒有機會相遇的人，如今也能交流想法、建立關係並彼此合作。

advantage-disadvantage:6.english: This is an overwhelmingly positive development because it expands access to valuable opportunities and promotes greater understanding between societies, although a few disadvantages do exist.
advantage-disadvantage:6.chinese: 這無疑是一項整體上非常正面的發展，因為它擴大了人們接觸寶貴機會的途徑，並促進了不同社會之間更深入的理解，儘管它確實也存在一些缺點。

advantage-disadvantage:6.english: The most significant advantage is that online international communication gives people access to relationships and opportunities that geography would normally prevent.
advantage-disadvantage:6.chinese: 最重要的優點是，跨國網上溝通讓人們得以接觸那些原本會因地理限制而無法建立的人際關係與機會。

advantage-disadvantage:6.english: A student in Hong Kong, for instance, can seek advice from a university mentor in Britain, join an online discussion group with members from several countries, and later develop academic or professional connections that would have been impossible in the past.
advantage-disadvantage:6.chinese: 例如，一名身在香港的學生可以向英國的大學導師請教，加入由多個國家成員組成的網上討論群組，並進一步發展出過去根本不可能建立的學術或專業聯繫。

advantage-disadvantage:6.english: This matters because such interaction is not merely casual conversation; it can lead to practical outcomes such as improved education, better employment prospects and broader career networks.
advantage-disadvantage:6.chinese: 這一點之所以重要，是因為這種互動並不只是隨意閒聊；它可以帶來實際成果，例如提升教育機會、改善就業前景，以及擴闊職業人脈網絡。

advantage-disadvantage:6.english: Another major benefit is that regular contact with people from other cultures can reduce ignorance and prejudice.
advantage-disadvantage:6.chinese: 另一項主要好處是，與不同文化背景的人保持經常接觸，可以減少無知與偏見。

advantage-disadvantage:6.english: When individuals communicate directly with foreigners, they are exposed to different customs, viewpoints and lifestyles, which makes them more open-minded and better prepared for life in a globalised society.
advantage-disadvantage:6.chinese: 當人們直接與外國人交流時，他們會接觸到不同的習俗、觀點和生活方式，這會使他們變得更開放，也更能為全球化社會中的生活作好準備。

advantage-disadvantage:6.english: Therefore, online international communication is highly beneficial because it creates both practical opportunities and deeper intercultural understanding.
advantage-disadvantage:6.chinese: 因此，跨國網上溝通極具價值，因為它同時創造了實際機會，並促進了更深層次的跨文化理解。
然而，這種溝通方式也的確存在一些缺點。

advantage-disadvantage:6.english: The most serious is that online platforms can spread false or harmful information across borders with alarming speed.
advantage-disadvantage:6.chinese: 其中最嚴重的一點是，網上平台能夠以驚人的速度跨越國界傳播錯誤或有害的信息。

advantage-disadvantage:6.english: Misleading claims about politics, health or social issues can reach large audiences before they are corrected, which may create confusion or mistrust.
advantage-disadvantage:6.chinese: 有關政治、健康或社會議題的誤導性言論，往往在被更正之前便已傳播給大量受眾，從而造成混亂或不信任。

advantage-disadvantage:6.english: In addition, digital interaction can sometimes be less genuine than face-to-face communication.
advantage-disadvantage:6.chinese: 此外，數位互動有時不如面對面交流那樣真誠。

advantage-disadvantage:6.english: Because people can hide behind anonymous accounts or present edited versions of themselves, online relationships may occasionally be superficial or even deceptive.
advantage-disadvantage:6.chinese: 由於人們可以躲在匿名帳戶背後，或只展示經過修飾的自己，網上關係有時可能流於表面，甚至帶有欺騙性。

advantage-disadvantage:6.english: Nevertheless, these problems are relatively limited and are usually caused by irresponsible use of technology rather than by international communication itself.
advantage-disadvantage:6.chinese: 儘管如此，這些問題相對有限，而且通常是由不負責任地使用科技所造成的，而非跨國網上溝通本身所必然導致的結果。

advantage-disadvantage:6.english: In conclusion, the ability to communicate online with people from other countries brings substantial benefits, especially by creating opportunities and encouraging intercultural understanding.
advantage-disadvantage:6.chinese: 總結來說，能夠在網上與來自其他國家的人交流，帶來了重大的好處，尤其體現在創造機會以及促進跨文化理解方面。

advantage-disadvantage:6.english: Although it may also enable misinformation and insincere interaction, these drawbacks are minor in comparison, so the overall effect is clearly positive.
advantage-disadvantage:6.chinese: 雖然它也可能助長錯誤資訊的傳播，以及不夠真誠的互動，但與其優點相比，這些缺點只是次要的。因此，整體影響顯然是正面的。

advantage-disadvantage:7.english: In many legal systems, judges are expected to decide punishments after considering both the crime itself and the circumstances surrounding it.
advantage-disadvantage:7.chinese: 在許多法律制度中，法官在決定刑罰時，須考慮罪行本身及其相關情況。

advantage-disadvantage:7.english: Some people, however, argue that a system of fixed punishments would be more efficient.
advantage-disadvantage:7.chinese: 然而，有些人認為固定刑罰制度會更有效率。

advantage-disadvantage:7.english: While this approach does offer certain practical benefits, I believe its disadvantages are considerably greater because it would undermine justice and could even worsen crime in the long term.
advantage-disadvantage:7.chinese: 雖然這種做法確有一些實際好處，但我認為其缺點大得多，因為它會損害公正，長遠甚至可能令犯罪問題惡化。

advantage-disadvantage:7.english: The main advantage of fixed sentencing is that it would make the legal process faster and more straightforward.
advantage-disadvantage:7.chinese: 固定判刑的主要優點，是它能令法律程序更快、更簡明。

advantage-disadvantage:7.english: If the penalty for each offence were predetermined, courts would spend less time debating the appropriate sentence, which would reduce delays and lower administrative costs.
advantage-disadvantage:7.chinese: 如果每項罪行的刑罰已預先訂明，法院便可少花時間討論合適刑期，從而減少延誤及降低行政成本。

advantage-disadvantage:7.english: As a result, cases could be resolved more quickly, and victims would not have to wait as long for closure.
advantage-disadvantage:7.chinese: 因此，案件可以更快解決，受害者也不用等那麼久才能等到事情告一段落。
另一個好處是判刑更一致。

advantage-disadvantage:7.english: When punishments are standardised, similar offences are more likely to receive similar penalties, which may strengthen public confidence in the justice system.
advantage-disadvantage:7.chinese: 當刑罰標準化時，類似罪行便更可能受到相似處罰，這或能加強公眾對司法制度的信心。

advantage-disadvantage:7.english: For example, fixed fines and licence suspensions for traffic offences are often accepted because they are transparent and easy for the public to understand.
advantage-disadvantage:7.chinese: 例如，交通違規的固定罰款及停牌處分往往獲得接受，因為規則透明，公眾亦容易理解。

advantage-disadvantage:7.english: Nevertheless, the disadvantages of such a system are far more serious.
advantage-disadvantage:7.chinese: 儘管如此，這種制度的缺點遠為嚴重。

advantage-disadvantage:7.english: Most importantly, fixed punishments ignore the fact that crimes differ enormously in motive, severity and context.
advantage-disadvantage:7.chinese: 最重要的是，固定刑罰忽略了罪行在動機、嚴重程度及案情背景方面可能有極大差異。

advantage-disadvantage:7.english: A person who steals food out of desperation should not automatically receive the same sentence as a repeat offender who commits theft for profit.
advantage-disadvantage:7.chinese: 因困境而偷食物的人，不應自動與屢次為牟利而偷竊的人受到相同刑罰。

advantage-disadvantage:7.english: If the law fails to recognise such differences, justice becomes mechanical rather than fair.
advantage-disadvantage:7.chinese: 如果法律未能辨別這些差異，司法便會變得機械化，而非公平。

advantage-disadvantage:7.english: In addition, rigid sentencing can damage rehabilitation and ultimately make society less safe.
advantage-disadvantage:7.chinese: 此外，僵硬的判刑方式可能妨礙犯人改過，最終令社會變得較不安全。

advantage-disadvantage:7.english: When first-time or low-risk offenders are given the same punishment as hardened criminals, they may leave prison more alienated, less employable and more likely to reoffend.
advantage-disadvantage:7.chinese: 當初犯或低風險犯人與慣犯受到相同刑罰時，他們離開監獄後可能更加疏離、更難就業，也更可能再犯。

advantage-disadvantage:7.english: For instance, a teenager involved in a minor drug offence may be pushed further into criminal behaviour if treated identically to an experienced trafficker.
advantage-disadvantage:7.chinese: 例如，涉及較輕微毒品罪行的青少年，如果受到與有經驗的販運者完全相同的處理，可能會更深陷犯罪行為。

advantage-disadvantage:7.english: In conclusion, fixed punishments may improve efficiency and consistency, but these benefits are outweighed by their profound weaknesses.
advantage-disadvantage:7.chinese: 總結來說，固定刑罰或能提升效率與一致性，但這些好處仍不足以抵消其深層弱點。

advantage-disadvantage:7.english: Because crime must be judged in relation to both the act and the offender, a flexible sentencing system is clearly the more just and effective approach.
advantage-disadvantage:7.chinese: 因為判斷罪行時必須同時考慮行為本身及行為人，有彈性的判刑制度顯然是更公正、更有效的做法。

advantage-disadvantage:8.english: Schools are increasingly expected to prepare young people not only for academic success but also for life in an interconnected world.
advantage-disadvantage:8.chinese: 人們越來越期望學校不只幫助年輕人取得學業成就，也要為他們在互相連繫的世界中生活做好準備。

advantage-disadvantage:8.english: In this context, some educators argue that international exchange visits are beneficial for teenagers.
advantage-disadvantage:8.chinese: 在這種背景下，一些教育工作者認為國際交流訪問對青少年有益。

advantage-disadvantage:8.english: I strongly believe that the advantages of these programmes far outweigh the disadvantages, because they develop maturity and intercultural competence in ways that ordinary classroom learning rarely can, whereas the drawbacks are generally short-lived and manageable.
advantage-disadvantage:8.chinese: 我深信這些計劃的優點遠大於缺點，因為它們能以一般課堂學習難以做到的方式培養成熟度和跨文化能力，而缺點通常短暫且可以處理。

advantage-disadvantage:8.english: The greatest advantage of international exchange visits is that they accelerate teenagers’ personal growth.
advantage-disadvantage:8.chinese: 國際交流訪問最大的優點是能加快青少年的個人成長。

advantage-disadvantage:8.english: When students spend time in a different country, they are forced to deal with unfamiliar routines, different school expectations and everyday practical challenges without depending entirely on their parents.
advantage-disadvantage:8.chinese: 當學生在另一個國家生活一段時間，他們必須在未能完全依賴父母的情況下，應付陌生的日常安排、不同的學校要求和生活中的實際難題。

advantage-disadvantage:8.english: This process makes them more independent, adaptable and responsible.
advantage-disadvantage:8.chinese: 這個過程使他們更獨立、更能適應變化，也更有責任感。

advantage-disadvantage:8.english: For example, a student staying with a host family may initially struggle to follow a new timetable or communicate minor needs, but very quickly that student learns to ask questions confidently, manage time more effectively and solve problems calmly.
advantage-disadvantage:8.chinese: 例如，寄宿在接待家庭的學生起初可能難以適應新的時間表，或難以說明一些日常需要；但不久後，學生便學會有信心地發問、更有效地安排時間，並冷靜地解決問題。

advantage-disadvantage:8.english: A second major benefit is that these visits deepen cultural and linguistic understanding.
advantage-disadvantage:8.chinese: 第二個主要好處是這類訪問能加深學生對文化和語言的理解。

advantage-disadvantage:8.english: Instead of learning about another society in an abstract way, teenagers experience it directly through conversation, school life and daily interaction.
advantage-disadvantage:8.chinese: 青少年不再只是抽象地學習另一個社會，而是透過交談、學校生活和日常互動直接體驗它。

advantage-disadvantage:8.english: As a result, they often become more open-minded and more capable of communicating with people from different backgrounds.
advantage-disadvantage:8.chinese: 因此，他們往往變得更願意接納不同觀點，也更能與不同背景的人溝通。

advantage-disadvantage:8.english: Admittedly, there are some disadvantages, but they are not significant enough to challenge the overall value of such visits.
advantage-disadvantage:8.chinese: 無可否認，這類訪問有一些缺點，但不足以動搖其整體價值。

advantage-disadvantage:8.english: One concern is cost, since travel, accommodation and insurance can be expensive.
advantage-disadvantage:8.chinese: 其中一個顧慮是費用，因為旅費、住宿費和保險費可能很高。

advantage-disadvantage:8.english: However, many exchange programmes are short, subsidised or organised through school partnerships, so the financial burden is often reduced considerably.
advantage-disadvantage:8.chinese: 然而，許多交流計劃時間較短、獲得資助，或透過學校夥伴關係舉辦，因此經濟負擔往往能大幅減輕。

advantage-disadvantage:8.english: Another possible drawback is that some teenagers may feel homesick or anxious in an unfamiliar environment.
advantage-disadvantage:8.chinese: 另一個可能的缺點是，一些青少年在陌生環境中可能會想家或感到焦慮。

advantage-disadvantage:8.english: Nevertheless, this discomfort is usually temporary and can even be beneficial, because overcoming it helps young people build emotional resilience.
advantage-disadvantage:8.chinese: 儘管如此，這種不適通常是短暫的，甚至可能有益，因為克服它能幫助年輕人培養情緒韌性。

advantage-disadvantage:8.english: For instance, a student who feels lonely during the first few days of an exchange often returns home noticeably more confident after forming friendships and adapting successfully.
advantage-disadvantage:8.chinese: 例如，交流開始幾天感到孤單的學生，在結識朋友並成功適應後，回家時往往明顯更有信心。

advantage-disadvantage:8.english: In conclusion, international exchange visits offer teenagers far more than a simple change of scenery.
advantage-disadvantage:8.chinese: 總結來說，國際交流訪問給青少年的收穫遠不止換個環境看看。

advantage-disadvantage:8.english: Because they foster independence, cultural awareness and real-world communication skills, and because their disadvantages are limited and manageable, their advantages decisively outweigh their disadvantages.
advantage-disadvantage:8.chinese: 因為這類訪問能培養獨立性、文化意識和現實生活中的溝通能力，而其缺點有限且可以處理，所以優點明顯大於缺點。

advantage-disadvantage:9.english: In many schools, uniforms are treated as a basic part of discipline, while others allow children to dress with far more freedom.
advantage-disadvantage:9.chinese: 在許多學校中，校服被視為紀律的基本部分，而另一些學校則容許學生在衣著上有更多自由。

advantage-disadvantage:9.english: Requiring pupils to wear a uniform has several clear benefits, especially in relation to equality and school identity, but it can also create problems for self-expression and family finances.
advantage-disadvantage:9.chinese: 要求學生穿校服有幾個明顯好處，尤其是在平等和學校身份認同方面；但它也可能在自我表達和家庭財政方面帶來問題。

advantage-disadvantage:9.english: One major advantage is that a uniform reduces visible social differences among children.
advantage-disadvantage:9.chinese: 其中一個主要優點是，校服可以減少孩子之間外在可見的社會差異。

advantage-disadvantage:9.english: If everyone wears similar clothes, pupils from poorer families are less likely to feel embarrassed by cheap or unfashionable outfits, and wealthier pupils have fewer chances to display expensive brands.
advantage-disadvantage:9.chinese: 如果每個人都穿著相似的衣服，來自較貧困家庭的學生便較不容易因為衣服便宜或不時尚而感到尷尬，而較富裕的學生也較少機會展示昂貴品牌。

advantage-disadvantage:9.english: This can make the classroom feel like a more equal place, where children are judged more by their behaviour and effort than by what they wear.
advantage-disadvantage:9.chinese: 這可以令課室感覺上更平等，孩子受到評價時，更多是基於他們的行為和努力，而不是他們穿甚麼。

advantage-disadvantage:9.english: Uniforms can also strengthen a sense of belonging.
advantage-disadvantage:9.chinese: 校服也可以加強學生的歸屬感。

advantage-disadvantage:9.english: A child who puts on the same colours and badge as their classmates may feel that they are part of a shared community, much like a sports team whose kit quietly reminds its members that they represent something larger than themselves.
