advantage-disadvantage:30.english: When communication happens mainly through screens, spontaneous conversations, informal mentoring, and team cohesion all decline.
advantage-disadvantage:30.chinese: 當溝通主要透過螢幕進行時，自發交談、非正式指導和團隊凝聚力都會減少。

advantage-disadvantage:30.english: This is particularly damaging for younger staff, who often learn by observing experienced colleagues solve problems in real time.
advantage-disadvantage:30.chinese: 這對較年輕的員工尤其有害，因為他們往往透過觀察資深同事如何即時解決問題來學習。

advantage-disadvantage:30.english: For example, a new employee may receive formal instructions online yet still miss the quick advice that would naturally be available in a shared office.
advantage-disadvantage:30.chinese: 例如，新員工即使在網上收到正式指示，仍可能錯過在共用辦公室自然會得到的即時建議。

advantage-disadvantage:30.english: A second drawback is that home working can erase the boundary between work and private life.
advantage-disadvantage:30.chinese: 第二項缺點是，在家工作可能抹去工作與私人生活之間的界線。

advantage-disadvantage:30.english: Because the laptop is always nearby, some people keep checking messages late into the evening.
advantage-disadvantage:30.chinese: 由於手提電腦總在身邊，有些人到了晚上仍不斷查看訊息。

advantage-disadvantage:30.english: A manager who replies to emails after dinner every night, for example, may gradually slip into fatigue and burnout instead of enjoying genuine flexibility.
advantage-disadvantage:30.chinese: 例如，一位每晚飯後都回覆電郵的經理，可能漸漸陷入疲勞與職業倦怠，而不是享受真正的彈性。

advantage-disadvantage:30.english: In conclusion, working online from home brings real drawbacks, but it remains a positive development overall.
advantage-disadvantage:30.chinese: 總括而言，在家線上工作的增加確實帶來一些缺點，但整體上仍屬正面發展。

advantage-disadvantage:30.english: While it can reduce face-to-face interaction and encourage overwork, its benefits for well-being and access to employment are more significant.
advantage-disadvantage:30.chinese: 雖然在家工作可能減少面對面交流並助長過度工作，但它對福祉和就業機會的好處更重要。

cause-solution:2.english: Large companies are often able to spend heavily on advertising, sponsorship and online promotion, so their products become more visible than those made by smaller local producers.
cause-solution:2.chinese: 大型企業通常有能力在廣告、贊助和網上推廣方面投入大量資金，因此它們的產品會比小型本地生產商所製造的產品更加顯眼。

cause-solution:2.english: This trend can damage local economies and weaken choice, but measures can make local goods easier to buy.
cause-solution:2.chinese: 這種趨勢可能損害本地經濟並削弱消費者選擇，但一些措施可以令本地產品更容易被購買。

cause-solution:2.english: The first problem is that smaller firms are pushed into the shadows.
cause-solution:2.chinese: 第一個問題是，小型企業會被推到陰影之中。

cause-solution:2.english: When shoppers repeatedly see the same brands on television, social media and supermarket shelves, they tend to trust those names almost automatically, even when a local alternative is just as good.
cause-solution:2.chinese: 當消費者不斷在電視、社交媒體和超市貨架上看到相同品牌時，他們往往會幾乎自動地信任這些品牌名稱，即使本地替代產品同樣出色。

cause-solution:2.english: As sales move towards large corporations, independent shops and small manufacturers lose revenue, cut jobs and, in the worst cases, close altogether.
cause-solution:2.chinese: 隨著銷售額流向大型企業，獨立商店和小型製造商會失去收入、削減職位，最嚴重時甚至完全結業。

cause-solution:2.english: This drains money from the community and leaves high streets less varied and less alive.
cause-solution:2.chinese: 這會使金錢從社區中流走，並令商業街變得較缺乏多樣性，也較沒有生氣。

cause-solution:2.english: A second problem is that consumer decisions become shaped by image rather than real value.
cause-solution:2.chinese: 第二個問題是，消費者的決定會被形象塑造，而不是由真正價值決定。

cause-solution:2.english: A heavily advertised snack, for instance, may seem superior simply because its packaging, slogan and celebrity endorsement are everywhere.
cause-solution:2.chinese: 例如，一款被大量宣傳的零食，可能只是因為它的包裝、標語和名人代言隨處可見，便顯得更優越。

cause-solution:2.english: As a result, people may pay more for familiarity, while healthier or fresher local products are overlooked.
cause-solution:2.chinese: 結果，人們可能會為熟悉感支付更高價格，而更健康或更新鮮的本地產品卻被忽略。

cause-solution:2.english: To encourage local purchasing, governments and councils should first make local products more visible.
cause-solution:2.chinese: 為了鼓勵人們購買本地產品，政府和地方議會首先應該讓本地產品更加顯眼。

cause-solution:2.english: They could fund farmers’ markets, local-product sections in supermarkets, and digital platforms where nearby producers can sell directly to residents.
cause-solution:2.chinese: 它們可以資助農夫市集、超市中的本地產品專區，以及讓附近生產商能夠直接向居民銷售的數碼平台。

cause-solution:2.english: If a family can find local vegetables, bread or handmade goods as easily as a global brand, buying locally becomes a convenient habit rather than a moral chore.
cause-solution:2.chinese: 如果一個家庭能夠像找到全球品牌一樣容易地找到本地蔬菜、麵包或手工製品，那麼購買本地產品就會變成一種方便的習慣，而不是一項道德上的苦差。

cause-solution:2.english: Retailers can also help by using clear labelling and fair shelf space.
cause-solution:2.chinese: 零售商也可以透過清晰標籤和公平的貨架空間提供幫助。

cause-solution:2.english: A simple “made locally” label, paired with brief information about the producer, can turn an ordinary purchase into a small act of community support.
cause-solution:2.chinese: 一個簡單的「本地製造」標籤，再配上關於生產者的簡短資料，可以把一次普通的購物轉化為一個支持社區的小小行動。

cause-solution:2.english: Public campaigns can also remind consumers that local spending sustains jobs, skills and neighbourhood identity.
cause-solution:2.chinese: 公共宣傳活動也可以提醒消費者，本地消費能夠維持就業、技術和社區身份。

cause-solution:2.english: In conclusion, the marketing power of large businesses can undermine local firms and encourage more brand-led consumption.
cause-solution:2.chinese: 總結來說，大型企業的行銷力量可能削弱本地企業，並鼓勵更多由品牌主導的消費。

cause-solution:2.english: However, if local goods are made visible, convenient and meaningful to consumers, communities can tilt demand back towards their own producers.
cause-solution:2.chinese: 然而，如果本地商品能夠變得顯眼、方便，並且對消費者具有意義，社區便能夠把需求重新引導回自己的生產者身上。

cause-solution:3.english: The gap between wealthy and impoverished nations has widened in many parts of the world, creating a cycle in which prosperity attracts more prosperity while poverty becomes harder to escape.
cause-solution:3.chinese: 在世界許多地方，富裕國家與貧困國家之間的差距已經擴大，形成了一種富裕吸引更多富裕、而貧困變得更難擺脫的循環。

cause-solution:3.english: The main cause of this problem is the unequal access countries have to the systems that create long-term wealth.
cause-solution:3.chinese: 這個問題的主要原因是，各國在取得能夠創造長期財富的系統方面存在不平等。

cause-solution:3.english: This essay will explain this cause and suggest practical ways to address it.
cause-solution:3.chinese: 本文將解釋這個原因，並提出實際可行的方法來處理這個問題。

cause-solution:3.english: The central reason is that rich countries usually possess better education systems, stronger institutions, advanced technology and easier access to investment.
cause-solution:3.chinese: 核心原因是，富裕國家通常擁有更好的教育制度、更強大的制度、先進科技，以及更容易取得投資的渠道。

cause-solution:3.english: These advantages allow them to produce high-value goods and services, such as medicines, software and financial products, which generate large profits.
cause-solution:3.chinese: 這些優勢使它們能夠生產高價值的商品和服務，例如藥物、軟件和金融產品，而這些都能創造龐大利潤。

cause-solution:3.english: Poor countries, by contrast, often depend on exporting raw materials or low-paid labour.
cause-solution:3.chinese: 相比之下，貧困國家往往依賴出口原材料或低薪勞動力。

cause-solution:3.english: As a result, they earn less, collect less tax and struggle to build the roads, schools and hospitals that would help them compete.
cause-solution:3.chinese: 結果是，它們賺得更少、徵收的稅收更少，也難以建設能幫助它們競爭的道路、學校和醫院。

cause-solution:3.english: This becomes a vicious circle: the less a country can invest in its people and infrastructure, the harder it is for that country to move beyond survival and into genuine development.
cause-solution:3.chinese: 這便形成了一個惡性循環：一個國家越無法投資於人民和基礎建設，它就越難從僅僅維持生存，走向真正的發展。

cause-solution:3.english: To reduce this gap, both international reform and domestic improvement are needed.
cause-solution:3.chinese: 要縮小這個差距，國際層面的改革和國內層面的改善都是必要的。

cause-solution:3.english: Wealthier countries and global institutions should make trade rules fairer, reduce unfair debt burdens and support poorer nations with targeted investment in education, healthcare and clean infrastructure.
cause-solution:3.chinese: 較富裕的國家和全球機構應該使貿易規則更加公平、減少不公平的債務負擔，並透過針對教育、醫療和清潔基礎建設的投資來支持較貧困的國家。

cause-solution:3.english: This would give developing economies the tools to grow rather than leaving them permanently dependent on aid.
cause-solution:3.chinese: 這將給予發展中經濟體成長所需的工具，而不是讓它們永久依賴援助。

cause-solution:3.english: At the same time, governments in poorer countries must strengthen transparency, reduce corruption and invest public money in industries that can create skilled employment.
cause-solution:3.chinese: 與此同時，貧困國家的政府必須加強透明度、減少貪污，並把公共資金投放於能夠創造技術型就業的產業。

cause-solution:3.english: For example, supporting vocational training and small local businesses can help workers move from unstable informal jobs into more productive work.
cause-solution:3.chinese: 例如，支持職業培訓和本地小型企業，可以幫助工人從不穩定的非正式工作轉向更具生產力的工作。

cause-solution:3.english: In this way, aid becomes a stepping stone, not a crutch.
cause-solution:3.chinese: 這樣一來，援助便會成為踏腳石，而不是拐杖。

cause-solution:3.english: In conclusion, the widening wealth gap is mainly caused by unequal access to education, technology, capital and stable institutions.
cause-solution:3.chinese: 總結來說，財富差距擴大的主要原因，是各國在取得教育、科技、資本和穩定制度方面存在不平等。

cause-solution:3.english: It can be reduced through fairer global rules, responsible investment and stronger domestic governance.
cause-solution:3.chinese: 這個問題可以透過更公平的全球規則、負責任的投資，以及更強大的國內治理來減輕。

cause-solution:4.english: Internet access has become a normal part of childhood, especially as many children now use online platforms to chat, play games and build friendships.
cause-solution:4.chinese: 互聯網使用已成為童年生活中很正常的一部分，尤其是現在許多兒童都會使用網上平台聊天、玩遊戲和建立友誼。

cause-solution:4.english: However, when this happens without adult supervision, children may be exposed to risks which they are not mature enough to recognise.
cause-solution:4.chinese: 然而，當這種情況在沒有成年人監督下發生時，兒童可能會接觸到一些他們尚未成熟到能夠辨認的風險。

cause-solution:4.english: The main problems are contact with dangerous strangers and cyberbullying, and these can be addressed through stronger parental guidance, school education and platform responsibility.
cause-solution:4.chinese: 主要問題是接觸危險的陌生人以及網絡欺凌，而這些問題可以透過更強的家長引導、學校教育和平台責任來解決。

cause-solution:4.english: The first major problem is that children can come into contact with people who hide their real identity.
cause-solution:4.chinese: 第一個主要問題是，兒童可能會接觸到隱藏自己真實身份的人。

cause-solution:4.english: In gaming platforms, messaging apps or social media groups, an adult may pretend to be another child in order to gain trust, ask for private information, or persuade the child to keep secrets from their family.
cause-solution:4.chinese: 在遊戲平台、即時通訊應用程式或社交媒體群組中，成年人可能會假裝成另一名兒童，以取得信任、索取私人資料，或說服孩子向家人保守秘密。

cause-solution:4.english: Since young children are often trusting and eager to be accepted, this can lead to grooming, blackmail or exploitation.
cause-solution:4.chinese: 由於年幼兒童通常容易信任別人，而且渴望被接納，這可能會導致誘導、勒索或剝削。
第二個問題是網絡欺凌。

cause-solution:4.english: Unlike ordinary playground conflict, online abuse can follow a child home, spread quickly, and feel impossible to escape.
cause-solution:4.chinese: 與普通的操場衝突不同，網上辱罵可以跟隨孩子回到家中，迅速擴散，並讓人感到無法逃避。

cause-solution:4.english: Repeated insults, rumours or humiliating images can seriously damage a child’s confidence and mental well-being.
cause-solution:4.chinese: 反覆的侮辱、謠言或令人羞辱的圖片，可能會嚴重損害孩子的自信心和心理健康。

cause-solution:4.english: These problems can be reduced if parents take an active but sensible role in children’s internet use.
cause-solution:4.chinese: 如果父母在孩子使用互聯網時扮演積極而理性的角色，這些問題是可以被減少的。

cause-solution:4.english: Rather than simply banning the internet, parents should set clear rules, use age-appropriate safety settings, and regularly talk to their children about what they see online.
cause-solution:4.chinese: 父母不應只是簡單地禁止孩子使用互聯網，而應該設定清晰的規則，使用適合年齡的安全設定，並定期與孩子談論他們在網上看到的內容。

cause-solution:4.english: This makes supervision feel like protection rather than punishment.
cause-solution:4.chinese: 這會令監督感覺像是一種保護，而不是懲罰。

cause-solution:4.english: Schools also have an important role to play.
cause-solution:4.chinese: 學校也有重要的角色要發揮。

cause-solution:4.english: Digital safety lessons should teach children how to identify suspicious behaviour, protect personal information, block abusive users and report threatening messages.
cause-solution:4.chinese: 數碼安全課程應該教導兒童如何辨認可疑行為、保護個人資料、封鎖辱罵性的使用者，以及舉報具威脅性的訊息。

cause-solution:4.english: At the same time, technology companies should design safer spaces for young users, with stronger age checks, easier reporting tools and faster removal of harmful content.
cause-solution:4.chinese: 與此同時，科技公司應該為年幼使用者設計更安全的空間，包括更嚴格的年齡檢查、更容易使用的舉報工具，以及更快速移除有害內容的機制。

cause-solution:4.english: In conclusion, unsupervised internet use can expose children to manipulation by strangers and damaging forms of cyberbullying.
cause-solution:4.chinese: 總結來說，沒有監督的互聯網使用可能會令兒童暴露於陌生人的操控，以及具傷害性的網絡欺凌之中。

cause-solution:4.english: These dangers are best tackled through responsible parenting, practical digital education and safer online platforms.
cause-solution:4.chinese: 這些危險最好透過負責任的家長教育、實用的數碼教育，以及更安全的網上平台來處理。

cause-solution:6.english: In many parts of the world, cities record more crime than villages and small towns.
cause-solution:6.chinese: 在世界許多地方，城市錄得的犯罪比鄉村和小鎮更多。

cause-solution:6.english: This is not simply because urban residents are less law-abiding; rather, city life creates conditions in which crime is easier to commit and harder to prevent.
cause-solution:6.chinese: 這並不只是因為城市居民較不守法；相反，城市生活創造了一些條件，使犯罪更容易發生，也更難預防。

cause-solution:6.english: The most effective response is therefore to reduce both the opportunities for crime and the pressures that push people towards it.
cause-solution:6.chinese: 因此，最有效的應對方法，是同時減少犯罪機會，以及減輕那些把人推向犯罪的壓力。

cause-solution:6.english: One major reason is the anonymity of urban life.
cause-solution:6.chinese: 其中一個主要原因，是城市生活的匿名性。

cause-solution:6.english: In a small rural community, people tend to know one another, so suspicious behaviour is more visible and social pressure acts as a quiet form of control.
cause-solution:6.chinese: 在一個細小的鄉村社區中，人們往往彼此認識，因此可疑行為更容易被看見，而社群的目光也會形成一種無聲的約束力量。

cause-solution:6.english: In a large city, by contrast, offenders can disappear into the crowd.
cause-solution:6.chinese: 相比之下，在大城市裡，犯罪者可以消失在人群之中。

cause-solution:6.english: For example, pickpocketing is easier in a packed train station than in a village market, because victims, witnesses and police officers may struggle to identify the offender.
cause-solution:6.chinese: 例如，在擠迫的火車站裡扒竊，會比在鄉村市場中更容易，因為受害者、目擊者和警察都可能難以辨認犯罪者。

cause-solution:6.english: Cities often bring wealth and poverty face to face: luxury apartments may stand only a few streets away from overcrowded housing.
cause-solution:6.chinese: 在城市裏，富裕與貧窮往往近在咫尺：豪華住宅可能只與擁擠的住房相隔幾條街。

cause-solution:6.english: When people feel excluded from the prosperity around them, some may turn to theft, drug dealing or gang activity, especially if legal routes to success seem blocked.
cause-solution:6.chinese: 當人們覺得自己被排除在周圍的繁榮之外時，有些人可能會轉向盜竊、販毒或幫派活動，尤其是在合法取得成功的途徑似乎被堵塞時。

cause-solution:6.english: To reduce urban crime, governments should first design cities in ways that make offending more difficult.
cause-solution:6.chinese: 為了減少城市犯罪，政府首先應該以令犯罪更困難的方式來設計城市。

cause-solution:6.english: Better lighting, reliable public transport, visible community policing and well-maintained public spaces can all reduce the sense that certain areas are unsafe or uncontrolled.
cause-solution:6.chinese: 更好的照明、可靠的公共交通、可見的社區警務，以及保養良好的公共空間，都能減少某些地區不安全或失控的感覺。

cause-solution:6.english: For instance, a park that is clean, busy and properly lit is far less likely to become a place for drug dealing or violence.
cause-solution:6.chinese: 例如，一個乾淨、熱鬧而且照明充足的公園，遠不容易變成販毒或暴力活動的場所。

cause-solution:6.english: At the same time, prevention must go deeper than surveillance.
cause-solution:6.chinese: 與此同時，預防工作必須比監控走得更深入。

cause-solution:6.english: Cities need stronger youth services, affordable education, job training and support for families under pressure.
cause-solution:6.chinese: 城市需要更完善的青少年服務、可負擔的教育、職業培訓，以及對承受壓力的家庭的支援。

cause-solution:6.english: If young people can see a realistic path into work and belonging, crime becomes less attractive and less necessary.
cause-solution:6.chinese: 如果年輕人能看見一條通向工作和歸屬感的現實道路，犯罪便會變得較不吸引，也較不必要。

cause-solution:6.english: In conclusion, crime is often higher in urban areas because cities combine anonymity with sharper social inequality.
cause-solution:6.chinese: 總結來說，城市地區的犯罪率往往較高，是因為城市結合了匿名性和更尖銳的社會不平等。

cause-solution:6.english: Reducing it requires both practical safety measures and long-term social investment.
cause-solution:6.chinese: 要減少犯罪，既需要實際的安全措施，也需要長遠的社會投資。

cause-solution:7.english: At university level, science courses remain unevenly populated, with male students greatly outnumbering female students.
cause-solution:7.chinese: 在大學階段，科學課程中的學生比例仍然不均衡，男學生的人數遠遠多於女學生。

cause-solution:7.english: This imbalance is not mainly a question of ability.
cause-solution:7.chinese: 這種不平衡主要並不是能力問題。

cause-solution:7.english: It is more often caused by social expectations that shape girls’ confidence and subject choices long before they apply to university.
cause-solution:7.chinese: 它更多是由社會期望所造成，而這些期望早在女生申請大學之前，已經塑造了她們的自信和科目選擇。

cause-solution:7.english: To balance the numbers, schools and universities need to change both the image of science and the support available to female students.
cause-solution:7.chinese: 為了平衡人數，學校和大學需要同時改變科學的形象，以及提供給女學生的支援。

cause-solution:7.english: The main reason is that science is still widely presented, directly or indirectly, as a male domain.
cause-solution:7.chinese: 主要原因是，科學在很大程度上仍然被直接或間接地呈現為男性領域。

cause-solution:7.english: From childhood, boys are more often encouraged to build, experiment and solve technical problems, while girls may be guided towards subjects seen as more caring, verbal or socially suitable.
cause-solution:7.chinese: 從童年開始，男孩往往更常被鼓勵去建造、實驗和解決技術問題，而女孩則可能被引導到一些被認為更具照顧性、更偏語言性，或更符合社會期待的科目。

cause-solution:7.english: As a result, many capable female students begin to doubt whether they belong in physics, engineering or computer science.
cause-solution:7.chinese: 結果是，許多有能力的女學生開始懷疑自己是否屬於物理、工程或電腦科學這些領域。

cause-solution:7.english: This doubt can become self-fulfilling: if a girl rarely sees female scientists, teachers or classmates around her, science starts to look less like an open door and more like a room built for someone else.
cause-solution:7.chinese: 這種懷疑可能會自行應驗：如果一個女孩很少在身邊看見女性科學家、教師或同學，科學便開始不像一扇向她敞開的門，而更像是一個為別人而建的房間。

cause-solution:7.english: One effective solution is to intervene earlier, before university choices are fixed.
cause-solution:7.chinese: 一個有效的解決方法是在大學選擇確定之前，更早作出干預。

cause-solution:7.english: Schools should expose girls to practical science projects, female role models and career talks that show the real range of scientific work, from medical research to environmental technology.
cause-solution:7.chinese: 學校應該讓女生接觸實用的科學項目、女性榜樣，以及能展示科學工作真正範圍的職業講座，從醫學研究到環境科技都應包括在內。

cause-solution:7.english: At the same time, teachers should actively challenge the quiet stereotypes that influence subject selection, so that girls are not simply allowed to study science but genuinely expected to succeed in it.
cause-solution:7.chinese: 同時，教師應該積極挑戰那些悄悄影響科目選擇的刻板印象，讓女生不只是被容許修讀科學，更被真心相信能在這個領域取得成功。

cause-solution:7.english: Universities can also help by making science courses feel less isolating.
cause-solution:7.chinese: 大學也可以透過讓科學課程感覺不那麼孤立來提供幫助。

cause-solution:7.english: Mentoring schemes, scholarships, outreach programmes and visible female academic staff can reassure applicants that they will not be walking into hostile territory alone.
cause-solution:7.chinese: 導師計劃、獎學金、外展項目，以及可見的女性學術人員，都可以讓申請者放心，知道自己並不是獨自走進一片充滿敵意的領地。

cause-solution:7.english: Admission campaigns should also show science as collaborative, creative and socially valuable, rather than only technical and competitive.
cause-solution:7.chinese: 招生宣傳也應該把科學呈現為合作性強、富有創意並具有社會價值的領域，而不只是技術性強和競爭激烈的領域。

cause-solution:7.english: In conclusion, the gender gap in university science is largely rooted in early stereotypes and a lack of visible belonging.
cause-solution:7.chinese: 總結來說，大學科學領域中的性別差距，很大程度上源於早期形成的刻板印象，以及缺乏可見的歸屬感。

cause-solution:7.english: It can be narrowed through earlier encouragement, stronger role models and more supportive university environments.
cause-solution:7.chinese: 這種差距可以透過更早的鼓勵、更有力的榜樣，以及支援更充足的大學環境來縮小。

cause-solution:9.english: An increasing number of people now face serious health risks because they are overweight.
cause-solution:9.chinese: 越來越多人如今因為超重而面臨嚴重的健康風險。

cause-solution:9.english: This problem is best understood not as a simple failure of personal discipline, but as the result of a modern environment that quietly encourages inactivity and unhealthy eating.
cause-solution:9.chinese: 這個問題最應被理解為現代環境所造成的結果，而不是單純的個人自律失敗；這種環境正悄悄鼓勵人們缺乏活動並養成不健康的飲食習慣。

cause-solution:9.english: The most effective solution, therefore, is to make healthier routines easier to follow in ordinary life.
cause-solution:9.chinese: 因此，最有效的解決方法是讓較健康的日常習慣在普通生活中更容易實行。

cause-solution:9.english: The main reason for the growth in overweight people is that many daily routines now involve too little movement and too much convenient, calorie-dense food.
cause-solution:9.chinese: 超重人數增加的主要原因是，現今許多日常生活模式都包含太少活動，以及太多方便而高熱量密度的食物。

cause-solution:9.english: In many cities, people sit for long hours at school, at work and during travel, so their bodies use far less energy than before.
cause-solution:9.chinese: 在許多城市中，人們在學校、工作和通勤期間都長時間坐著，因此身體消耗的能量比以前少得多。

cause-solution:9.english: At the same time, fast food, sugary drinks and processed snacks are cheap, widely available and heavily promoted.
cause-solution:9.chinese: 與此同時，快餐、含糖飲品和加工零食價格便宜、隨處可得，而且被大量推廣。

cause-solution:9.english: When these two forces work together, weight gain can become almost automatic.
cause-solution:9.chinese: 當這兩種力量同時發揮作用時，體重增加幾乎會變成一種自然而然的結果。

cause-solution:9.english: For example, a student who spends the day in class, travels home by car and then relaxes with online games may gradually build a lifestyle in which eating is easy but physical activity is rare.
cause-solution:9.chinese: 例如，一名學生整天在課室上課，放學後坐車回家，然後用網上遊戲放鬆，便可能逐漸形成一種飲食很容易、但體能活動很少的生活方式。

cause-solution:9.english: To solve this problem, governments, schools and employers need to change the conditions that shape everyday behaviour.
cause-solution:9.chinese: 為了解決這個問題，政府、學校和僱主需要改變那些塑造日常行為的條件。

cause-solution:9.english: Governments could limit junk-food advertising aimed at children, require clearer nutrition labels and make fresh food more affordable.
cause-solution:9.chinese: 政府可以限制針對兒童的垃圾食品廣告，要求更清晰的營養標籤，並令新鮮食物更容易負擔。

cause-solution:9.english: Schools should provide regular physical education and healthier meals, while workplaces could encourage active breaks, flexible lunch hours and safe facilities for walking or cycling.
cause-solution:9.chinese: 學校應該提供定期的體育教育和更健康的膳食，而工作場所則可以鼓勵活動休息、彈性午餐時間，以及安全的步行或單車設施。

cause-solution:9.english: These measures are useful because they do not depend only on willpower.
cause-solution:9.chinese: 這些措施是有用的，因為它們並不只是依賴個人意志力。

cause-solution:9.english: If healthy food is reasonably priced and exercise is built into the day, people are more likely to maintain a healthy weight without feeling that they are fighting their own routine.
cause-solution:9.chinese: 如果健康食物價格合理，而運動又被融入日常生活之中，人們便更有可能維持健康體重，而不會覺得自己正在對抗自己的生活規律。

cause-solution:9.english: In conclusion, the rise in overweight people is mainly caused by sedentary lifestyles combined with easy access to unhealthy food.
cause-solution:9.chinese: 總結來說，超重人數上升主要是由久坐的生活方式，加上不健康食物容易取得所造成的。

cause-solution:9.english: It can be reduced by creating environments in which eating well and moving regularly become normal, practical and affordable choices.
cause-solution:9.chinese: 這個問題可以透過創造一種環境來減少；在這種環境中，健康飲食和定期活動會成為正常、實際而且負擔得起的選擇。

cause-solution:10.english: Although walking is one of the simplest and cheapest ways to stay healthy, it has quietly disappeared from many people’s daily routines.
cause-solution:10.chinese: 儘管步行是保持健康最簡單、最便宜的方法之一，它卻已悄然從許多人的日常生活中消失。

cause-solution:10.english: This decline stems mainly from car-centred urban design and increasingly sedentary lifestyles.
cause-solution:10.chinese: 這種下降主要源於以汽車為中心的城市設計，以及越來越久坐不動的生活方式。

cause-solution:10.english: It can be addressed by improving public spaces and making walking a normal part of work, school and transport habits.
cause-solution:10.chinese: 這個問題可以透過改善公共空間，以及使步行成為工作、學校和交通習慣中的正常部分來解決。

cause-solution:10.english: One major reason is that many modern cities are built around speed rather than movement.
cause-solution:10.chinese: 其中一個主要原因是，許多現代城市是圍繞速度而非身體活動來建造的。

cause-solution:10.english: When homes, offices, shops and schools are far apart, walking becomes inconvenient or unsafe, especially in areas with wide roads, poor pavements and little shade.
cause-solution:10.chinese: 當住宅、辦公室、商店和學校相距甚遠時，步行就會變得不方便或不安全，尤其是在道路寬闊、行人路質素差、遮蔭不足的地區。

cause-solution:10.english: As a result, people choose cars, buses or ride-hailing services, not because walking has no value, but because the environment pushes them away from it.
cause-solution:10.chinese: 結果，人們選擇私家車、巴士或叫車服務，原因在於環境讓他們遠離步行，並非步行本身沒有價值。

cause-solution:10.english: Another reason is the rise of desk-based routines.
cause-solution:10.chinese: 另一個原因是以辦公桌為中心的日常模式越來越普遍。

cause-solution:10.english: Many people spend long hours in front of screens, and after a tiring day they often choose the easiest option: lifts instead of stairs, online shopping instead of local errands, and entertainment at home instead of a short walk outside.
cause-solution:10.chinese: 許多人長時間坐在螢幕前，而在疲憊的一天過後，他們往往會選擇最輕鬆的選項：乘搭升降機而不是走樓梯、網上購物而不是到附近辦事、在家娛樂而不是到戶外短暫散步。

cause-solution:10.english: Over time, these small choices harden into a sedentary lifestyle.
cause-solution:10.chinese: 久而久之，這些小選擇便會固化成一種久坐不動的生活方式。

cause-solution:10.english: To tackle this problem, governments should make walking safer, easier and more attractive.
cause-solution:10.chinese: 為了解決這個問題，政府應該使步行變得更安全、更容易，也更具吸引力。

cause-solution:10.english: Wider pavements, shaded streets, better lighting, pedestrian zones and crossings can turn walking from a chore into a daily option.
cause-solution:10.chinese: 更寬闊的行人路、有遮蔭的街道、更好的照明、行人專區和過路設施，可以把步行由一件麻煩事變成一個日常選項。

cause-solution:10.english: For example, if a neighbourhood has pleasant routes to schools, parks and shops, families are more likely to walk without feeling that they are sacrificing time or safety.
cause-solution:10.chinese: 例如，如果一個社區有舒適的路線通往學校、公園和商店，家庭便更有可能步行，而不會覺得自己正在犧牲時間或安全。

cause-solution:10.english: At the same time, employers and schools should build movement into ordinary routines.
cause-solution:10.chinese: 同時，僱主和學校應該把身體活動融入日常安排之中。

cause-solution:10.english: Workplaces can encourage walking meetings and active commuting, while schools can promote walking buses or step-based challenges.
cause-solution:10.chinese: 工作場所可以鼓勵步行會議和主動通勤，而學校則可以推廣步行巴士或以步數為基礎的挑戰活動。

cause-solution:10.english: These measures matter because they make walking feel like part of daily life, not an extra task squeezed into a crowded schedule.
cause-solution:10.chinese: 這些措施之所以重要，是因為它們能讓步行感覺像日常生活的一部分，而不是一項被硬塞進繁忙日程中的額外任務。

cause-solution:10.english: In conclusion, fewer people are walking because their surroundings and routines often make inactivity easier than movement.
cause-solution:10.chinese: 總結來說，越來越少人步行，是因為他們所處的環境和日常習慣，往往令不活動比活動更容易。

cause-solution:10.english: The most effective response is to design walkable communities and create daily habits that make walking convenient, safe and normal again.
cause-solution:10.chinese: 最有效的應對方法，是設計適合步行的社區，並建立日常習慣，使步行重新變得方便、安全和正常。

cause-solution:11.english: In many parts of the world, rural-to-urban migration has become increasingly common.
cause-solution:11.chinese: 在世界許多地方，從農村遷往城市的現象已變得越來越普遍。

cause-solution:11.english: This movement is mainly driven by the belief that cities offer better life chances than villages or small towns.
cause-solution:11.chinese: 這種流動主要是由一種信念所推動：城市比村莊或小城鎮能提供更好的人生機會。

cause-solution:11.english: However, it can place serious pressure on urban systems and leave rural communities increasingly fragile.
cause-solution:11.chinese: 然而，這可能會對城市系統造成嚴重壓力，並使農村社區變得越來越脆弱。

cause-solution:11.english: One major reason for this trend is economic opportunity.
cause-solution:11.chinese: 造成這一趨勢的一個主要原因是經濟機會。

cause-solution:11.english: In many rural areas, work is still closely connected to farming, local trade, or small family businesses, all of which may provide unstable income.
cause-solution:11.chinese: 在許多農村地區，工作仍然與農業、本地貿易或小型家庭生意密切相關，而這些工作都可能帶來不穩定的收入。

cause-solution:11.english: By contrast, cities usually offer a wider range of jobs in factories, offices, retail, hospitality, and technology.
cause-solution:11.chinese: 相比之下，城市通常在工廠、辦公室、零售、酒店服務業和科技行業中提供更廣泛的工作選擇。

cause-solution:11.english: A young person who moves to a city, for example, may start with an entry-level position but still see a path towards promotion, training, and higher earnings.
cause-solution:11.chinese: 例如，一個搬到城市的年輕人可能一開始只是從事入門級職位，但仍然能看到晉升、培訓和獲得更高收入的路徑。

cause-solution:11.english: This sense of upward mobility makes urban life extremely attractive.
cause-solution:11.chinese: 這種向上流動的感覺使城市生活極具吸引力。

cause-solution:11.english: Another important reason is access to essential services.
cause-solution:11.chinese: 另一個重要原因是能夠獲得基本服務。

cause-solution:11.english: Cities tend to have better schools, universities, hospitals, transport networks, and digital infrastructure.
cause-solution:11.chinese: 城市往往擁有更好的學校、大學、醫院、交通網絡和數碼基礎設施。

cause-solution:11.english: For families, this can be decisive because education and healthcare are not luxuries; they are the foundations of long-term security.
cause-solution:11.chinese: 對家庭而言，這可能是決定性的因素，因為教育和醫療並不是奢侈品；它們是長遠保障的基礎。

cause-solution:11.english: If a rural parent believes that a city school will give their child stronger qualifications and wider social exposure, relocation may seem not only sensible but necessary.
cause-solution:11.chinese: 如果一位農村家長相信城市學校能讓孩子取得更有競爭力的學歷資格，並接觸更廣闊的社會環境，那麼搬遷看來不只明智，更有必要。

cause-solution:11.english: This movement, however, can cause several problems.
cause-solution:11.chinese: 然而，這種人口流動可能造成幾個問題。

cause-solution:11.english: The most immediate one is urban overcrowding.
cause-solution:11.chinese: 最直接的一個問題是城市過度擁擠。

cause-solution:11.english: When population growth is faster than planning, housing becomes expensive, roads become congested, and public services are stretched thin.
cause-solution:11.chinese: 當人口增長快於城市規劃時，住房會變得昂貴，道路會變得擁堵，而公共服務也會不堪負荷。

cause-solution:11.english: As a result, some migrants may end up living in poor-quality accommodation while competing for limited jobs.
cause-solution:11.chinese: 結果是，一些移民最終可能住在質素較差的住所，同時還要競爭有限的工作機會。

cause-solution:11.english: At the same time, rural areas may decline.
cause-solution:11.chinese: 與此同時，農村地區可能會衰落。

cause-solution:11.english: As younger and more capable residents leave, villages can lose workers, customers, and future community leaders.
cause-solution:11.chinese: 隨著較年輕和較有能力的居民離開，村莊可能會失去工人、顧客，以及未來的社區領袖。

cause-solution:11.english: Schools may close, local businesses may struggle, and elderly residents may become increasingly isolated.
cause-solution:11.chinese: 學校可能會關閉，本地商業可能會陷入困境，而年長居民也可能變得越來越孤立。

cause-solution:11.english: In conclusion, people move to cities mainly for better employment prospects and access to services.
cause-solution:11.chinese: 總結來說，人們搬到城市主要是為了更好的就業前景和獲得服務的機會。

cause-solution:11.english: Nevertheless, this trend can overload urban areas and weaken the social and economic life of the countryside.
cause-solution:11.chinese: 然而，這一趨勢可能會使城市地區負荷過重，並削弱農村的社會和經濟生活。

cause-solution:12.english: As cities attract more people in search of employment and better prospects, urban overpopulation has become a serious challenge.
cause-solution:12.chinese: 隨著城市吸引越來越多人前來尋找工作和更好的發展前景，城市人口過多已成為一個嚴重的挑戰。

cause-solution:12.english: This essay will discuss two major problems caused by this trend, namely pressure on housing and public services, and the decline of everyday living conditions, before suggesting practical ways to address them.
cause-solution:12.chinese: 本文將討論這一趨勢所造成的兩個主要問題，即住房和公共服務所承受的壓力，以及日常生活條件的下降，然後提出實際的方法來解決這些問題。

cause-solution:12.english: The first problem is that housing becomes increasingly unaffordable and inadequate.
cause-solution:12.chinese: 第一個問題是，住房越來越難以負擔，合適住所亦越來越供不應求。

cause-solution:12.english: When too many people compete for a limited number of homes, rents rise sharply, and poorer residents may be forced into cramped apartments or informal settlements.
cause-solution:12.chinese: 當太多人爭奪數量有限的住房時，租金會急劇上升，而較貧困的居民可能被迫住進狹小的公寓或非正式聚居區。

cause-solution:12.english: This also places heavy pressure on schools, hospitals and sanitation systems, because public services have to serve more people than they were designed for.
cause-solution:12.chinese: 這也會對學校、醫院和衛生系統造成沉重壓力，因為公共服務需要服務的人數超出了原本設計時所能承受的範圍。

cause-solution:12.english: As a result, city life may promise opportunity, but for many residents it becomes expensive, stressful and unhealthy.
cause-solution:12.chinese: 結果是，城市生活也許象徵著機會，但對許多居民而言，它卻變得昂貴、充滿壓力，而且不健康。

cause-solution:12.english: Another serious problem is the deterioration of daily life in crowded urban areas.
cause-solution:12.chinese: 另一個嚴重問題是，擁擠城市地區的日常生活質素下降。

cause-solution:12.english: Large populations usually lead to traffic congestion, longer commuting times and higher levels of air pollution.
cause-solution:12.chinese: 龐大的人口通常會導致交通擠塞、通勤時間延長，以及空氣污染水平上升。

cause-solution:12.english: For example, if thousands of workers travel into the same business districts every morning, roads and public transport systems quickly become overloaded.
cause-solution:12.chinese: 例如，如果每天早上有數以千計的上班族前往相同的商業區，道路和公共交通系統很快便會不勝負荷。

cause-solution:12.english: This wastes time, reduces productivity and gradually turns the city into a place where people spend more time surviving the routine than enjoying its opportunities.
cause-solution:12.chinese: 這會浪費時間、降低生產力，並逐漸把城市變成一個讓人花更多時間應付日常壓力，而不是享受城市機會的地方。

cause-solution:12.english: These problems can be solved through a combination of regional development and better urban planning.
cause-solution:12.chinese: 這些問題可以透過區域發展和更好的城市規劃相結合來解決。

cause-solution:12.english: Governments should create jobs, universities and reliable public services in smaller towns so that moving to a major city is not the only path to a better life.
cause-solution:12.chinese: 政府應該在較小的城鎮創造就業機會、建立大學，並提供可靠的公共服務，使搬到大城市不再是通往更好生活的唯一途徑。

cause-solution:12.english: At the same time, cities need more affordable housing, stronger public transport networks and stricter planning rules to prevent overcrowded neighbourhoods from expanding without proper infrastructure.
cause-solution:12.chinese: 與此同時，城市需要更多可負擔的住房、更完善的公共交通網絡，以及更嚴格的規劃規則，以防止過度擁擠的社區在缺乏適當基礎設施的情況下繼續擴張。

cause-solution:12.english: In conclusion, overpopulation in cities can cause housing shortages, pressure on public services, congestion and pollution.
cause-solution:12.chinese: 總結來說，城市人口過多可能會造成住房短缺、公共服務壓力、交通擠塞和污染。

cause-solution:12.english: However, these problems can be reduced if governments make smaller regions more attractive and manage urban growth more carefully.
cause-solution:12.chinese: 然而，如果政府能使較小地區更具吸引力，並更謹慎地管理城市增長，這些問題便可以得到減輕。

cause-solution:13.english: Children are going online with less adult supervision and from early ages, which can expose them to risks they are not mature enough to recognise.
cause-solution:13.chinese: 兒童在較少成人監督的情況下上網，而且從較小的年齡便開始接觸網絡，這可能使他們面對一些他們尚未成熟到足以辨識的風險。

cause-solution:13.english: Parents therefore face two main difficulties: keeping children safe from harmful digital material and helping them develop self-control online.
cause-solution:13.chinese: 因此，父母面對兩個主要困難：保護孩子遠離有害的網上內容，以及幫助他們在網上培養自我控制能力。

cause-solution:13.english: This essay will discuss these problems and suggest solutions.
cause-solution:13.chinese: 本文將討論這些問題並提出解決方法。

cause-solution:13.english: One major problem is that parents cannot easily monitor what children see or whom they communicate with.
cause-solution:13.chinese: 其中一個主要問題是，父母難以輕易監察孩子在網上看到甚麼，或與誰交流。

cause-solution:13.english: The internet is not a single controlled space: a child may start by watching cartoons, but one click can lead to violent videos, misleading information, or conversations with strangers.
cause-solution:13.chinese: 互聯網並不是一個單一而受控制的空間：一個孩子可能只是從觀看卡通開始，但一次點擊便可能通向暴力影片、誤導性資訊，或與陌生人的對話。

cause-solution:13.english: Since children often lack the judgement to separate entertainment from manipulation, they may reveal private information, copy unsuitable behaviour, or become frightened by disturbing content.
cause-solution:13.chinese: 由於孩子往往缺乏判斷力，難以分辨娛樂與操控之間的界線，他們可能會透露私人資料、模仿不合適的行為，或因令人不安的內容而感到害怕。

cause-solution:13.english: Another difficulty is the battle over screen time.
cause-solution:13.chinese: 另一個困難是圍繞螢幕時間的拉鋸。

cause-solution:13.english: Digital devices are designed to hold attention, so children may resist limits, rush homework, sleep late, or prefer online stimulation to face-to-face play.
cause-solution:13.chinese: 電子設備本身就是為了吸引注意力而設計的，因此孩子可能會抗拒限制、匆忙完成作業、晚睡，或更偏好網上刺激而不是面對面的玩耍。

cause-solution:13.english: Parents are therefore managing not only a device, but also a powerful habit.
cause-solution:13.chinese: 因此，父母所管理的不只是一部設備，更是一種強大的習慣。

cause-solution:13.english: These problems can be reduced through clear rules, technical safeguards and education.
cause-solution:13.chinese: 這些問題可以透過清晰規則、技術保障和教育來減少。

cause-solution:13.english: First, parents should create consistent household routines: devices can be used in shared areas, screen time can be limited after homework, and phones should be kept out of bedrooms at night.
cause-solution:13.chinese: 首先，父母應建立一致的家庭規律：設備可以只在家中共用空間使用，螢幕時間可以限制在完成功課之後，而手機在晚上應該放在睡房之外。

cause-solution:13.english: Second, parents should use age-appropriate controls, privacy settings and safe-search tools, not as a substitute for parenting, but as a safety net.
cause-solution:13.chinese: 其次，父母應使用適合孩子年齡的管控功能、私隱設定和安全搜尋工具；這些工具提供一張安全網，不能取代父母的管教。

cause-solution:13.english: Finally, children need to be taught digital judgement.
cause-solution:13.chinese: 最後，孩子需要被教導網絡判斷力。

cause-solution:13.english: Schools and parents can explain why personal details should not be shared, why online strangers may be dangerous, and why upsetting content should be reported immediately.
cause-solution:13.chinese: 學校和父母可以解釋為甚麼不應分享個人資料、為甚麼網上陌生人可能很危險，以及為甚麼令人不安的內容應立即舉報。

cause-solution:13.english: This turns internet safety from a hidden battle into an open conversation.
cause-solution:13.chinese: 這能把網絡安全從一場隱藏的角力，轉化為可以公開討論的話題。

cause-solution:13.english: In conclusion, unsupervised internet use creates problems because parents struggle to monitor online risks and control digital habits.
cause-solution:13.chinese: 總結來說，缺乏監督的互聯網使用會造成問題，因為父母難以監察網上風險，也難以控制孩子的使用電子設備的習慣。

cause-solution:13.english: The most effective response is not a total ban, but a steady combination of boundaries, protection and education, so that children can use the internet safely as they grow.
cause-solution:13.chinese: 最有效的應對方法，是持續結合界線、保護和教育，讓孩子在成長過程中安全使用互聯網，避免一概禁止。

cause-solution:14.english: Tourism has made air travel a normal part of modern life, and the rising number of travellers has naturally created greater demand for flights.
cause-solution:14.chinese: 旅遊業已經使航空旅行成為現代生活中正常的一部分，而旅客人數的上升自然也創造了對更多航班的更大需求。

cause-solution:14.english: This essay will discuss the environmental problems caused by this trend, especially carbon emissions and damage around airports, before suggesting practical measures to reduce these effects.
cause-solution:14.chinese: 本文將討論這一趨勢所造成的環境問題，尤其是碳排放和機場周邊的破壞，然後提出可行的措施來減少這些影響。

cause-solution:14.english: The most serious problem is that more flights lead to higher fuel consumption and, therefore, greater greenhouse gas emissions.
cause-solution:14.chinese: 最嚴重的問題是，更多航班會導致更高的燃料消耗，因此也會帶來更多的溫室氣體排放。

cause-solution:14.english: Aircraft burn large amounts of aviation fuel, so when airlines operate extra routes or increase flight frequency, more carbon dioxide is released into the atmosphere.
cause-solution:14.chinese: 飛機會燃燒大量航空燃料，所以當航空公司營運額外航線或增加航班頻率時，更多二氧化碳便會被釋放到大氣中。

cause-solution:14.english: Over time, this contributes to global warming, which can intensify heatwaves, rising sea levels and extreme weather.
cause-solution:14.chinese: 長遠而言，這會加劇全球暖化，而全球暖化可能使熱浪、海平面上升和極端天氣變得更加嚴重。

cause-solution:14.english: A second problem is the environmental pressure created on the ground.
cause-solution:14.chinese: 第二個問題是在地面上造成的環境壓力。

cause-solution:14.english: Busier airports often require larger terminals, longer runways and heavier road traffic, all of which can disturb nearby habitats and worsen local air and noise pollution.
cause-solution:14.chinese: 更繁忙的機場通常需要更大的客運大樓、更長的跑道和更密集的道路交通，而這些都可能干擾附近的棲息地，並惡化當地的空氣和噪音污染。

cause-solution:14.english: For communities and wildlife living close to airports, the constant movement of planes can become a heavy environmental burden.
cause-solution:14.chinese: 對於居住在機場附近的社區和野生動物而言，飛機持續起降可能會成為沉重的環境負擔。

cause-solution:14.english: There are several measures that could limit these problems.
cause-solution:14.chinese: 有幾項措施可以限制這些問題。

cause-solution:14.english: First, governments should encourage cleaner aviation by setting stricter emissions standards and supporting investment in more efficient aircraft, sustainable aviation fuels and better air-traffic management.
cause-solution:14.chinese: 首先，政府應該透過制定更嚴格的排放標準，並支持對更高效飛機、可持續航空燃料和更完善空中交通管理的投資，來鼓勵更清潔的航空業。

cause-solution:14.english: If planes use less fuel and spend less time circling or waiting on runways, each journey will leave a smaller environmental footprint.
cause-solution:14.chinese: 如果飛機使用較少燃料，並減少在空中盤旋或在跑道上等待的時間，每一次旅程所留下的對環境的影響便會更小。

cause-solution:14.english: Second, countries should reduce unnecessary demand for short flights.
cause-solution:14.chinese: 第二，各國應該減少對短途航班的不必要需求。

cause-solution:14.english: For example, high-speed rail, better coach networks and convenient domestic transport can give travellers a realistic alternative when the destination is not far away.
cause-solution:14.chinese: 例如，當目的地並不遙遠時，高速鐵路、更完善的長途巴士網絡和便利的本地交通可以為旅客提供一個切實可行的替代選擇。

cause-solution:14.english: Airlines could also be required to include environmental costs in ticket prices, so that extremely cheap flights no longer encourage people to travel casually without considering the impact.
cause-solution:14.chinese: 航空公司也可以被要求把環境成本納入機票價格之中，這樣極其便宜的航班便不再鼓勵人們在不考慮影響的情況下隨意出行。

cause-solution:14.english: In conclusion, the rising demand for flights damages the environment mainly through increased emissions and greater pressure around airports.
cause-solution:14.chinese: 總結來說，航班需求增加，主要因排放增加和機場周邊環境承壓而損害環境。

cause-solution:14.english: Cleaner technology, stricter regulation and attractive alternatives to flying are therefore necessary to reduce these problems.
cause-solution:14.chinese: 因此，更清潔的技術、更嚴格的監管，以及具吸引力的飛行替代方案，都是減少這些問題所必需的。

cause-solution:15.english: Eco-tourism is often promoted as a responsible way to travel, but when visitors enter remote areas, they can place serious pressure on local cultures and communities.
cause-solution:15.chinese: 生態旅遊通常被宣傳為一種負責任的旅行方式，但當遊客進入偏遠地區時，他們可能會對當地文化和社區造成嚴重壓力。

cause-solution:15.english: This essay will discuss the cultural and social problems that may result from eco-tourism, before suggesting practical measures to protect local people and their traditions.
cause-solution:15.chinese: 本文將討論生態旅遊可能帶來的文化和社會問題，然後提出保護當地居民及其傳統的實際措施。

cause-solution:15.english: One major problem is that local culture may be commercialised.
cause-solution:15.chinese: 其中一個主要問題是，當地文化可能會被商業化。

cause-solution:15.english: When tourists are willing to pay for “authentic” experiences, traditional ceremonies, clothing, music, and religious practices may gradually be turned into performances.
cause-solution:15.chinese: 當遊客願意為「地道」體驗付費時，傳統儀式、服飾、音樂和宗教習俗可能會逐漸變成表演項目。

cause-solution:15.english: As a result, customs that once had deep spiritual or social meaning can become little more than tourist attractions.
cause-solution:15.chinese: 結果是，原本具有深厚精神或社會意義的習俗，可能淪為旅遊景點。

cause-solution:15.english: This can weaken local identity, especially among younger people, who may start to see their own culture as something to sell rather than something to preserve.
cause-solution:15.chinese: 這可能會削弱當地身份認同，尤其是在年輕人當中，因為他們可能會開始把自己的文化看成可以出售的東西，而不是應該保存的東西。

cause-solution:15.english: Another problem is that remote communities may be disrupted by sudden outside influence.
cause-solution:15.chinese: 另一個問題是，偏遠社區可能會受到突然出現的外來影響所干擾。

cause-solution:15.english: Tourists can bring different values, spending habits, and expectations, which may change local behaviour and increase tension between residents and visitors.
cause-solution:15.chinese: 遊客可能會帶來不同的價值觀、消費習慣和期望，而這些可能會改變當地人的行為，並增加居民與遊客之間的緊張關係。

cause-solution:15.english: In some cases, prices for food, land, and services may rise, making everyday life harder for local families.
cause-solution:15.chinese: 在某些情況下，食物、土地和服務的價格可能會上升，使當地家庭的日常生活變得更加困難。

cause-solution:15.english: Several measures can be taken to reduce these problems.
cause-solution:15.chinese: 可以採取幾項措施來減少這些問題。

cause-solution:15.english: First, eco-tourism should be controlled by local communities rather than outside companies.
cause-solution:15.chinese: 首先，生態旅遊應該由當地社區主導，而不是由外來公司控制。

cause-solution:15.english: Local leaders should decide how many tourists may visit, which areas are open to outsiders, and which cultural practices should remain private.
cause-solution:15.chinese: 當地領袖應該決定可以接待多少遊客、哪些地區可以向外來者開放，以及哪些文化習俗應該保持私密。

cause-solution:15.english: This would allow communities to benefit from tourism without losing control of their way of life.
cause-solution:15.chinese: 這能讓社區從旅遊中受益，同時不會失去對自身生活方式的控制。

cause-solution:15.english: Second, governments and tourism operators should introduce clear rules for visitors.
cause-solution:15.chinese: 第二，政府和旅遊營運者應該為遊客制定清晰的規則。

cause-solution:15.english: For example, tourists should be educated about local customs, dress codes, sacred sites, and acceptable behaviour before entering remote areas.
cause-solution:15.chinese: 例如，在進入偏遠地區之前，遊客應該接受有關當地習俗、服裝規範、神聖場所和可接受行為的教育。

cause-solution:15.english: Visitor numbers should also be limited, and part of the income from eco-tourism should be used to support local schools, cultural centres, healthcare, and environmental protection.
cause-solution:15.chinese: 遊客人數也應該受到限制，而生態旅遊收入的一部分應該用來支持當地學校、文化中心、醫療服務和環境保護。

cause-solution:15.english: In conclusion, eco-tourism can damage remote communities by commercialising culture and disturbing local life.
cause-solution:15.chinese: 總結來說，生態旅遊可能會透過將文化商業化和干擾當地生活，對偏遠社區造成傷害。

cause-solution:15.english: However, community control, visitor education, and careful regulation can help protect local traditions while still allowing tourism to bring economic benefits.
cause-solution:15.chinese: 然而，社區控制、遊客教育和審慎規管可以幫助保護當地傳統，同時仍然讓旅遊帶來經濟利益。

cause-solution:16.english: In many cities and towns, roads are carrying more vehicles than they can reasonably absorb.
cause-solution:16.chinese: 在許多城市和城鎮，道路上的車輛已多到超出合理負荷。

cause-solution:16.english: This problem is mainly caused by car-centred planning and weak alternatives to private transport.
cause-solution:16.chinese: 這個問題主要是由以汽車為中心的城市規劃，以及除了私家車以外，其他交通選擇不足所造成的。

cause-solution:16.english: It can be addressed by improving public transport, managing road use more carefully and making short local journeys easier without a car.
cause-solution:16.chinese: 這個問題可以透過改善公共交通、更審慎地管理道路使用，以及讓人們在不使用汽車的情況下更容易完成短途本地出行來解決。

cause-solution:16.english: One important cause is that many urban areas have been built around driving.
cause-solution:16.chinese: 其中一個重要原因是，許多城市地區都是圍繞駕車而建設的。

cause-solution:16.english: When homes, workplaces, schools and shops are spread across wide distances, ordinary routines almost force people onto the road.
cause-solution:16.chinese: 當住宅、工作場所、學校和商店分散在很遠的距離之間時，日常生活的安排幾乎會迫使人們上路開車。

cause-solution:16.english: A parent, for example, may need to drive to a school, an office and a supermarket in one morning, turning one household into several car trips.
cause-solution:16.chinese: 例如，一位家長可能需要在一個早上開車前往學校、辦公室和超級市場，結果一個家庭便產生了數次汽車出行。

cause-solution:16.english: A second cause is the poor quality of public transport.
cause-solution:16.chinese: 第二個原因是公共交通的質素欠佳。

cause-solution:16.english: If buses are slow, trains are overcrowded, or services do not connect well with residential areas, people will naturally see driving as the only practical choice.
cause-solution:16.chinese: 如果巴士速度緩慢、火車過度擁擠，或者交通服務與住宅區連接不佳，人們自然會把駕車視為唯一實際可行的選擇。

cause-solution:16.english: In that situation, each driver tries to save time, but everyone ends up losing time in congestion.
cause-solution:16.chinese: 在這種情況下，每位司機都試圖節省時間，但最後所有人都在交通擠塞中浪費了時間。

cause-solution:16.english: The first solution is to make public transport genuinely convenient.
cause-solution:16.chinese: 第一個解決方法是讓公共交通真正變得方便。

cause-solution:16.english: Governments should invest in frequent buses, reliable rail services and simple ticketing systems, so that using a bus or train feels less like a sacrifice and more like common sense.
cause-solution:16.chinese: 政府應投資於班次頻密的巴士、可靠的鐵路服務和簡單的票務系統，讓人覺得乘搭巴士或火車不再需要作出犧牲，而是合情合理的選擇。

cause-solution:16.english: For instance, a worker who can cross a city quickly with one affordable ticket is far less likely to drive.
cause-solution:16.chinese: 例如，如果一名上班族能夠用一張價格合理的車票快速穿越城市，他開車的可能性便會大大降低。

cause-solution:16.english: In addition, local authorities should manage car use through congestion charges, limited parking and bus lanes.
cause-solution:16.chinese: 此外，地方政府應透過擠塞徵費、限制泊車位和設置巴士專線來管理汽車使用。

cause-solution:16.english: Cities should also build safe walking and cycling routes, especially for short trips.
cause-solution:16.chinese: 城市亦應建設安全的步行和單車路線，尤其是為短途出行而設。

cause-solution:16.english: These measures reduce unnecessary traffic without banning cars completely, leaving road space for essential journeys, deliveries and emergency vehicles.
cause-solution:16.chinese: 這些措施能在不完全禁止汽車的情況下減少不必要的交通流量，從而為必要出行、送貨車輛和緊急車輛騰出道路空間。

cause-solution:16.english: In conclusion, heavy traffic is largely the result of car-dependent planning and unattractive transport alternatives.
cause-solution:16.chinese: 總結來說，交通繁忙很大程度上是依賴汽車的城市規劃，以及缺乏吸引力的交通替代方案所造成的。

cause-solution:16.english: It can be reduced if cities improve public transport while encouraging people to make shorter and less essential journeys in other ways.
cause-solution:16.chinese: 如果城市改善公共交通，同時鼓勵人們以其他方式完成短途及較不必要的旅程，交通擠塞便可以得到減少。

cause-solution:17.english: In many countries, a growing number of people from farming communities are leaving the countryside and moving to cities in search of paid employment.
cause-solution:17.chinese: 在許多國家，越來越多來自農業社群的人正離開鄉村，搬到城市尋找有薪工作。

cause-solution:17.english: This trend can create serious pressure both in urban centres and in rural areas, but it can be addressed through stronger rural investment and better-managed urban planning.
cause-solution:17.chinese: 這種趨勢可能同時為城市中心和農村地區帶來嚴重壓力，但它可以透過更強的農村投資和更妥善管理的城市規劃來應對。

cause-solution:17.english: One major consequence is that cities may become overcrowded before they are ready to absorb the new population.
cause-solution:17.chinese: 一個主要後果是，城市可能在尚未準備好吸收新增人口之前便變得過度擁擠。

cause-solution:17.english: When large numbers of rural workers arrive within a short period, housing, transport and public services can be stretched beyond their normal capacity.
cause-solution:17.chinese: 當大量農村勞工在短時間內湧入城市時，住房、交通和公共服務可能承受超出正常負荷的壓力。

cause-solution:17.english: As a result, many newcomers may end up living in poor-quality accommodation, working in unstable jobs, or competing intensely for low-paid work.
cause-solution:17.chinese: 結果是，許多新來者最終可能住在質素低劣的住所中，從事不穩定的工作，或為低薪工作進行激烈競爭。

cause-solution:17.english: For example, a young farmer who moves to a major city without recognised qualifications may find that the city offers more opportunities in theory than in practice.
cause-solution:17.chinese: 例如，一位沒有受認可資歷的年輕農民搬到大城市後，可能會發現城市看似提供更多機會，實際上卻未必如此。

cause-solution:17.english: At the same time, this movement can weaken rural communities.
cause-solution:17.chinese: 與此同時，這種人口流動也可能削弱農村社群。

cause-solution:17.english: If too many working-age people leave agriculture, farms may lose labour, villages may become dominated by the elderly, and local food production may gradually decline.
cause-solution:17.chinese: 如果太多處於工作年齡的人離開農業，農場可能會失去勞動力，村莊可能會變成以長者為主，而本地糧食生產也可能逐漸下降。

cause-solution:17.english: One practical response is to make rural life economically viable rather than treating cities as the only path to progress.
cause-solution:17.chinese: 一個實際的應對方法，是令農村生活在經濟上變得可行，而不是把城市視為唯一的進步道路。

cause-solution:17.english: Governments could invest in irrigation, storage facilities, rural roads and digital access so that farmers can sell their products more efficiently and earn a steadier income.
cause-solution:17.chinese: 政府可以投資灌溉系統、儲存設施、農村道路和數碼連接，使農民能夠更有效率地出售產品，並賺取更穩定的收入。

cause-solution:17.english: They should also support modern agricultural training, small businesses and food-processing industries, which would create employment near people’s homes.
cause-solution:17.chinese: 他們也應該支持現代農業培訓、小型企業和食品加工產業，這些都能在人們居住地附近創造就業機會。

cause-solution:17.english: In cities, authorities need to plan for migration instead of simply reacting to it.
cause-solution:17.chinese: 在城市中，當局需要為人口遷移作出規劃，而不是單純在問題出現後才作出反應。

cause-solution:17.english: Affordable housing, vocational training and reliable public transport would help new arrivals enter the formal economy and avoid being pushed to the margins.
cause-solution:17.chinese: 可負擔住房、職業培訓和可靠的公共交通，將有助於新來者進入正規經濟體系，並避免被推向社會邊緣。

cause-solution:17.english: In conclusion, rural-to-urban migration can lead to overcrowded cities, insecure employment and a decline in agricultural communities.
cause-solution:17.chinese: 總結來說，農村到城市的人口遷移可能導致城市過度擁擠、就業不穩定，以及農業社群衰落。

cause-solution:17.english: However, if governments improve rural opportunities while managing urban growth carefully, this movement can become far less damaging and more sustainable.
cause-solution:17.chinese: 然而，如果政府在謹慎管理城市增長的同時改善農村機會，這種人口流動造成的損害便可大幅減少，發展亦更可持續。

cause-solution:18.english: In many modern societies, work has expanded beyond the office and begun to crowd out family, rest and personal growth.
cause-solution:18.chinese: 在許多現代社會中，工作已經延伸到辦公室之外，並開始擠壓家庭、休息和個人成長的空間。

cause-solution:18.english: This problem is usually caused by unrealistic workplace expectations and weakened boundaries between professional and private life.
cause-solution:18.chinese: 這個問題通常是由不切實際的職場期望，以及工作與私人生活之間的界線變得模糊所造成的。

cause-solution:18.english: It can be reduced if employers design healthier systems and individuals learn to protect their time deliberately.
cause-solution:18.chinese: 如果僱主能設計更健康的工作制度，而個人也學會有意識地保護自己的時間，這個問題便可以得到減輕。

cause-solution:18.english: One major reason is that many employees are expected to be constantly available.
cause-solution:18.chinese: 其中一個主要原因是，許多員工被期望隨時都能回應工作。

cause-solution:18.english: Emails, messaging apps and online meetings allow work to follow people home, so the end of the working day no longer feels like a real end.
cause-solution:18.chinese: 電子郵件、即時通訊應用程式和線上會議讓工作跟著人們回到家中，因此工作日的結束不再感覺像真正的結束。

cause-solution:18.english: As a result, a person may be physically with their family but mentally still at their desk.
cause-solution:18.chinese: 結果是，一個人身體上可能和家人在一起，但精神上仍然停留在辦公桌前。
另一個原因是經濟壓力。

cause-solution:18.english: When housing, childcare and daily expenses are high, people often accept overtime, second jobs or heavier workloads, even when these choices damage their health.
cause-solution:18.chinese: 當住房、育兒和日常開支高昂時，人們即使知道這些選擇會損害健康，也往往會接受加班、第二份工作或更沉重的工作量。

cause-solution:18.english: Over time, this creates a cycle in which tired workers perform less efficiently, need more time to finish tasks, and lose even more of their personal lives.
cause-solution:18.chinese: 長遠而言，這會形成一個循環：疲憊的員工工作效率下降，需要更多時間完成任務，並失去更多私人生活。

cause-solution:18.english: The most effective solution is for employers to set clearer limits on work.
cause-solution:18.chinese: 最有效的解決方法是讓僱主為工作設立更清晰的界線。

cause-solution:18.english: For instance, companies can discourage non-urgent messages after office hours, monitor excessive overtime and give staff more control over when and where they work.
cause-solution:18.chinese: 例如，公司可以不鼓勵員工在辦公時間後發送非緊急訊息、監察過度加班的情況，並讓員工對自己的工作時間和工作地點有更多掌控權。

cause-solution:18.english: These measures do not simply make employees happier; they also help them return to work with sharper concentration and better judgement.
cause-solution:18.chinese: 這些措施不只是讓員工更快樂；它們也能幫助員工以更集中的精神和更好的判斷力重新投入工作。

cause-solution:18.english: At the same time, individuals need to manage their own routines more firmly.
cause-solution:18.chinese: 同時，個人也需要更堅定地管理自己的日常安排。

cause-solution:18.english: This may mean setting fixed times for exercise, family meals or sleep, and treating these commitments as seriously as meetings with clients.
cause-solution:18.chinese: 這可能意味著為運動、家庭用餐或睡眠設定固定時間，並像對待與客戶的會議一樣認真看待這些承諾。

cause-solution:18.english: Without such boundaries, personal life becomes the first thing to be sacrificed.
cause-solution:18.chinese: 如果沒有這些界線，私人生活就會成為最先被犧牲的東西。

cause-solution:18.english: In conclusion, poor work-life balance is mainly the result of constant connectivity, high workplace demands and financial pressure.
cause-solution:18.chinese: 總結來說，工作與生活失衡主要是由時刻保持聯絡、高度職場要求和經濟壓力所造成的。

cause-solution:18.english: However, it can be overcome when organisations create more humane working conditions and individuals draw a clearer line between their jobs and the rest of their lives.
cause-solution:18.chinese: 然而，當機構創造更人性化的工作條件，而個人也在工作和生活其他部分之間劃出更清晰的界線時，便有可能克服這個問題。

cause-solution:19.english: In many developing countries, children in rural communities are held back not by a lack of ability, but by a shortage of high-quality teachers.
cause-solution:19.chinese: 在許多發展中國家，限制農村兒童發展的是優質教師不足，並非兒童本身能力欠佳。

cause-solution:19.english: This problem is largely caused by poor working conditions and limited career prospects, and it can be addressed through targeted incentives and stronger professional support.
cause-solution:19.chinese: 這個問題主要是由惡劣的工作條件和有限的職業前景造成的，而它可以透過有針對性的激勵措施和更強的專業支援來解決。

cause-solution:19.english: One major reason skilled teachers avoid rural areas is that these posts often come with serious personal and professional disadvantages.
cause-solution:19.chinese: 優秀教師避免到農村地區工作的其中一個主要原因，是這些職位往往伴隨嚴重的個人和職業劣勢。

cause-solution:19.english: Many rural schools lack basic facilities, reliable transport, proper accommodation, and teaching materials, so even committed teachers may feel that they are being asked to do an important job with one hand tied behind their back.
cause-solution:19.chinese: 許多農村學校缺乏基本設施、可靠交通、合適住宿和教學材料，因此即使是有熱誠的教師，也可能會覺得自己像是被綁住一隻手去完成一份重要工作。

cause-solution:19.english: For example, a science teacher who has no laboratory, no stable internet connection, and overcrowded classes may struggle to deliver lessons effectively, which can quickly lead to frustration and burnout.
cause-solution:19.chinese: 例如，一位沒有實驗室、沒有穩定網絡連接，還要面對過度擠迫班級的科學老師，可能很難有效地授課，而這很快便會導致挫敗感和職業倦怠。

cause-solution:19.english: Another reason is that rural appointments may appear to damage a teacher’s long-term career.
cause-solution:19.chinese: 另一個原因是，農村任職安排可能看起來會損害教師的長遠職業發展。

cause-solution:19.english: In cities, teachers usually have better access to training, senior colleagues, promotion opportunities, and professional networks.
cause-solution:19.chinese: 在城市，教師通常更容易獲得培訓機會、接觸資深同事、得到晉升機會，並建立專業人脈網絡。

cause-solution:19.english: By contrast, a rural teacher may feel invisible, no matter how hard he or she works.
cause-solution:19.chinese: 相比之下，一位農村教師無論多努力工作，都可能會覺得自己被忽視。

cause-solution:19.english: To solve this problem, governments should first make rural teaching financially and practically attractive.
cause-solution:19.chinese: 為了解決這個問題，政府首先應該使農村教學在經濟和實際層面上都更具吸引力。

cause-solution:19.english: This could include higher salaries, free housing, transport allowances, and priority access to future promotions.
cause-solution:19.chinese: 這可以包括更高薪酬、免費住房、交通津貼，以及未來晉升的優先機會。

cause-solution:19.english: Such measures would not merely reward teachers; they would also signal that rural education is a national priority rather than a professional dead end.
cause-solution:19.chinese: 這些措施不只是獎勵教師；它們也會傳達一個訊息：農村教育是國家優先事項，而不是一條職業死路。

cause-solution:19.english: In addition, rural teachers need regular support, not just a contract and a classroom.
cause-solution:19.chinese: 此外，農村教師需要定期支援，而不只是一份合約和一間課室。

cause-solution:19.english: Governments and schools could provide online mentoring, mobile training teams, and partnerships between urban and rural schools, so that teachers in remote areas can continue to improve their skills.
cause-solution:19.chinese: 政府和學校可以提供網上指導、流動培訓團隊，以及城鄉學校之間的合作關係，讓偏遠地區的教師能夠持續提升自己的技能。

cause-solution:19.english: Over time, developing local teacher-training programmes would also help, because teachers who come from rural communities are more likely to understand local needs and remain there.
cause-solution:19.chinese: 長遠而言，發展本地教師培訓課程也會有幫助，因為來自農村社區的教師更有可能理解當地需要，並留在那裡工作。

cause-solution:19.english: In conclusion, good teachers often avoid rural schools because the conditions are difficult and the career rewards are limited.
cause-solution:19.chinese: 總結來說，優秀教師往往避免到農村學校工作，因為那裡的條件艱難，而且職業回報有限。

cause-solution:19.english: Better incentives, stronger training, and clearer career pathways would make rural teaching more sustainable and improve children’s access to quality education.
cause-solution:19.chinese: 更好的激勵措施、更強的培訓，以及更清晰的職業發展路徑，將會使農村教學更可持續，並改善兒童接受優質教育的機會。

cause-solution:20.english: Highly educated professionals often choose to pursue employment overseas after gaining expertise in their own fields.
cause-solution:20.chinese: 受過良好教育的專業人士在自己的領域累積專門知識後，往往會選擇到海外工作。

cause-solution:20.english: This is usually driven by stronger career incentives and better professional conditions, and it can create serious difficulties both for their home countries and for the individuals involved.
cause-solution:20.chinese: 這通常是由更強的職業誘因和更好的專業工作條件所推動，而這也可能為他們的原居國以及相關個人帶來嚴重困難。

cause-solution:20.english: The main reason is that working abroad often offers a level of reward that is difficult to obtain at home.
cause-solution:20.chinese: 主要原因是，海外工作往往能提供在本國難以得到的待遇。

cause-solution:20.english: In many countries, even well-qualified workers may face low salaries, limited promotion prospects, or institutions that do not fully recognise their ability.
cause-solution:20.chinese: 在許多國家，即使是資歷優秀的工作者，也可能面對低薪、有限的晉升前景，或未能充分認可他們能力的機構。

cause-solution:20.english: By contrast, foreign employers may provide higher pay, clearer career paths, and more stable working conditions.
cause-solution:20.chinese: 相比之下，外國僱主可能提供更高薪酬、更清晰的職業發展道路，以及更穩定的工作條件。

cause-solution:20.english: A doctor, engineer, or researcher, for example, may move not simply for money, but because another country offers modern equipment, stronger professional networks, and a workplace where their skills can genuinely grow.
cause-solution:20.chinese: 例如，一位醫生、工程師或研究人員移居海外，動機可能超越金錢，還包括當地的現代化設備、更強大的專業人脈，以及能讓技能真正提升的工作環境。

cause-solution:20.english: In this sense, migration becomes less an act of escape than a search for room to breathe professionally.
cause-solution:20.chinese: 從這個意義上說，移民與其說是一種逃離，不如說是在尋找專業上得以伸展和發展的空間。

cause-solution:20.english: However, this movement can cause several problems.
cause-solution:20.chinese: 然而，這種流動也可能造成若干問題。

cause-solution:20.english: For the country of origin, the most serious consequence is a loss of human capital.
cause-solution:20.chinese: 對原居國而言，最嚴重的後果是人力資本的流失。

cause-solution:20.english: When experienced teachers, medical specialists, scientists, or technical experts leave, the public systems that trained them may be left thinner and weaker.
cause-solution:20.chinese: 當有經驗的教師、醫療專家、科學家或技術專家離開時，曾經培訓他們的公共系統可能會更缺乏人手，運作也更吃力。

cause-solution:20.english: Hospitals may have longer waiting times, universities may lose capable lecturers, and local industries may struggle to innovate.
cause-solution:20.chinese: 醫院的輪候時間可能會變得更長，大學可能會失去有能力的講師，而本地產業也可能難以創新。

cause-solution:20.english: Over time, this “brain drain” can widen the gap between richer and poorer countries, because the places that most need skilled workers are sometimes the least able to keep them.
cause-solution:20.chinese: 長遠而言，這種「人才外流」可能擴大富裕國家與較貧窮國家之間的差距，因為最需要技術人才的地方，有時反而最沒有能力留住他們。

cause-solution:20.english: There may also be personal costs: migrants can face loneliness, cultural barriers, and the pressure of starting again in an unfamiliar professional environment.
cause-solution:20.chinese: 此外，也可能存在個人層面的代價：移民者可能面對孤獨、文化障礙，以及在陌生的專業環境中重新開始的壓力。

cause-solution:20.english: In conclusion, educated and experienced people usually move abroad because overseas work can offer better pay, recognition, resources, and long-term career development.
cause-solution:20.chinese: 總結來說，受過教育並具備經驗的人通常會移居海外，因為海外工作能提供更好的薪酬、認可、資源，以及長遠的職業發展。

cause-solution:20.english: Nevertheless, this trend can weaken essential services in their home countries and place emotional and social pressure on the workers themselves.
cause-solution:20.chinese: 然而，這一趨勢可能削弱他們原居國的重要服務，並為工作者本人帶來情感和社交上的壓力。

direct-question:2.english: The success of a company often depends less on ambitious strategy than on how consistently its employees perform in daily work.
direct-question:2.chinese: 一家公司的成功往往與其說取決於雄心勃勃的策略，不如說取決於員工在日常工作中能否持續穩定地表現。

direct-question:2.english: To increase staff productivity, firms should focus on two practical areas: making work easier to do well and creating conditions in which people want to do their best.
direct-question:2.chinese: 為了提高員工生產力，企業應該專注於兩個實際範疇：讓工作更容易被做好，以及創造一種讓人願意盡力而為的環境。

direct-question:2.english: The first step is to make work clearer, better supported, and less wasteful.
direct-question:2.chinese: 第一步是讓工作變得更清晰、得到更好的支援，並減少浪費。

direct-question:2.english: Many employees are not unproductive because they are lazy; rather, they lose time because instructions are vague, systems are slow, or priorities change too often.
direct-question:2.chinese: 許多員工缺乏生產力並不是因為他們懶惰；相反，他們浪費時間，是因為指示含糊、系統緩慢，或者優先事項變動太頻繁。

direct-question:2.english: Companies should therefore set clear targets, divide large projects into manageable tasks, and ensure that workers know exactly what is expected of them.
direct-question:2.chinese: 因此，公司應該設定清晰目標，將大型項目分拆成可管理的任務，並確保員工準確知道自己被期望完成甚麼。

direct-question:2.english: Regular but concise feedback is also important, as it allows staff to correct mistakes before small problems become expensive ones.
direct-question:2.chinese: 定期但簡潔的回饋同樣重要，因為它能讓員工在小問題變成昂貴錯誤之前及時修正。

direct-question:2.english: Training should also be treated as a core investment rather than an occasional extra.
direct-question:2.chinese: 培訓也應該被視為一項核心投資，而不是偶爾才提供的額外安排。

direct-question:2.english: When employees are taught how to use new software, communicate with clients, or manage their workload, they can work with greater confidence and fewer errors.
direct-question:2.chinese: 當員工被教導如何使用新軟件、與客戶溝通，或管理自己的工作量時，他們便能更有信心地工作，並減少錯誤。

direct-question:2.english: A well-trained team is rarely a luxury; it is the engine of a productive company.
direct-question:2.chinese: 一支訓練有素的團隊很少只是奢侈品；它是一間高生產力公司的引擎。

direct-question:2.english: Another effective way to improve productivity is to protect employees’ motivation and well-being.
direct-question:2.chinese: 另一個提高生產力的有效方法，是保護員工的動力和身心健康。

direct-question:2.english: If staff are constantly exhausted, underpaid, or ignored, their performance will eventually decline, even if they are talented.
direct-question:2.chinese: 如果員工長期感到疲憊、薪酬不足，或被忽視，即使他們很有才華，表現最終也會下降。

direct-question:2.english: Companies can prevent this by offering fair salaries, recognising good work, and giving employees realistic workloads.
direct-question:2.chinese: 公司可以透過提供公平薪酬、認可優秀工作，以及給予員工合理的工作量來防止這種情況。

direct-question:2.english: Flexible working arrangements can also help, especially when they reduce unnecessary commuting and allow workers to concentrate during their most productive hours.
direct-question:2.chinese: 彈性工作安排也能有所幫助，尤其是當它們能減少不必要的通勤，並讓員工在自己最有效率的時間集中工作時。

direct-question:2.english: Managers should also create a culture in which employees feel trusted rather than watched.
direct-question:2.chinese: 管理者也應該創造一種讓員工感到被信任，而不是被監視的文化。

direct-question:2.english: People usually work harder when they feel respected, because they see their job not merely as a duty, but as a contribution.
direct-question:2.chinese: 當人們感到被尊重時，通常會更努力工作，因為他們不再只把工作視為職責，也視為一種貢獻。

direct-question:2.english: In conclusion, companies can raise staff productivity by improving work systems, providing useful training, and maintaining a healthy, motivating workplace.
direct-question:2.chinese: 總結來說，公司可以透過改善工作制度、提供有用的培訓，以及維持一個健康而具激勵性的工作環境來提升員工生產力。

direct-question:2.english: Productivity grows best when efficiency and morale move together.
direct-question:2.chinese: 當效率與士氣同步提升時，生產力最能自然增長。

direct-question:3.english: Many organisations require employees to wear a standard uniform whenever they are on duty.
direct-question:3.chinese: 許多機構要求員工在值班時必須穿著標準制服。

direct-question:3.english: Although this may seem like a simple rule about clothing, it can serve several important business purposes and can also make daily working life easier for employees.
direct-question:3.chinese: 儘管這看起來可能只是一項關於服裝的簡單規定，但它可以達到幾項重要的商業目的，也可以讓員工的日常工作生活變得更容易。

direct-question:3.english: For companies, the clearest advantage is that uniforms create a consistent and professional public image.
direct-question:3.chinese: 對公司而言，最明顯的優點是制服能夠塑造一致而專業的公眾形象。

direct-question:3.english: When customers see staff dressed in the same recognisable way, the business appears more organised, reliable and trustworthy.
direct-question:3.chinese: 當顧客看到員工以同樣容易識別的方式穿著時，該企業會顯得更有組織、更可靠，也更值得信任。

direct-question:3.english: This is especially important in service industries such as hotels, airlines and restaurants, where first impressions can shape the customer’s view of the whole company.
direct-question:3.chinese: 這在酒店、航空公司和餐廳等服務行業中尤其重要，因為第一印象可以塑造顧客對整間公司的看法。

direct-question:3.english: A uniform also makes employees easy to identify.
direct-question:3.chinese: 制服也讓員工容易被識別。

direct-question:3.english: As a result, customers can ask for help more quickly, managers can supervise the workplace more efficiently, and outsiders are less likely to enter restricted areas unnoticed.
direct-question:3.chinese: 因此，顧客可以更快尋求幫助，管理人員可以更有效率地監督工作場所，而外來人士也較不可能在未被察覺的情況下進入限制區域。

direct-question:3.english: In jobs involving food, healthcare or machinery, a uniform can also support hygiene and safety because workers are dressed in clothing designed for that particular environment.
direct-question:3.chinese: 在涉及食品、醫療或機械的工作中，制服也有助維持衛生和安全，因為員工穿著的是為該特定環境而設計的服裝。

direct-question:3.english: There are clear benefits for staff as well.
direct-question:3.chinese: 對員工而言，也有明顯的好處。

direct-question:3.english: First, uniforms remove the daily pressure of deciding what to wear and reduce the need to spend money on fashionable or work-appropriate clothes.
direct-question:3.chinese: 首先，制服消除了每天決定穿甚麼的壓力，也減少了在時尚服裝或適合工作的服裝上花錢的需要。

direct-question:3.english: This is a practical advantage, particularly for lower-paid employees who might otherwise feel judged by their appearance.
direct-question:3.chinese: 這是一個實際的優點，尤其是對收入較低的員工而言，否則他們可能會因自己的外表而感到被評價。

direct-question:3.english: Secondly, uniforms can create a stronger sense of equality and belonging.
direct-question:3.chinese: 其次，制服可以創造更強的平等感和歸屬感。

direct-question:3.english: When everyone wears similar clothing, differences in wealth, taste or social background become less visible, and staff may feel that they are part of the same team.
direct-question:3.chinese: 當每個人穿著相似的服裝時，財富、品味或社會背景上的差異會變得較不明顯，而員工也可能會覺得自己是同一個團隊的一部分。

direct-question:3.english: In addition, well-designed uniforms can be comfortable and protective, allowing employees to focus on their tasks rather than on their clothing.
direct-question:3.chinese: 此外，設計良好的制服可以既舒適又具保護性，讓員工能夠專注於自己的工作任務，而不是自己的衣著。

direct-question:3.english: In conclusion, uniforms benefit companies by strengthening brand image, improving identification and supporting workplace control.
direct-question:3.chinese: 總結來說，制服透過強化品牌形象、改善識別度和支持工作場所管理，為公司帶來好處。

direct-question:3.english: They can also benefit employees by saving time and money, reducing social pressure and encouraging a shared sense of professionalism.
direct-question:3.chinese: 它們也可以透過節省時間和金錢、減少社交壓力，以及鼓勵共同的專業意識，為員工帶來好處。

direct-question:4.english: In sales, it is tempting to assume that the best employees are those who chase money most aggressively, because commission rewards output directly.
direct-question:4.chinese: 在銷售行業中，人們很容易假設最好的員工就是那些最積極追求金錢的人，因為佣金會直接獎勵工作成果。

direct-question:4.english: I disagree with this view: money is not the true driving force behind sustained hard work, and recruitment should focus on character and customer-facing ability rather than financial hunger alone.
direct-question:4.chinese: 我不同意這種觀點：金錢並不是持續努力工作的真正推動力，而招聘應該著重於品格和面對客戶的能力，而不是單靠對金錢的渴望。

direct-question:4.english: Money may push people to make an extra call or close one more deal, but it rarely produces lasting dedication by itself.
direct-question:4.chinese: 金錢也許能推動人們多打一通電話，或多完成一筆交易，但它本身很少能產生持久的投入感。

direct-question:4.english: If a salesperson is motivated only by income, their effort depends on whether a reward is immediately visible.
direct-question:4.chinese: 如果一名銷售人員只受到收入驅動，他們的努力便取決於回報是否能夠即時看見。

direct-question:4.english: When targets become harder, customers become cautious, or rejection piles up, that motivation can burn out quickly.
direct-question:4.chinese: 當目標變得更困難、客戶變得更謹慎，或者拒絕不斷累積時，這種動力便可能很快耗盡。

direct-question:4.english: More importantly, a money-first employee may treat clients as transactions rather than people, which can damage trust and weaken long-term business relationships.
direct-question:4.chinese: 更重要的是，一個金錢至上的員工可能會把客戶視為交易，而不是有真實需要的人，這可能會損害信任，並削弱長期商業關係。

direct-question:4.english: Genuine hard work is more likely to come from professional pride, resilience, and a belief in the product being sold.
direct-question:4.chinese: 真正的努力工作更有可能來自專業自豪感、抗壓能力，以及對所銷售產品的信念。

direct-question:4.english: These qualities keep a person steady when the easy rewards disappear.
direct-question:4.chinese: 當容易得到的回報消失時，這些特質能讓一個人保持穩定。

direct-question:4.english: When recruiting sales staff, companies should therefore consider several practical qualities.
direct-question:4.chinese: 因此，在招聘銷售員工時，公司應該考慮幾項實際的特質。

direct-question:4.english: The first is communication skill: a good salesperson must listen carefully, explain benefits clearly, and adjust their tone to different customers.
direct-question:4.chinese: 第一項是溝通能力：一名優秀的銷售人員必須細心聆聽、清楚解釋產品好處，並根據不同客戶調整語氣。

direct-question:4.english: Sales is not merely talking; it is reading people.
direct-question:4.chinese: 銷售不只是說話；它是理解人。

direct-question:4.english: The second factor is resilience, because rejection is part of the job.
direct-question:4.chinese: 第二個因素是抗壓能力，因為被拒絕是這份工作的一部分。

direct-question:4.english: A candidate who can stay calm after losing a deal is far more valuable than one who is energetic only when everything goes well.
direct-question:4.chinese: 一個在未能成交後仍能保持冷靜的求職者，遠比一個只有在一切順利時才充滿幹勁的人更有價值。

direct-question:4.english: Finally, integrity should be treated as essential.
direct-question:4.chinese: 最後，誠信應該被視為不可或缺的特質。

direct-question:4.english: Sales staff represent the company’s face, and one dishonest promise can poison a brand’s reputation for years.
direct-question:4.chinese: 銷售員工代表公司的形象，而一個不誠實的承諾可能在往後多年損害品牌聲譽。

direct-question:4.english: In conclusion, money may be a useful incentive, but it should not be seen as the main engine of hard work.
direct-question:4.chinese: 總結來說，金錢也許是一種有用的激勵，但不應被視為努力工作的主要引擎。

direct-question:4.english: For sales positions, firms should recruit people who are persuasive, resilient, ethical, and genuinely capable of building trust with customers.
direct-question:4.chinese: 對於銷售職位，公司應該招聘那些具說服力、有抗壓能力、有道德操守，並真正能夠與客戶建立信任的人。

direct-question:5.english: In consumer markets, price is more than a number on a label; it often functions as a signal.
direct-question:5.chinese: 在消費市場中，價格不僅僅是標籤上的一個數字；它往往也具有信號作用。

direct-question:5.english: I would argue that price strongly influences potential buyers, especially when it suggests status or quality, but the final decision is also shaped by practical factors such as need, trust and personal experience.
direct-question:5.chinese: 我會主張，價格會強烈影響潛在買家，尤其當它暗示地位或品質時；但最終決定也會受到實際因素影響，例如需要、信任和個人經驗。

direct-question:5.english: A high price can attract consumers because many people associate cost with quality.
direct-question:5.chinese: 高價格可以吸引消費者，因為很多人會把成本與品質聯繫起來。

direct-question:5.english: When buyers do not have specialist knowledge, they may use price as a shortcut: an expensive phone, watch or handbag is assumed to be better designed, more durable or more prestigious.
direct-question:5.chinese: 當買家沒有專業知識時，他們可能會把價格當作一種捷徑：一部昂貴的手機、一隻手錶或一個手袋，往往會被認為設計更好、更耐用或更有聲望。

direct-question:5.english: This is particularly true in luxury markets, where the price itself becomes part of the appeal.
direct-question:5.chinese: 這在奢侈品市場中尤其真實，因為價格本身已成為吸引力的一部分。

direct-question:5.english: A cheap diamond necklace, for instance, may make buyers suspicious rather than excited, because its low price weakens the image of rarity.
direct-question:5.chinese: 例如，一條便宜的鑽石項鏈可能會令買家感到懷疑，而不是興奮，因為它的低價削弱了稀有性的形象。

direct-question:5.english: In this sense, price can create desire by giving a product an aura of value.
direct-question:5.chinese: 從這個意義上說，價格可以透過賦予產品一種價值光環來創造購買慾望。

direct-question:5.english: It tells buyers not only what the item costs, but also what owning it might say about them.
direct-question:5.chinese: 它告訴買家的不只是這件物品的成本，也包括擁有它可能代表著他們是怎樣的人。

direct-question:5.english: However, price alone rarely carries a purchase decision from beginning to end.
direct-question:5.chinese: 然而，單靠價格很少能從頭到尾支撐一個購買決定。

direct-question:5.english: Buyers are also influenced by the usefulness of the product, the reputation of the brand, reviews from other customers and the emotional experience attached to ownership.
direct-question:5.chinese: 買家也會受到產品實用性、品牌聲譽、其他顧客評價，以及擁有該產品所帶來的情感體驗所影響。

direct-question:5.english: A parent choosing a child’s laptop, for example, may care less about whether it looks fashionable and more about battery life, reliability and after-sales support.
direct-question:5.chinese: 例如，一位家長為孩子選擇手提電腦時，可能不太在意它看起來是否時尚，而更重視電池壽命、可靠性和售後支援。

direct-question:5.english: Similarly, a product with strong advertising may initially catch the eye, but poor reviews can quickly pour cold water on that interest.
direct-question:5.chinese: 同樣地，一件擁有強力廣告宣傳的產品一開始可能會吸引目光，但差劣的評價很快就會為這份興趣潑冷水。

direct-question:5.english: Convenience also matters: people often choose items that are easy to obtain, simple to use and compatible with their daily routines.
direct-question:5.chinese: 便利性同樣重要：人們往往會選擇容易取得、使用簡單，並且能配合他們日常生活習慣的物品。

direct-question:5.english: In conclusion, price has a powerful influence because it can suggest quality, prestige and social meaning.
direct-question:5.chinese: 總結來說，價格具有強大的影響力，因為它可以暗示品質、聲望和社會意義。

direct-question:5.english: Nevertheless, people ultimately buy products when price works together with trust, usefulness, reputation and convenience.
direct-question:5.chinese: 然而，人們最終會在價格與信任、實用性、聲譽和便利性共同發揮作用時購買產品。

direct-question:5.english: A high price may open the door, but other factors usually decide whether buyers walk through it.
direct-question:5.chinese: 高價格也許能打開那扇門，但其他因素通常才決定買家是否真的會走進去。

direct-question:6.english: Many people equate business success with the amount of money a company or entrepreneur earns.
direct-question:6.chinese: 許多人把商業成功等同於一間公司或一位企業家所賺取的金錢數量。

direct-question:6.english: However, money is not a true indicator of success, because it can hide weak foundations, poor ethics and unstable growth.
direct-question:6.chinese: 然而，金錢並不是成功的真正指標，因為它可能掩蓋薄弱的基礎、不良的道德操守，以及不穩定的增長。

direct-question:6.english: A business should instead be judged by whether it creates lasting value for customers, workers and society.
direct-question:6.chinese: 相反，一門生意應該根據它是否為顧客、員工和社會創造持久價值來評判。

direct-question:6.english: The main problem with using money as the only measure is that financial results can be misleading.
